So, a retired power battery recycling network optimization model and intelligent algorithm are proposed to achieve multi-objective and multi-level integrated optimization, which could implement the extended producer responsibility system and appropriately utilize the existing forward logistics network. Firstly, considering both the economic costs and environmental costs, a retired power battery recycling network optimization model based on bi-level programming is proposed to achieve integrated optimization at the strategic and tactical levels, which takes both the minimum total cost of retired power batteries reverse logistics and the minimum negative impact on residents as the upper-level objective and takes the shortest tour path of recycling vehicles as the lower-level objective. Secondly, insufficient diversity of solution sets and slow convergence speed are usually shortcomings of existing heuristic algorithms in solving such planning models, so a multi-objective grey wolf and genetic algorithm (MGW-GA) is proposed to solve the model by using leader selection strategies and external storage archives and applying the ideas of evolutionary game and hierarchical iteration. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the constructed model are proved by experiments. The performance of algorithm is compared with an existing excellent heuristic algorithm, NSGA-II-GA. The results indicate that the MGW-GA exhibits significant advantages in terms of the diversity and uniformity of the non-dominated solution set as well as convergence speed.

articleTitle: MDFN:Multi-scale Dense Fusion Network for RGB-D Salient Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In RGB-D salient object detection, the low quality of the salient maps produced after detection is caused by the unclear contents of some RGB-D images and the poor utilization of image information by some methods. To solve the above problems, in this paper, we propose a Multi-scale Dense Fusion Network (MDFN) to improve RGB-D image understanding and enhance the performance of salient object detection. First, in the design of the encoder, we chose the Pyramid Pooling Transformer (P2T) as the backbone network of the encoder, and take advantage of the strong image understanding capability of the P2T to prevent the loss of important information when extracting RGB-D features. For the limitations such as less depth map information and noise interference, we propose the Depth Attention Enhancement Module (DAEM) to enhance the depth feature representation, and design the RGB-Depth Fusion Module (RDFM) to achieve RGB-D information matching. In the decoder design, to improve the utilization of image information, we propose the Dual-dense Fusion Module (DFM) to fully integrate the features of each layer and achieve multiple applications of the object information. Compared with 7 SOTA methods on 3 public datasets, MDFN achieves excellent performance on 4 evaluation metrics $(S_{\alpha}, F_{\beta}, E_{\xi}, M)$ and saliency maps, which proves the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Multi-source data acquisition system for radiometric calibration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the key work in the field of remote sensing, radiometric calibration can improve the accuracy of sensor measurement data to a certain extent. As a necessary condition for remote sensing work, the accuracy and quality of data are particularly important. In order to extract data more accurately, this paper designs a data acquisition and processing system for multi-source data of radiometric calibration. Firstly, the data source types and system modules of multi-source data acquisition and processing system are described. Secondly, it introduces the overall design of the data acquisition system, as well as the possible problems and solutions of data acquisition. In addition, this paper also developed a system monitoring platform to maintain the system in real time by monitoring the process of obtaining data. Finally, the system function is tested, and the test results reach the expected effect. At present, this data acquisition and processing system has been successfully put into use in the radiation calibration of sensors.

articleTitle: A High-security Configuration Circuit Design for SoPC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: SoPC has gradually take place of FPGA in electronic systems. Protecting the bitstream files designed by users becomes the basis of using digital chips safely. In this paper, a security configuration circuit in SoPC chip is proposed. Through the encryption and authentication algorithms of AES-256 and SHA-256, and the unique readback control circuit, we realized the encryption configuration and bitstream authentication of the SoPC chip. Meanwhile, effectively protects against possible backdoors and loopholes in SoPC. The simulation results show that the circuit can realize encryption configuration and data protection.

articleTitle: Sea Ice SAR Image Generation and Analysis based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This work discusses the potential applications of deep learning method supported by the increasing amount of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data, in particular the Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). The generative and discriminative networks of a modified version named Wasserstein GANs (WGANs) are applied in the sea ice image analysis. The generated SAR images bear a great similarity to real images from both visual inspection and data modeling perspectives. Meanwhile, the discriminative network outputs are capable of providing direct representations of sea-ice regional proportions and indication of the overall ice concentration of the test images. Such results demonstrate a useful unsupervised or semi-supervised approach in sea characteristic studies. The network training and test scenes are from real RADARSAT -2 HH polarization SAR multi-looked intensity data covering marginal sea ice areas.

articleTitle: Detection Method Of The Distributed Photovoltaic Aggregation Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the gradual increase in the number of distributed photovoltaic systems connected to the distribution network, various network attacks and abnormal attacks faced by the communication network will also increase. Therefore, it is very important to study the risk protection against distributed photovoltaic aggregation attacks and potential network anomaly attacks. Numerous distributed photovoltaic branches, circular operation, and flexible load fluctuation characteristics are important factors affecting the stable operation of traditional distribution networks and suffering from abnormal network attacks. This paper presents a mathematical model for distributed photovoltaic aggregation attacks, aiming at minimizing load fluctuations and transmission line power fluctuations in distributed photovoltaic network systems, to achieve detection of distributed photovoltaic aggregation attacks and related control and protection methods.

articleTitle: Dynamic collection and analysis of network link performance indicators based on BGP-LS and telemetry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the era of SDN/NFV technology, in order to meet the goal of cloud-network convergence and cloud to number conversion, this paper proposes a network link performance index collection based on BGP-LS and telemetry protocols to achieve second-level performance index collection, rapid network topology collection, topology change sensing, SRv6 path performance index sensing, etc., which realizes the automatic fault recovery capability from path monitoring, to fault detection, cause analysis, path re Optimization calculations, and the ability to send down the network to complete the automatic fault recovery of the path at the minute level.

articleTitle: A Joint Entity and Relation Extraction Model Based on Encoder-Decoder
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Relation extraction is a task of automatically detecting and identifying predefined semantic relationships between identified entities in text. As a core and basic technology of knowledge acquisition in knowledge engineering, relation extraction endows artificial intelligence with strong ability of knowledge understanding. Massive text data, as the carrier of human knowledge, is rapidly submerged in the tide of information with the explosive growth of information. Mining knowledge hidden in these texts, is not only the theoretical demand of natural language processing but also the practical demand of human civilization inheritance. Natural language processing based on deep learning methods has made great progress in relation extraction field, effectively promoting knowledge discovering in texts of various granularity. However, some problems in relation extraction still need solving in the practical research process. In view of the existing work, most of the relations extraction task is divided into two independent sub-tasks, named entity recognition and relation classification, which lack the interaction between named entity recognition and relation classification in the sentence, and cannot handle the overlapping entity and relationship triples well. To solve these problems, a joint entity and relation extraction model based on Encoder-Decoder structure is proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of THz Communication in Satellite Constellation*
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: THz communication technology has been known as an important enabler for 6G. This paper summarizes the condition of THz research in some countries, and introduces the characters of THz communication, ultrahigh communication speed with ultra-high path loss for the same reason–the ultra-high frequency (more than 100 GHz). The THz communication is more applicable in satellite constellation for the ideal channel. This paper analyzes the problem that need to be handled before practical application, such as Doppler shift and tracking problem. We propose a typical LEO satellite constellation and analyze the performance of THz communication in multi-scenarios (intra-orbit, inter-orbit and satellite-ground). The results show that the Doppler shift and tracking problem, which THz communication being used in LEO satellite constellation may face, can be handled easily. Furthermore, the THz communication can also achieve the goal of ultra-high communication speed at a long distance.

articleTitle: M-Net: COVID-19 Lung Image Classification based on CNN and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The M-Net model is proposed in this paper to classify the COVID-19 lung CT images of patients. The mixing module is presented in this work to extract local information while capturing long-range dependencies. The introduction of the mixing module makes an improvement to the classification performance of the model. Experimental results show that the proposed M-Net model outperforms other state-of-the-art classification models, including both CNN-based and Transformer-based models, with an Accuracy of 95.03%, a Precision of 95.21%, and a Sensitivity of 97.46%.

articleTitle: Design and Characterization of a High-performance Wearable Robot Using Symmetric Conjugate Surface Joints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Hand impairments after stroke of a person can result in losing his independence and quality of life. Hand exoskeletons are widely used for hand rehabilitation and assist in grasping tasks in people’s daily life. Unfortunately, current hand exoskeletons remain challenges in user-friendly design, portable for daily use, and dexterity for different tasks. Here, we report a wearable hand exoskeleton that incorporates key biomimetic properties of human hand. The exoskeleton contains a series of symmetric conjugate surface joints. The hand exoskeleton proposed here achieves accurate biomimetic performance in the execution of finger natural grasping. Thanks to the conjugate surface joints, the finger exoskeleton is capable of tracking specific trajectories with a simple structure comparing with the traditional n-bar linkage exoskeletons. Experimental results confirm that the exoskeleton covers the range of fingertip forces required to assist users in daily grasping activities.

articleTitle: Advanced BP Neural Network Algorithm on Radar Jamming Effectiveness Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aimed at the problems of initial weights and thresholds of standard back propagation neural network effecting the network training in the presence of radar jamming effectiveness evaluation model to a great extent, first, this paper puts forward the idea of using GA according to selection, crossover and mutation among the random initialization and regarding the error function between predicted and expected values as the fitness function to optimize initial weights and thresholds of BP neural network to predict data sample better. Then train and predict the BP neural network at last. Compared to the algorithm without GA, the simulation results show that the using genetic algorithm to optimize the BP network has smaller error in evaluation, and the advantages and disadvantages of the two evaluation algorithms are verified.

articleTitle: Research on 5G Network System Construction of Intelligent Open-pit Mine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The construction of smart open-pit mines has entered a period of rapid development. 5G technology plays a huge role in the construction of smart mines. At present, there is a strong demand for integration of 5G+smart open-pit mines, and it is crucial to build a safe and efficient 5G network system for smart open-pit mines. First of all, the requirements for 5G network in China’s open-pit coal mines are sorted out: remote control, unmanned driving, UAV patrol, video transmission, etc. Some typical intelligent application scenarios have increasingly stringent requirements for wireless networks; Then, the key technologies used in 5G, such as large-scale antenna, network slicing, edge computing, are introduced; Secondly, the construction principles of 5G network architecture are proposed, and the 5G network architecture of intelligent open-pit mine is designed and constructed based on 5G network foundation; Finally, combined with the actual application scenario, the application of 5G in open-pit mines is introduced, hoping that the research content can promote the integration of 5G+smart open-pit mines and accelerate the construction of smart mines.

articleTitle: Small Target Forest Fire Recognition Method based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the small size of the fire target in the early stage of the forest fire, the model has the problem of missing detection of the small target forest fire. This paper proposes a forest fire recognition method based on YOLOv5 small target detection. In order to obtain flame space information at different scales and obtain an output containing abstract feature information, replace the SPP module in the YOLOv5 backbone network with the WASP module; in order to enhance the expression of flame features, add the Triplet attention module to the C3 module; In order to improve the detection effect of the detection algorithm on small flames, a small target detection layer is added. In this paper, a set of ablation experiments and a set of comparative experiments are designed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. The experimental results show that compared with the original YOLOv5 algorithm, the algorithm in this paper has improved mAP@50 by 3.49%, and can accurately detect small target forest fire targets, effectively improving the ability to prevent forest fires.

articleTitle: Design of seafood product stacking system Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Now considering the seafood picking and stacking is only realized by manpower. It not only consumes a lot of manpower and material resources, but also the personal safety of personnel under harsh environment is necessary to consider. The design of the seafood stacking system based on machine vision is studied in the paper. The realization of unmanned picking and stacking has always been the focus of the seafood product enterprises. This project carries out the research on the key technology of the picking and playing system of visually guided seafood, which includes the intelligent picking and playing system of visually guided seafood, the efficient and stable classification of seafood, the unmanned process from picking to playing. The system can effectively saves manpower. The system meets the requirements of the enterprise for automatic stacking of seafood. The scheme design of the system is reasonable. It is planned to carry out the development of the system prototype in the later stage and carry out subsequent tests to verify the stability and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Sea Ship Target Detection Based On Improved ViBe Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of slow “ghost image” elimination speed, ship trail interference, and complicated sea surface noise in the process of ViBe algorithm’s ship target detection in the sea background. This paper proposes a ViBeDiff3C object detection algorithm which combines the frame difference method and the improved ViBe algorithm. Based on the frame-to-frame difference method, the ViBe algorithm is improved to detect ship targets, and the “ghost” problem caused by the ViBe algorithm caused by moving targets in the first frame of the image is solved, thereby improving the update speed of the background template and achieving the goal of quickly eliminating “ghosts”. Objective To improve the detection effect of the frame difference method by introducing the Canny operator into the frame difference method, and solve the problems of sea surface noise, ship wakes and holes, thereby improving the clarity and accuracy of the target.

articleTitle: Design of A New In-transit Monitoring Terminal for Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The new in-transit monitoring terminal is a device specially used for monitoring the status information during the transportation of large electrical materials. It can monitor the vehicle position, speed, three-dimensional impact acceleration, tilt angle, nitrogen pressure, ambient temperature and humidity, battery voltage, anti-disassembly alarm and other functions in real time during material transportation. It also supports 4G communication, Bluetooth communication, solar panel access, on-site printing and other functions. The monitoring data is sent to the remote monitoring data server through the operator network. The transportation status can be viewed in real time on the server. Users can also use the mobile terminal to view the status information during transportation in real time, and monitor the transportation process in real time and comprehensively. The new in-transit monitoring terminal design in this paper can solve the problems of equipment damage and unclear responsibilities, reduce communication costs and ensure the safety of goods. This design meets the operation requirements of the power logistics service platform of the State Grid of China, and can solve the problems that hinder the development of power logistics management, and improve the level of power material management and control.

articleTitle: Restaurant Photovoltaic Environment Optimization and Clustering Method--based on PNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to explore the impact of the restaurant dining environment on customer satisfaction, this paper conducts research on two aspects of restaurant decoration design and the indoor environment by processing measured data. In this paper, the canteen of XX University is taken as the research object, and specific indicators are determined according to the restaurant design and indoor environment. The indicators conduct the satisfaction questionnaire, and the results are presented in satisfaction values. Through fuzzy C-mean clustering (FCM) clustering results, probabilistic neural network (PNN) training data and verification numbers are selected. The results show that when the decoration colour is cheerful, the air temperature is 23°C, and the noise is below 60dB, the customer’s satisfaction is exemplary.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis algorithm of power supply based on case-based reasoning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and real-time of station power supply system fault repair, the case-based reasoning algorithm is applied. First, the fault case set is organized to build a fault case library and extract feature attributes and fault types; then, the KNN-based algorithm is used to calculate the similarity between the source and target cases for the unprocessed fault data set and the processed fault data set. After the contrast and the analysis, the accuracy of case retrieval after the data processing is higher.

articleTitle: Design of Liver Cancer Diagnosis System with Structured Database
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The liver, the largest organ in the human abdomen, possesses a complex structure. Clinicians can diagnosis liver cancer by computed tomography (CT) images. Early detection and treatment of liver cancer are imperative to avoid significant complications. Unfortunately, traditional diagnostic techniques are time-consuming and heavily reliant on expert interpretation. Consequently, there is a pressing need for an automated and comprehensive system to replace conventional diagnostic methods. Also, there are numerous organizations that voluntarily share liver and liver tumor datasets all around the internet, and a central platform is required to combine various data sources, well organize the data, and enhance re-usability. There are a few studies on image intelligent diagnosis system and they all focus on liver tumor detection but omitted organizing the data well. In this research, we designed a liver cancer diagnosis system with structured database. And we have proposed a novel flow of data warehousing, data annotation and liver cancer diagnosis for computer-aided diagnosis.

articleTitle: Access Control Policy Management Based on Data Classification and Hierarchy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The integrated management information system gathers all kinds of data on a unified storage, management and application platform. Establish strict data classification and hierarchy mechanism and corresponding access control methods to ensure the security of data access. This paper proposes a policy-based access control mechanism for data classification and hierarchy. It uses the attributes of the subject and object, environment variables, and related information to control the access of resources. It can describe users’ various access control requirements more flexibly and accurately, and implement access control quickly according to the changes in the operating environment to ensure the security of important data and function modules.

articleTitle: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Method for Accurate and Efficient Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Anomaly detection is a crucial service in contemporary data networks, and the development of new fast and robust algorithms capable of detecting and classifying dangerous traffic is essential to cope with evolving threats and increasing detection difficulty. In this paper, we present a novel anomaly detection algorithm that uses deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to efficiently learn and adapt to anomalies in time series data. Compared to alternative DRL methods using in anomaly detection, the approach posited in this paper presents various advantages. Primarily, it outperforms other techniques in scenarios with continuous action spaces. Additionally, it contributes to the stabilization of the learning procedure and enhances the convergence of the algorithm. Finally, it facilitates the acquisition of superior policies and circumvents the risk of being trapped in local optima.

articleTitle: Research on Micro-electric Network Management and Control Technology to Enhance Distributed Energy Absorption Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the characteristics of the user-side microgrid, the principles of energy storage capacity and power allocation in the microgrid are summarized. Through the analysis of the output of the photovoltaic power station, the goal function of maximizing user income is established by using the characteristics of the energy storage system to track the output of the photovoltaic power, and the power balance requirements of the power generation system, the state of energy (SOE) constraints of the distributed energy storage system The power and capacity constraints of the distributed energy storage system adopt the linear decreasing inertia weight particle swarm optimization algorithm, aiming to seek the micro-electric network management and control strategy under the existing constraints, and enhance the distributed energy absorption capacity.

articleTitle: Optimization study of satellite communication transmission of meteorological message information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, we study the transmission of meteorological message information satellite communication, i.e., we calculate all combinations between time (K) and number of detachments (N) under given conditions by enumeration method and n-bit interval transmission method, establish a general transmission model between K and N, and conduct Monte Carlo simulation experiments on the obtained data, give the data evaluation criteria and experimental error analysis, and select the optimal value and optimal transmission scheme. Problem 1: first of all, a preliminary analysis of the transmission between the primary stations is carried out, the model is built using enumeration and n-bit interval transmission, and the relationship between the time K and the number of detachments N is calculated; and then, a Monte Carlo simulation experiment is carried out on the data using Oracle Crystal Ball, and the optimal solution of the model is obtained by analyzing the data of 10,000 Monte Carlo experiments. The minimum value of K is 5 when N=9, and the transmission scheme of the weather message from the master station is obtained based on the simulation results. Problem 2: With a probability of 80% for a sub-station to send and receive a message, when two sub-stations of each detachment send the same message to the same master station at the same time, the probability of satisfying the probability of successfully accepting a weather message from at least one sub-station of that detachment is not less than 0.9. The optimal sub-station weather message transmission scheme is obtained by using the enumeration and multi-objective aggregation transmission method. The analysis shows that the transmission scheme for sharing weather messages between stations is the same as Problem 1. The data is then simulated by Monte Carlo using Oracle Crystal Ball, and the maximum value of N is 12 when K=7, and the transmission scheme of the sub-station weather messages is obtained.

articleTitle: High-power multiphase coupled wireless charging coil structure based on DD coil
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The electric vehicles energy efficiency characteristics of the wireless charging system are directly related to the coupling coil structure of the system, which has a great influence on the transmission power, transmission efficiency, offset tolerance, electromagnetic loss, conducted radiation and other factors of the system. However, the existing coil structure has many difficulties for high-power wireless charging, so a more reasonable coil structure is needed to improve the power density of high-power application systems. Based on the existing wireless charging double-D(DD) coil structure and its theoretical basis, this paper proposes the multiphase bipolar three-winding coil structure, and discusses the magnetic field distribution and magnetic coupling inductance model topology and multiphase coil structure. The considered structure is designed to utilize a rotating magnetic field to achieve smoother power transfer characteristics over time than single-phase systems. The simulation results show that under the same conditions, when the front-end voltage is 800V, the output power of the multiphase coupling structure is 98.62kW, and the coil surface power density reaches 394kW/m2, which increases the transmission power by 26.2% compared with the single-phase structure.

articleTitle: Cross Energy Variety Adjustable Resources in Typical Scenarios Participate in Grid Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to help achieve the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals and build a new power system, it is necessary to consider the power and electricity balance problem under the condition of high proportion of new energy access and controllable power system cost. Cross energy variety adjustable resources can play a role in different scenarios due to their own characteristics. This paper analyzes the scenario of long cycle electricity balance in hydrogen energy service, the scenario of hot and cold resources participating in peak shaving and peak shaving, and the scenario of electric heating synergistically improving the self balancing capacity of the park, respectively. The results show that the cost of providing regulatory resources is significantly reduced by adjustable resources across energy varieties, and additional benefits are brought.

articleTitle: Research and development of cement clinker production data mining system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Take the production process parameters and quality data of cement clinker as the research object. A set of methods for cleaning, processing and analyzing the data of cement production process parameters is proposed, and a data mining model of cement production process parameters is expected to be established; Optimize the discretization method based on value division, form a new discretization method by introducing the knowledge of cement field, and apply it to the processing of cement clinker production data; According to the characteristics of cement clinker production data, Apriori algorithm is improved, and the parameters in the cement production process are analyzed by association rules using the improved Apriori algorithm to obtain some instructive analysis results. Based on the analysis of the category and characteristics of process data, aiming at the problems of quality data availability and analysis difficulties, a mining algorithm is designed. On the one hand, the massive production process data generated by cement enterprises are filtered by features. On the other hand, when any process data is needed, the quality data that meets the needs can be quickly selected from the characteristic production process data to provide accurate data support for the intelligent control of cement enterprises.

articleTitle: A Survey of Double-Qualified Teacher’s Professional Standard Elements in Double High Level Vocational Colleges based on Likert Scale Using the R Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Building a High-Level Double-Qualified Teachers’ Faculty (DQTF) is the key to support the reform and development of double high level vocational colleges in the new era, and has become the focus of research in the field of higher vocational education. Meanwhile, the determination of professional standard elements is the core. This article firstly adopts the technique to confirm the 34 critical indexes which compose the professional standard, builds the 7 Likert Scale, and carries on the collection of 726 questionnaires. Based on the results obtained from the test, the results will show that the model of the sample is found out by means of R language, which provided a basis for further research on Principal Component Analysis.

articleTitle: Auditory, Frontoparietal, and Somatomotor Networks Encode the Direction of Auditory Motion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Directions of auditory motion can be represented by multivariate activation patterns using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). However, whether functional connectivity (FC) patterns across brain regions encode auditory motion directions remains unclear. In the present study, we hypothesize that FC patterns across auditory, frontoparietal, and somatomotor networks could represent directions of auditory motion. We obtained FC patterns across the three networks while healthy participants passively listened to a sound moving horizontally. Multivariate connectivity pattern classification was carried out based on the direction of motion. Result showed that FC patterns across three networks encoded the direction of moving sound. Furthermore, we identified the FCs and brain regions contributing most to the coding of auditory motion direction. In sum, our result demonstrated that FC patterns across auditory, frontoparietal, and somatomotor networks encoded the direction of auditory motion.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Signal Light Recognition Method in Complex Scene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor real-time performance and low recognition rate of traffic light recognition methods in complex scenes, a traffic light recognition method for complex scenes is studied. Firstly, the bilateral median filter is used to suppress the noise in the complex background, and the image with low illumination is enhanced; Then, the improved Scharr operator is used for edge segmentation, and the interference region is removed by mathematical morphology processing and setting double threshold, and the accurate location of signal lamp is realized by region analysis algorithm; Finally, according to the color histogram of Cr component in YCbCr color space, the threshold range for judging color is set, and according to the shape characteristics of signal lamps, the discrimination conditions of shape or number is set. Finally, the accurate recognition of traffic signal lamps is realized. The experimental comparative analysis shows that for the traffic light recognition of complex scenes such as cloudy, rainy, snowy and foggy days, the average recognition accuracy of this method is 98.8%, and the average running time of the algorithm is 0.8s. The recognition rate is greatly improved, and the traffic light can be recognized quickly and accurately. Therefore, this method has good robustness and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research on target attitude estimation method based on image
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the real time and accuracy of door handle pose estimation, this paper improved ORB matching algorithm and combined with least square plane fitting algorithm. In order to improve the real-time performance of the system to obtain the location information of the door handle, the ORB matching algorithm was used to reduce the time complexity of the algorithm itself and the polar constraint algorithm was added to reduce the search dimension to straight line search to reduce the matching time and reduce the mismatching. Finally, the least square plane fitting algorithm is used to obtain the spatial attitude information of the door handle under the camera plane. The accuracy and real-time performance of the improved ORB matching algorithm and the accuracy of the door handle pose are verified by experiments. The proposed method can meet the requirements in practical application.

articleTitle: A Survey of the Logistics Service Quality Level for Courier Enterprises based on Likert Scale using the R Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, a large number of courier enterprises emerging. With increasingly fierce homogeneous competition, the improvement of logistics service quality has become an important goal for courier enterprises. To improve the service quality of the courier enterprises requires a clear perception of the current service quality level, so it is crucial to investigate and evaluate the service quality level of courier enterprises. In this paper, we used technical method determine 22 key indicators based on SERVQUAL theoretical model, then made a 7-point Likert scale, distributed and collected 716 questionnaires, from which 671 valid questionnaires were obtained. Then we used R language to visualize and analyze the data such as density distribution, heat map, and histogram, which revealed the pattern of the survey data and laid the foundation for the next step of establishment of evaluation model.

articleTitle: Social media fake news detection algorithm based on multiple feature groups
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The spread of fake news on social media seriously jeopardizes the authenticity of online content. Such misinformation has the potential to affect public opinion, government credibility, and more. Therefore, automatic detection of fake news is an important and challenging problem that has not been well solved today. Fake news has three universally recognized characteristics: the text of an article, the user response it receives, and the source users promoting it. Existing work mainly focuses on formulating a solution for a certain feature, which cannot detect fake news more accurately. In this work, we propose a model that combines all three features to achieve more accurate and automated predictions. We propose a model called TSRI, which consists of four modules: Text, Source, Response, and Integrate. The first module is based on news text content, using the BERT+LSTM model, while considering the semantic representation of sentences and the long-distance dependencies between sentences. The second module uses GAT to model the network of replying and retweeting users based on social network features. The third module is based on the user's response to the news, using LDA to find conflicting opinions in the news tweets, and based on the identified tweets' opinions, constructs the credibility of the tweets and spreads the network, and finally obtains the module's value through iterative deduction. result. The last module combines the above three and outputs whether the news is true or false.

articleTitle: Design and research of waveform detection experimental platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rise of artificial intelligence, machine learning methods have been applied to classify many waveform processes, such as ECG. Since the detection signal waveform and image have similar data forms, there is a relationship between local and global, i.e., the relationship between low-level features and high-level features. Therefore, the features of CNN can be used to abstract some low-level and visible waveform changes in the diagnosis process into some concepts of passing and failing in engineering inspection, and realize automatic feature extraction and classification. In order to reduce the parameter operation and improve the efficiency, this paper designs a 7-layer CNN shallow model to complete the automatic classification of pass and fail in a simple and efficient way, and then effectively solve the classification problem of manual inspection images. It provides a practical basis for further application of the trained optimal model to guide engineering practice, and provides further validation of the CNN in the development of both efficiency, accuracy, and generalizability algorithms, which have great potential for future applications in waveform detection.In this paper, an experimental platform for waveform detection by machine vision is established to address the problem of waveform classification for ultrasonic conduction technology detection, using a self-built waveform detection database, which contains a total of 1000 test images, applying a deep learning convolutional neural network (CNN) method for training, and using 700 waveform images in the period as the detection data set, with a training and detection accuracy of 93& or higher. In the detection of continuous waveforms, the CNN method outperforms the conventional method of manual reading in terms of speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Dynamic Deeper Graph Convolutional Network for Traffic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Graph convolutional networks (GCNs) are widely used in traffic prediction because they can better represent the structure of traffic network. GCNs can obtain deeper feature representation by aggregating neighborhood features. However, the network is prone to over-smoothing, as the aggregation neighborhood deepens. GCNs used for traffic prediction usually aggregate neighborhood features of order 2 or 3. To obtain deeper features, we use an adaptive hidden layer connection method to deepen neighborhood aggregation in traffic graph network for the first time. It adaptively adjusts the weight of hidden layer to increase the initial connection and hidden layer connection, which can obtain deeper neighborhood features and alleviate over-smoothing. We evaluated the model using real data from the road network in Beijing, and it showed good performance, especially in the long-term prediction.

articleTitle: A value index calculation framework for value quantification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of digital economy, value-based management has attracted more and more attention from enterprises with its diversified advantages. Value-based management is based on value quantification, aims at value growth, and pursues long-term sustainable maximization of organizational value. The value quantitative evaluation needs to carry out full-scale data collection and calculation of element flowing in the process. When the data collection and calculation is scattered in digital applications of various businesses, there are often some problems such as irregular data collection, low calculation efficiency and difficult monitoring of indicators. Therefore, this paper exploits the value quantitative evaluation technology and designs a value index calculation framework, which includes digital element warehouse, digital component warehouse, and digital index warehouse. The proposed framework can provide the ability of element association management, process execution data collection and value index calculation and analysis. It can effectively improve the standardization, accuracy and efficiency of value quantitative evaluation and provide support for process optimization and innovation.

articleTitle: An embedded system for evaluating plant growth based on plant electrical signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With population growth, national grain still needs to import a lot every year, grain is a country’s economic lifeline, so we are now the first problem to solve is agriculture production, this paper proposes the method of analysis of plant electrical signals and discusses the relationship between plant electrical signal change and plant growth environment and growth state. Thus, the growth condition of plants can be judged by the electrical signals of plants, and the environmental factors can be adjusted quickly so that the growth condition of plants can be effectively controlled. In this paper, aloe vera is used as the experimental object to predict and evaluate the environment where the plant is located through plant electrical signals. Taking the assessment of the change of light intensity in the environment where aloe vera is located as an example, only the light intensity is changed, and the collection is carried out under the three light levels of 0%, 50%, and 100%. The FTP data site will be established for the three kinds of electrical signals collected. Realize plant electrical signal data storage and online acquisition. The embedded platform is built, the domestic RT-Thread real-time operating system is adopted for modular programming, and the MQTT transmission protocol is adopted to realize the data interaction between the embedded hardware platform and the Ali Cloud Internet of Things platform. Meanwhile, the WEB side of the Ali Cloud platform can control and monitor the environment incubator, which is convenient for laboratory staff to carry out experiments and maintain data.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent SEI Method for Navigation Radar Based on Metric
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Specific emitter identification (SEI) of radars is an important function of electronic reconnaissance. Aiming at the individual identification of navigation radars, this paper provides a method combining metric learning and deep learning. That method extracts the front & back edge and instantaneous frequency of pulse envelop based on original pulse waveform data as initial input features, then combines the central loss function and cross entropy loss function to training the deep neural network so as to extract the individual features, at last makes identification to radar individuals through the optimized fully connected classification network. The test results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the performance of critical parameters including cluster effect of radar individual features and correct individual identification rate etc.

articleTitle: Detection Localization and Recovery of False Data Injection Attacks on Power Grids Based on SA-DCNN and AE-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The power system has gradually evolved into a power information physical system with deep coupling of power and information systems as advanced information and communication technology has advanced. False data injection attack (FDIA), an emerging form of information attack, can quickly affect the physical system via a strongly coupled system, tampering with system operation data without being detected by the bad data detection module, posing a serious threat to the safe and reliable operation of the power system. As a result, this paper employs FDIA of power grid as the research object, and first constructs FDIA base data to meet the actual conditions based on the AC power system where part of the network information is known. Then, a self attention-deep convolutional neural network based FDIA detection and localization algorithm is proposed, and the attacked data are recovered using an autoencoder-long and short-term memory neural network based on the correlation of the measurement data itself. Finally, a thorough experimental validation of the FDIA construction, detection, localization, and recovery algorithm is carried out using the IEEE 14 and 118 systems. The results show that the proposed comprehensive algorithm has excellent performance and can be used to effectively defend against FDIA against power grids.

Author Keywords: long and short term memory neural networks

articleTitle: Detection of Tubercle Bacilli by Fusion with YOLOv5s and ESRGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of small target and complex background in target detection, this paper proposes a fusion algorithm based on YOLOv5s target detection method and ESRGAN image super-resolution method -ESRGAN-YOLOv5s algorithm. The algorithm adds ESRGAN network to the input layer of YOLOv5s network, and then performs super-resolution data enhancement on the Mycobacterium tuberculosis data set input into the model; Then add channel and spatial attention module CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) to the FPN (Feature Pyramid Networks) feature pyramid network of the model to improve the ability of the model to extract the characteristics of Mycobacterium tuberculosis; Finally, a large-scale feature map is added to the detection head of the model for the detection of tuberculosis bacilli. The experimental results show that the average accuracy (mAP) of tuberculosis detection based on the fusion of YOLOv5s and ESRGAN is 85.9%, which is 2.5% higher than the original YOLOv5s model. The improved tuberculosis detection algorithm has a better recognition effect on tuberculosis targets.

articleTitle: Analysis of audit methods for high security cross-region video conference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The persistence of the epidemic has made inter-regional teleconferencing one of the main ways for organizations to work. As a special information system, the conventional auditing method can not cover the key points of information security of video conference service. Therefore, this paper analyzes the characteristics of organization video conferencing services, and analyzes a special audit method for high security cross-region video conferencing services. This method includes pre-meeting, mid-meeting and post-meeting behavior audit, and designs a variety of data models to support comprehensive audit analysis. Secondly, it puts forward two key audit items of abnormal meeting and illegal meeting, which provides a comprehensive and practical business behavior audit method for high-security organization video conference services.

articleTitle: The Application of 5G Technology for Intelligent Open-pit Mine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Digitalization is the only way to realize the high -quality development of traditional mining companies. Today, China’s open-pit mines are gradually moving towards the direction of intelligence, but the intelligent development of Chinese mines still faces intelligent decision-making Efficiency and other issues. First of all, the concept of 5G technology and wisdom open-pit mines is introduced; then, the application of 5G technology in the open -air mines is outlined, explaining the key technology of 5G technology for smart open-pit mines,for instance network slice technology, super bandwidth technology,ultra-low latency technology; the typical scenarios in the construction of open pit mines, including unmanned driving systems and target tracking, are emphatically introduced; finally, it is concluded that the application of 5G technology can further strengthen the security of intelligent open pit mines, ensuring real-time network communication and information transmission. With the continuous development and promotion of 5G technology, the large-scale implementation and application of 5G network in open pit mines will push intelligent open pit mines into a new development stage.

articleTitle: Research on the profit mechanism of data elements of platform economy in the era of big data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In today’s era of big data, the data itself gradually established as the factors of production, platform economy is actually the data as the core of the economic model, platform economic data elements profit mechanism as data elements supply the size of the size of the market and gradually development andprosperity, this paper through the analysis of data elements profit mechanism, establish data elements market scale expansion coefficient formula model, the research platform of the value of data value, shows that the data supply, value is farfrom fully realized.

articleTitle: Music emotion prediction based on multidimensional feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Audience sentiment analysis is a popular research task in Music Information Retrieval (MIR). In this work, we aim to lean the prediction model of fine-grained music emotion for intelligent editing and retrieval. To satisfy the properties of time-series of music, the RNN-based model of BILSTM was selected as the bone. In particular, the traditional features and deep features extracted from the CNN architecture of spectrogram was fused with attention mechanism to enhance the recognition ability for different emotions. The ablation experiment has proved the necessary of the multi-dimensional features. Finally, the contrasting experiments on recent algorithms demonstrate that our proposed method for emotion prediction is effective, which is also suitable for small data sets.

articleTitle: Improved Genetic Algorithm for Production Scheduling in Machine Tool Manufacturing Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the flexible job shop scheduling problem in machine tool manufacturing plants, an improved genetic algorithm based on directed variation is proposed. Based on the real-time production situation, the algorithm generates the probability distribution of processing equipment selection, and then carries out directed variation operation according to the probability, thus improving the optimization ability of the algorithm. In addition, the method of antibody self-elimination is used in species selection to enhance the diversity of the population.

articleTitle: Prediction of World Temperature Based on PSO Optimized LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Global temperature prediction is the crucial to prevent global warming. For the global ballooning problem, this paper proposes a long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network model combined with particle swarm optimization algorithm for predicting global average temperature. Two metrics, mean square error (MSE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), are selected to evaluate the prediction performance. The prediction results are compared with BP, LSTM, and PSO-BP. Particle swarm optimization is used to optimize the LSTM network input weights, reduce the loss function, and fit faster. Sensitivity analysis of the model yields a good generalization of the model, which can be extended for time series prediction.

articleTitle: Image style transfer based on local matching and global alignment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, image style transfer and deep learning technology have developed rapidly. It has been widely used in many fields, such as film and TV filters and art creation. However, the quality of the generated stylized images still needs improvement, often with content structure distortion, content detail loss, lack of semantic perception, and other problems. In this paper, we propose an image style transfer method based on local matching and global alignment. The local matching module is used to enhance the semantic similarity perception and improve the local style. The global alignment module improves the content structure distortion problem by aligning the statistical information of features. The integration of local matching information and global alignment information can better balance the style and content structure. The comparison experiments of stylized effects demonstrate that our approach can generate high-quality stylized images.

articleTitle: The Impact of Total Product Purchase Limit on Consumer Purchase Intention in E-business
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Currently, limited purchase is widely used in various online promotional activities in e-business. Previous studies have found that limited quantities often enhance consumers’ desire to buy goods. In fact, with the frequent occurrence of promotional activities, when the number of purchase restrictions is large, it may be more able to stimulate consumers’ willingness to purchase. The existing research has not been able to conduct a comparative study on the amount of total purchase restrictions. Therefore, this study introduces perceived sincerity and perceived scarcity to explore the impact mechanism of the total amount of product purchase limit on consumers’ purchase intention. Through online experimental research, we find that: the total amount of product purchase limit has a significant positive impact on consumer purchase intention; Compared to the case where the limited purchase quantity is small, when the limited purchase quantity of a product is large, the consumer’s purchase intention is stronger; Perceived sincerity and perceived scarcity play a mediating role in the impact of total purchase limit on consumers’ purchase intentions. The results of this study enrich the research on online limited sales promotion, and provide reference suggestions for enterprises and businesses to plan promotional activities in e-business.

articleTitle: Demand Forecast and Production Arrangement of Small Batch Material
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, six representative materials are selected through simple data mining from a variety of material demand historical data, and appropriate mathematical models for various materials are found out by analogy method to predict the actual demand of materials, so as to effectively help enterprises rationally arrange the production of materials and check the predicted effective level by evaluating indicators. The research applied the methods such as Multiple Regression, Grey Prediction, ARMA Model Prediction, BP Neural Network Prediction and Poisson Distribution Prediction to deal with the historical data, and established mathematical model. It gives six material demand forecasts. It horizontally compares the average service level of six selected materials in different forecasting methods. Therefore, the most suitable prediction model is found for materials with different demand forms, and the comprehensive model evaluation index and promotion model are established by adding inventory and material price factors.

articleTitle: A PathFinding Method in Hexagonal Tactical Wargame
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In tactical wargames, the maneuver path planning of combat units is a fundamental issue that needs to be studied in computer-generated force simulation. The paper first describes the design and specific characteristics of the hexagonal wargame map; then explains the general principle and method process of the A* algorithm; because of the characteristics of tactical wargame pathfinding, a maneuver cost calculation model based on historical confrontation data is proposed, and the A* algorithm is improved based on the characteristics of the hexagonal map. Finally, a simulation experiment is carried out to prove that the method proposed in this paper can better realize the pathfinding of combat units and enhance their safety during maneuvers.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Big Data Resources on the Digital Transformation Performance of Manufacturing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the impact mechanism of big data resources on the performance of enterprises’ digital transformation, this paper, based on the resource-based theory, divides the big data capability into three dimensions: resource integration capability, deep analysis capability and application capability. Through empirical analysis of 225 effective sample data of manufacturing enterprises, we found that: big data resources, two dimensions of big data capability (resource integration capability and application capability) and transformational leadership behavior positively affect the performance of digital transformation; Big data capability and transformational leadership have a chain mediating effect between big data resources and digital transformation performance. This paper theoretically enriched the research on the impact of big data resources on the performance of digital transformation; In practice, it is clear that enterprises should improve their big data capabilities and leadership to promote their digital transformation performance.

articleTitle: Research of Automatic Engine Assembly System Based on Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Green, intelligent and customized are opportunities and challenges for the development and transformation of high-end equipment manufacturing industry. It has been applied in the field of intelligent assembly and inspection. As the core part of automobile, the assembly line of engine has realized the basic automation, but most of them are assisted by human. There are some problems such as low assembly precision, low efficiency, high labor cost and labor intensity. According to this, this paper independently developed the engine automatic assembly workstation based on industrial robot. The workstation combined with the engine oil pan gluing and material grasping and handling AGV car, realized the automatic assembly of engine crankshaft connecting rod and valve mechanism, automatic coating detection of oil pan, automatic delivery of workpiece, etc., which improved the intelligent and customized ability of engine assembly line. It can meet the assembly requirements of different types of engines, and has the significance of application and promotion.

articleTitle: Array Design of 0.7-1.8 GHz Phased Array Receiver
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The receiver is a signal receiving device placed at the focus of the reflector of the radio telescope. In order to improve the observation efficiency of the telescope, the phased array receiver is proposed. It is to place the miniature phased array in the focal field of the radio telescope, and realize the flexible pattern and beam scanning function through the beamforming network. If combined with the array element multiplexing function, it can realize the simultaneous observation of all beams in the entire field of view, so as to achieve continuous sky coverage. Aiming at the array design requirements of 0.7-1.8GHz wideband phased array receiver, $10\times 10$ rectangular array with element spacing of 0.04m, combined with the focal field simulation results under beam scanning, it is finally determined that the array design can synthesize 1 beam at 0.7GHz, 9 beams at 1.25GHz, and 25 beams at 1.8GHz. The above work is of guiding significance to the preliminary array design of phased array receiver for reflector antenna, and the performance of the array needs to be further verified in combination with the above design.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Intelligent Voice Customer Service System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Intelligent voice customer service is the focus of machine learning and artificial intelligence algorithm research today, for enterprises is to save manpower to answer high-frequency repetitive questions must be, for individuals also hope to have anthropomorphic intelligent customer service to quickly solve practical problems. The personalized intelligent voice customer service system based on Rasa, React, Tacotron2, MelGAN and other framework models is designed, which solves the key problems such as inaccurate single-round dialogue reply, loss of important information in multi-round dialogue, and weak voice reply personalization ability, completes the basic service logic of multi-round dialogue, and can use characteristic human voices to complete personalized voice services, this paper mainly contains five large modules, namely front-end interaction module and back-end transit request processing module, Rasa NLU semantic understanding module, dialogue management module and speech synthesis module.

articleTitle: A Compact Wideband Dual-Polarized Dipole Antenna with High-Isolation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents a compact wideband dual-polarized dipole with high isolation. The proposed antenna makes use of two T-shaped orthogonal oscillators to realize the dual-polarization radiation. The wideband impedance matching is realized by the coaxial slotted balun. To reduce the size of the designed dipole, the arms of the oscillators are bent down. By optimizing various design parameters affecting antenna performances, the simulation results show that the relative impedance bandwidths of two ports are 32.1% (11.65GHz~16.1GHz) and 31.3% (11.45GHz~15.7GHz), respectively, and the port isolation is more than 45 dB, which indicates that the proposed dipole antenna has good dual-polarized radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Network Security Management System Based on K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology and Internet worldwide, people are using computers more and more to deal with various affairs. However, due to the late start of information construction and weak foundation, there are still many problems that need to be solved in China: such as unreasonable network structure, unsound network management system and lack of effective network security protection system, which have seriously restricted the rapid and healthy development of China’s economy and society. Therefore, how to strengthen the scientific and rational use of information network resources has become one of the important issues that need to be studied urgently. As an emerging information processing method, cluster analysis is to measure the similarity in a collection of objects and divide them into several categories according to certain criteria, so that the objects in the same category have a greater degree of similarity or similarity. It can discover a large amount of potentially useful knowledge, and thus is widely used in pattern recognition, machine learning, image segmentation and text classification. However, traditional clustering algorithms often need to specify the number of clusters or the initial centroid positions in advance, which leads to the final result may not be the optimal solution; In addition, when the size of the dataset increases, the computational effort also increases dramatically, which is difficult to meet the actual demand. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a new K-Means algorithm-based model for network security management systems, which can automatically determine the number of clusters and their optimal initial values, while using a parallel approach to execute tasks to reduce running time and improve efficiency.

articleTitle: Security Protection Mechanism of Core Data of Industrial Internet Identification Analysis in Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on the innovative industrial Internet identity resolution architecture, and focusing on the security risks existing in the industrial Internet identity resolution system, the industrial Internet identity resolution registration authentication and trusted resolution mechanism are designed. The information interaction rules and identity authentication methods of the system module are designed for enterprise node access, enterprise user registration, update, identification resolution and other processes. And tamper proof verification is carried out for the parsed entity ID mapping data results to further enhance the data security of the innovative ID resolution system.

articleTitle: Research on ITO Conductive Glass Chipping Defect Detection Method based on Improved Skeleton Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the detection difficulties caused by edge bending, dirt, dust, etc. in the detection of chipping defects of ITO conductive glass based on machine vision, a chipping defect detection method based on improved skeleton extraction is proposed. First, pretreatment is performed prior to skeleton extraction, to remove the pseudo-skeleton caused by the influence of dirt, dust, and other noise. Secondly, according to the characteristics of chipping imaging, remove some algorithm links to improve algorithm execution efficiency; Finally, short straight line segmentation is unfolded after skeleton extraction, Based on the judgment of the number of short straight lines, the detection of chipping defects is realized. Experiments show that the improved algorithm has high efficiency and accuracy for the chipping detection of ITO conductive glass, and has high practical value.

articleTitle: A Channel-enhanced Cross-modality Person Re-identification Method Based on CE-DGTL
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For visible-thermal person re-identification. This paper presents the CE-DGTL model. Using channel enhancement based on the DGTL model. By randomly swapping the image color channels, color-independent images are generated. Thus, the connection with the nighttime modalities is approximated, while the robustness of the model to color changes is enhanced. this paper also introduces a joint learning method for image enhancement from the channel level. Joint training is performed using visible images, enhanced images, grayscale images and nocturnal modal images. Using DGTL as the backbone network, coarse-grained and fine-grained information is learned to achieve intra-class compactness and inter-class differentiation. cbam attention module is introduced to make the model focus on specific regions. the model is jointly constrained using identity loss, triplet loss and hetero-center triplet loss. After using channel enhancement and cbam compared to backbone network DGTL. We experimented on the SYSU-MM01 dataset. In the case of All search, Rank-1 is improved by 7.85%. mAP improves by 5.39%. In the case of Indoor, Rank-1 increased by 7.04%. mAP increased by 5.81%. The above experiments also demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Research on fast stitching method of UAV aerial images based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Most of the current aerial images of UAVs are stitched together with the help of image post-processing software on the PC side, which has certain inconvenience. Based on the Android platform, the aerial images are transmitted back to the cell phone, and OpenCV is used to realize the fast-stitching and synthesis of the aerial images of UAVs. At the same time, considering the limitation of hardware image processing capability of mobile devices, the method is optimized and experimentally verified, and the results show that the image stitching effect on the mobile side meets the expectation.

articleTitle: A Network of Generating High Quality Hemoglobin Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, image-based facial skin pigment extraction has made great progress, and the extraction methods are mainly divided into traditional methods and deep learning methods. Due to the early introduction of traditional methods, there are some defects, such as low efficiency, some black pixels will go white, etc. Therefore, this paper mainly proposes a deep learning method based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to achieve hemoglobin image generation. Our goal is similar to image translation. Currently, the mainstream GAN networks for image translation include pix2pix, pix2pixHD, cycleGAN, etc. This paper proposes a network GHNet based on UNet to generate higher quality images. In the data set part, we built the paired data set of polarized light-hemoglobin image by ourselves. In the network part, we reduced the number of encoders and decoders in the traditional UNet network, which made the network more lightweight. Based on this, we define a neural network module and integrate the attention mechanism SE module to enhance the ability to capture the input image features. The experimental results show that, compared with ASAPNet, DGC and CLD networks, the proposed network training speed is the same as that of the baseline network, and the PSNR index and SSIM index of the generated images are improved.

articleTitle: Cascading Technology of Substation Video Stream Based on GB/T 28181
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the video stream processing technology based on edge analysis in substations has the problem that the video streams of substations and patrol centers with different voltage levels cannot be interconnected. The SIP protocol based on the GB/T 28181 and Q/GDW 10517 specifications can realize the unified implementation of video stream related processing control commands from different sources, realize the unification of video stream format. First of all, the control commands in the GB/T 28181 specification, such as video stream registration, real-time audio and video on demand, device information query, language playback and voice intercom, are implemented uniformly using the methods in the SIP protocol. Then, develop a unified access platform system for video stream to realize the unified access of video devices such as GB and B-Interface. Finally, through the distributed deployment of the unified access platform for video streams, cascade multiple substations or inspection centers to realize the continuous transmission of video streams between platforms.

articleTitle: A Fractional-order Neural Network for Solving Nonsmooth Programming*
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a fractional-order neural network is designed to solve non-smooth programming with linear equality constraints. First, we transform the feasible domain of the problem by extreme value mapping. We design a fractional-order neural network model by using the differential inclusion principle. The existence criterion is established by using the KKT condition for the existence of the optimal solution to the original problem. We select the appropriate Lyapunov function to prove the global stability of the equilibrium point of the fractional-order neural network. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify the obtained results in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Medical Service Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
