abstract: This paper mainly designs a mobile medical service robot. The system is divided into two parts: the upper computer and the lower computer. The upper computer uses the Raspberry PI 4B platform to recognize two-dimensional code or bar code information through OpenCV image algorithm, and collects basic information of patients, such as blood oxygen, heart rate, body surface temperature and so on. The lower machine uses STM32 microcontroller as the main controller to control the basic functions of the robot. The medical service robot can make a tour of each ward according to the prescribed lines. In order to adapt to the changing working environment, the robot has automatic lighting in dim environment, Hall code plate speed measurement, ultrasonic obstacle avoidance and other functions. The OLED screen displays real-time environmental data information. In order to meet various environmental requirements, the upper computer of the medical service robot sends commands to the lower computer through serial port, realizing two modes of automatic identification and manual control of the robot. This design has low energy consumption and is suitable for repetitive work in hospital wards and basic information detection of isolated population.

articleTitle: Multi-view Information Fusion Network for Pneumonia Diagnosis from Full Sequence CTs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Pneumonia diagnosis based on CT scans is crucial for the effective treatment. Existing deep leanring-based methods mainly focus on the global struction of the whole lung organs, while ignore the information of local detailed lesions. This can easily lead to errors in pneumonia decisions and a decline in classification accuracy. Actully, the diagnosis process of specialists in practice involves basically two steps glancing the whole lung organs to capture global information (global view) and gazing at local regions for observing detailed lesion (local view). To mimic this behaviour, we propose a multi-view information fusion network for pneumonia diagnosis from full sequence CTs. First, we design a multi-view information fusion network to extract spatial features from lung CT slices from global and local perspectives. Then, a recursive neural network (RNN) is utilized to solve the problem of dependency between slices and the continuity of lesions. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets are conducted and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Based on Multi-Strategy Improved Harris Hawk Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The paper proposes the EHHO algorithm to address the issues of reduced population diversity due to the use of random strategies for initial populations during the exploration stage of the Harris Hawk optimization (HHO) algorithm, as well as the problem of being trapped in local optima during the iterative process due to linear changes in escape energy during control development and exploration. Firstly, the Tent mapping function is introduced during the exploration stage to initialize the HHO population position. Secondly, a new formula for updating the nonlinear escape energy is used. Finally, the cosine inertia weight is utilized to improve the prey position update formula, thereby enhancing the algorithm’s local optimization ability. Experimental results demonstrate that the three optimization strategies effectively enhance the optimization performance of the HHO algorithm on 12 benchmark functions, and the improved HHO algorithm is significantly superior to other compared optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: SaaS-based Intelligent Conference Management System using Facial Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: An SaaS-based conference management system that implements facial recognition technology has been designed to address the requirement for intelligent conference management. The system leverages the SaaS model to achieve rapid deployment, enabling centralized management of multiple conference venues via a conference management service center. This center enables unified scheduling of attendees, equipment, and conference facilities, and provides customization to meet the requirements of various conference scenarios. The system uses facial recognition technology for conference check-in and data collection during the event, thereby optimizing conference automation management based on attendee information. User feedback has indicated a significant improvement in conference management efficiency.

articleTitle: Robot Control Policy Transfer based on Progressive Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the field of robotic control,it is appealing to solve complicated control tasks through deep learning techniques. However, collecting enough robot operating data to train deep learning models is difficult. Thus, in this paper a transfer approach based on progressive neural network (PNN) and deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) is proposed. By linking the current task model and pretrained task models in the model pool with a novel structure, the control strategy in the pretrained task models is transferred to the current task model. Simulation experiments validate that, the proposed approach can successfully transfer control policies learned from the source task to the current task. And compared with other baselines, the proposed approach takes remarkably less time to achieve the same performance in all the experiments.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of PCB Defect Detection Based on Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low detection accuracy and inaccurate defect location of PCB defects in conventional detection algorithms, an improved YOLOv5s PCB defect detection algorithm is proposed by studying PCB defect detection algorithms. Firstly, the loss function is optimized, and the original regression loss calculation method is changed from GIOU to EIOU, so as to accelerate the convergence speed of the model and improve the positioning accuracy of the frame, and the confidence loss balance coefficient is adaptively adjusted to improve the training effect of the model. Secondly, the attention mechanism of ECANet is introduced to improve the saliency and feature expression ability of PCB defect target area, and to enhance the extraction of small target defect detail information which is difficult to detect. Finally, in order to further verify the effectiveness and rationality of the improved YOLOv5s algorithm, ablation experiments are used for comparative analysis. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv5s algorithm improves the detection accuracy (mAP) to 96.80%, which meets the requirements of PCB defect detection.

articleTitle: Joint Identification of Space-Time Block Code and Modulation Methods Based on Trajectory Image
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A trajectory image-based identification algorithm is proposed for the joint identification of Space-Time Block Code (STBC) and modulation method used in multiple input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. First, the correspondence between the combination of STBC, modulation method, and trajectory image of the received signal was analyzed, and the feasibility of joint identification of STBC and modulation methods based on trajectory image was demonstrated. Two improvement schemes for trajectory images were given to increase the differentiation of different STBCs on trajectory images and the detailed information contained in trajectory images under BPSK. Finally, using the modified LeNet network to classify the trajectory image. The simulation verifies the ability of the algorithm to jointly discriminate between 24 combinations of 4 modulation methods and 6 STBCs, showing the algorithm’s feasibility to together to identify modulation methods and STBC jointly.

articleTitle: Robust Smoothing for the Reconstructed Trajectory using RLWRS-QMS Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the rocket projectile firing assessment test, the measurement data from a ground-based tracking radar may have poor quality due to complex interferences, especially in the rocket projectile’s low-altitude flight phase corresponding to the radar’s low-elevation detection that is corrupted by ground clutter. In this work, we are concerned about the problem that large errors accompany the rocket projectile’s trajectory that is reconstructed with polluted radar measurements, and affect the accuracy of assessment. We present a simple but practical robust smoothing method that combines robust local weighted regression smoothing (RLWRS) and quartile mean smoothing (QMS). Concretely, we use the RLWRS method to smooth the reconstructed sub-trajectory in the radar’s low-elevation detecting phase, whereas we use the QMS method to smooth the rest. Finally, a relatively realistic trajectory of the rocket projectile is obtained by splicing these smoothed sub-trajectories. A simulation experiment is provided and performed to verify the effectiveness of the RLWRS-QMS method.

articleTitle: Vehicle Data Security based on Underground Garage Location -- Dead Reckoning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the widespread popularity of the Internet of Things and the rapid development of vehicle communication technology, it has gradually become normal to realize vehicle evaluation, selection, and large-scale data distribution based on edge infrastructure. Collaborative data distribution through Wifi and CV modes effectively improves traffic efficiency, reduces road traffic accident rates, and improves user driving experience. Therefore, this paper will study the data security technology of Internet of Vehicles collaboration based on the dead reckoning method. To realize the security of data interaction, this paper describes the research of indoor positioning and the Internet of vehicles, respectively.

articleTitle: Maneuvering target filtering method based on the constraints of energy change rate and tangential acceleration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor tracking performance of traditional radar filtering algorithm in terminal high maneuvering of the target, a maneuvering target filtering method based on energy change rate and tangential acceleration constraints is proposed. Firstly, the traditional extended Kalman filter (EKF) is used according to the measured ranges, azimuth angles and elevation angles of the detected target. Then, applying the maneuvering characteristics of target, the constraints of energy change rate and tangential acceleration are designed, and the form of pseudo-measurement equation is integrated into the filtering process. The proposed method has the advantages of simple implementation and small computation. Compared with the traditional EKF method, the proposed method can effectively improve the filtering precision of position and velocity of targets in large maneuvers. Simulation results show the effectiveness and good performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: MPPT control of photovoltaic power generation system based on LESO estimation error compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to ensure that photovoltaic power generation systems can quickly reach the maximum power point and operate smoothly, this paper designs a maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller based on estimation error compensation of linear extended state observer (LESO). The purpose of improving the structure of first order linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) is to eliminate the estimation error of LESO in LADRC. By adding an estimation error compensation term to the traditional control law, the overshoot of the system is reduced, the response speed is increased, the anti-interference performance is enhanced, and the utilization rate of optical energy is improved.

articleTitle: Control Design of Smart Home Bookshelf
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of the Internet of Things and artificial intelligence, smart home has also entered an era of rapid development. Although many publications are widely accepted in the form of e-books and paperless office is increasingly popular, there are still many people who like to read or collect paper books. If there are a large number of books at home, most of them are easily forgotten on the shelf, and it is very inconvenient to access and search, especially for many books or materials that have not been electronic in the past, and it becomes very difficult to find them over time. This design uses OpenCV text recognition technology to realize the recognition of book information, uses the electric slide to complete the access of books at high places, uses the method of combination of bookcase to facilitate the intelligent expansion and reduction of bookshelves, and the client program carries in-depth intelligent applications, which greatly facilitates the use of users.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Monitoring and Identification System for Abnormal Behavior
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Traditional camera monitoring systems had been unable to meet the growing demand, in this case, intelligent monitoring technology had been rapidly developed. With the development of intelligent monitoring systems, great progress had been made in both the ability to respond to unexpected situations and the efficiency of hindsight viewing. By using artificial intelligence algorithms to detect people and their behavior, a lot of human and financial costs and time had been saved, and many valuable case investigation activities had been won over.

articleTitle: ISAR Image-based Spatial Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the increasing demand for space situational awareness and space environment monitoring, space target discovery, tracking, identification and classification technologies have been developed accordingly. At present, the integrated development of machine learning, artificial intelligence and other multidisciplinary disciplines has greatly promoted the progress of space target detection and identification technology. The inverse synthetic aperture radar image can reflect the fine structural features of space targets, which is important for feature extraction and recognition and classification of space targets. In this paper, three aspects of target recognition technologies based on RCS, HRRP and ISAR imaging are reviewed respectively, and the target recognition methods based on ISAR images are mainly discussed and validated. First, the basic problems and common methods of current RCS, HRRP, and ISAR image target recognition are introduced; then, a summary is made for ISAR image target recognition techniques; finally, the still existing problems of current ISAR image target recognition and the next development prospects are discussed.

articleTitle: A Brief Survey of Text Classification Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Text classification is a long-standing research spot in natural language processing (NLP), which greatly facilitates various NLP tasks. With the rapid development of Internet and social media, the need for effective data management also makes text classification become more and more important. Its research methodology has also developed from the early shallow classification based on handcrafted features to the deep language modeling with various neural networks. In this paper, we first give a brief introduction to its background and definition, and then describe its representative methods at different stages of development. Meanwhile, we also introduce the recently popular pre-trained language models on large-scale corpus, and discuss their applications to text classification. Overall, this paper gives a quick guide to understanding text classification research.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Output Simultaneous Coefficient of Regional Photovoltaic Power Station Considering Photovoltaic Capacity Ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of photovoltaic power generation, appropriately increasing the ratio of photovoltaic powerplant module capacity to inverter capacity has become an effective method to improve the comprehensive utilization rate of the photovoltaic system. The existing analysis method of photovoltaic power plant output simultaneity rate is no longer suitable for the future development of photovoltaics. In this paper, based on the photovoltaic operation data and the factors affecting the photovoltaic output, the monthly coefficient of photovoltaic power plant output is proposed through the operation data in the photovoltaic output large period at noon. Then, the 5% confidence interval is considered to calculate the daily average photovoltaic output and the actual daily output. The minimum value of them is taken as the monthly coefficient of photovoltaic power station output. Based on the monthly coefficient, the simultaneity rate of the photovoltaic power station is calculated, and the ratio of output power and inverter capacity under different capacity ratios and different photovoltaic power station output simultaneity rates is given. Finally, the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method are verified by the operation data of photovoltaic power stations in a provincial power grid.

articleTitle: Consistency Evaluation of Target Allocation Matrix for Soft and Hard Weapons
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the target assignment of multiple soft and hard weapons is to directly combine the damage probability of hard weapons with the failure rejection probability of soft weapons to form a target assignment matrix, and then target assignment matrix is solved by various optimization algorithms. The whole process lacks the consistency evaluation process under the same conditions. In view of this phenomenon, based on the analysis and comparison of various evaluation methods, an improved ADCF model is proposed. This model can comprehensively consider the damage or disable probability, availability, feasibility and external influence factors of soft and hard weapons, which could evaluate the comprehensive effectiveness of soft and hard weapons. Finally, the improved ADCF is used to analyze an example, and the results show that the evaluated target assignment matrix is more suitable as the fundamental basis for target assignment of soft and hard weapon.

articleTitle: Research on Closed loop Control of Steering Angle for Track Tracking of Intelligent Patrol Wheeled Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper uses the UWB positioning system to compare and verify the front wheel steering trajectory tracking controller and the four-wheel steering trajectory tracking controller of the intelligent patrol wheel robot.For the intelligent patrol wheel robot with front wheel and four-wheel steering, two speeds were used for verification, and the closed-loop test was finally carried out in the campus test field.The results show that the experimental results of the designed front wheel and four-wheel steering controllers are close to the simulation results, which indirectly verifies the accuracy of the dynamic model of the intelligent patrol wheeled robot;At the same time, the track tracking method of four-wheel steering based on adaptive model predictive control has higher track tracking accuracy than using front wheel steering only when the longitudinal speed changes.Therefore, the two controllers designed in this topic can meet the requirements of the closed-loop control of the intelligent patrol wheeled robot using trajectory tracking steering angle in different scenes.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of key process parameters of rotary kiln based on grey correlation degree
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the era of big data, the cement industry needs to use big data for correlation analysis. Combined with big data analysis technology, it can provide more scientific basis and more accurate characteristic information for the effective control of the temperature of cement rotary kiln. According to the characteristics of cement production in our country, according to the extraction of the key parameters of the process of rotary kiln production calcining and combining with the actual operator experience, the most important and most relevant process parameters are extracted to help operator find the most important parameters with strong correlation between the complex parameters, and help operator to change according to the correlation coefficient between parameters. Combined with the process flow to better judge the production.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Deformation Monitoring System Based on Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, natural disasters are frequent, especially landslides, which are always threatening people’s lives and properties. It is of great significance to establish a deformation monitoring system using modern science and technology to realize real-time monitoring of landslides for people’s disaster prevention and avoidance. This paper addresses the problems of the existing deformation monitoring system such as outdated architecture, not easy to upgrade and optimize, long system data link, and long data query time, and researches the deformation monitoring algorithm with multi-source sensors, and designs the deformation monitoring system based on microservice architecture, and completes the development of the deformation system to provide more timely, reliable and stable deformation monitoring service.

articleTitle: Flower classification Model based on improved attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the flower classification method is mainly based on the deep learning method. The deep learning model is used to classify flowers. However, most of the models are based on their own structure to build a complex structure, which requires high training requirements for the model and carries a large network burden. Attention model is widely used in the field of computer vision. Adding attention model to convolutional neural network can significantly improve the performance of the network without increasing the burden of model training. Therefore, this paper improves on BAMxs’s attention and integrates it into the deep learning model, using the self-built data set of 7 flower categories for experiments. The experimental results show that the accuracy rate is improved by 2.81% after integration into the network, and compared with common attention, the network performance can be greatly improved by introducing a few parameters into the attention model.

articleTitle: Improvement of Voice Navigation System based on Customer Service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of emerging digital information technology, various industries are accelerating the transition to intelligence. Based on the current challenges of China Telecom customer service operation system, this paper proposes an improved new generation of intelligent voice navigation system architecture, which improves the efficiency of the original customer service system in accurately responding to customer inquiries and complaints, and improves the customer service quality of hot user groups. Finally, based on the hot line pilot of a branch company, this paper trains a new generation of intelligent voice navigation model, verifies the effectiveness of the system, and provides new insights for optimizing other application systems.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation Network with Adaptive Neighborhood Construction for 3D Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the process of point cloud feature extraction, the inconsistent local spatial density of the input points will lead to the instability of Information fusion in the neighborhoods. In this paper, an adaptive neighborhood construction algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of uneven density when constructing spatial neighborhood from point cloud, which can more accurately capture the local spatial geometry near the query point. In addition, we augment the attentive pooling with differential attentive function, and both are integrated to assign a more effective attention score to the encoded feature. We applied the above methods to the RandLA-Net and tested on S3DIS Area5. The experiments show that our methods can effectively optimize the result of semantic segmentation and have obvious advantages in terms of accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Financial Crisis Early Warning Combining Model Based on Historical Data Trend and Single Year Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: How to give early warning to the financial crisis that may happen in the future is a hot topic in enterprise management. In view of the problems in the existing enterprise financial crisis early warning models, such as the single sample research angle and the large influence of sample data imbalance on the early warning accuracy, this paper combines the trend analysis of the enterprise’s longitudinal historical data with the horizontal single specific year data analysis, and proposes a combining model based on trend feature classification and twin support vector machine, And 123 enterprises that were implemented ST on the main board of Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchange from 2021 to 2022 were taken as the samples of financial crisis enterprises for empirical research. The results show that compared with the logistic model and the support vector machines model, the combining model can effectively improve the early warning accuracy; At the same time, the variable mass data gravity algorithm and twin support vector machine algorithm adopted in the combining model also make the model more robust in the case of sample data imbalance. On the whole, the combining model has certain theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between electrical signal and growth state of plants based on temperature factor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: It is a weak signal that changes the resting potential of plant cells or tissues under the stimulation of external environmental factors and can be transmitted between cells and tissues. Plant electrical signals are closely related to plant movement, growth, metabolism, etc., and the characteristic changes of plant electrical signals can then respond to the growth condition of the plant itself. In this paper, the electrical signals of Aloe vera are related to plant movement, growth, and metabolism. In this paper, according to the time-frequency domain distribution of this Aloe vera electrical signal, we choose to improve the wavelet threshold noise reduction to process the original electrical signal and then use the empirical mode decomposition into multiple eigenmode functions from 0-5Hz, multiple eigenmode functions form a two-dimensional time-frequency matrix signal and input the two-dimensional time-frequency matrix signal into the convolutional neural network for training to get the general law of plant electrical signal and plant growth state under different temperature levels. To further improve the model accuracy, the convolutional neural network model is optimized in this paper by adding a two-layer bidirectional LSTM behind the CNN.

articleTitle: Human-computer interactive intelligent trash can
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the demand for epidemic prevention and control and the encouragement of garbage recycling policy, how to enable users to empty garbage at the moment of garbage can idleness, timely disposal of some garbage that may become a medium of virus transmission and effective management and disposal of garbage cans become a problem worthy of attention. Therefore, this paper designs a smart trash can based on the STC89C52 microcontroller. This smart garbage can realize the functions of automatic opening of the lid by a garbage can personnel identification, real-time display of garbage capacity inside the garbage can, and human-computer interaction display by Bluetooth APP, which can effectively reduce the phenomenon that person needs to wait when emptying garbage, and also improve the efficiency of garbage can management for the administrator, and can provide the administrator with a suitable decision plan for when and where to put how many garbage cans.

articleTitle: A Radar Signal Sorting Algorithm Based on Improved FastICA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The FastICA algorithm is a novel iterative algorithm, also known as the fixed-point algorithm, proposed by Hyvrinen et al, at the University of Helsinki, Finland, unlike conventional neural network algorithms, FastICA uses a batch processing algorithm and requires larger data per iteration. In terms of both distribution and parallelism, the algorithm is still an artificial neural network-based algorithm. fastICA algorithms can be classified into three types: steepness, likelihood maxima, and negative entropy maxima. In this thesis, based on the FastICA algorithm based on negative entropy maximum, the algorithm has faster convergence speed and stronger robustness by introducing Newton iteration algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Network Video Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Traditional video monitoring systems do not have intelligent analysis and linkage processing capabilities, and cannot respond quickly to abnormal situations. This paper proposes a design method for an intelligent network video monitoring system, which uses a combination of software and hardware to timely determine whether there are abnormalities, and handle them in the fastest and best manner. Experiments have proved that the intelligent video monitoring system can effectively conduct pre warning, in-process processing, and timely evidence collection after the event. It is a fully automated, all-weather, real-time monitoring intelligent system.

articleTitle: Call Frequency Time Series Forecasting Based On LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Call frequency time series are extracted from Call Data Records and can be used to explore human activity patterns and predict call activity. In practical applications, accurate prediction of call frequency is very important, and can be used for optimizing communication network resource allocation, improving business processes and other aspects. In this paper, we design the network structure of LSTM (Long and Short Term Memory Network) and optimize the key parameters of the model to determine the optimal LSTM model to predict short term call frequency. In the experiment, we extracted 10 real call records for verification, and use these time series to test the model we designed. The average MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) is 5.721%. The results indicate that the model we used is a fast and effective one, which is advantageous for predicting call activity in future practical work.

articleTitle: Defects Classification of Steel Tube Based on Spectrogram and CNN Using Magnetic Flux Leakage Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Magnetic flux leakage (MFL) nondestructive testing technology uses magnetic sensors to detect the magnetic signal on the surface of seamless steel tube. In this process, the magnetic sensors are used to detect the flux leakage signal from the defects exist in the tube. The defects are located on the external or internal surface of the tubes with significant longitudinally or transversely oriented forms. This paper proposes a defect recognition and classification method based on spectrogram and convolutional neural network (CNN), which converts magnetic flux leakage signals frames obtained by sensors into spectrograms and sends them into convolutional neural network as input data for defect classification. The experiments show that the steel tube defects classification performance was 71% for method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Self-Rescuer Training System Based on GD32
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The underground coal mining process is highly dangerous. The self-rescuer device is the only escape tool that workers can carry with them when disaster occurs. Therefore, it is very important to master the use of self-rescue device. According to the current situation and many problems in the training of self-rescuer device. Based on GD32F103CBT6 chip, this paper designs a self-rescuer simulation operating system which integrates sensor technology. face recognition technology, information processing technology and Internet technology. It is used for daily practice of self rescue operation by downhole personnel, and ensuring that each person has mastered the correct operation method of the self rescue vehicle before going down the well.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Recycling Boats for Floating Garbage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, the problems of water garbage pollution and water bloom pollution have been widely concerned and discussed. On the one hand, due to the development of industrial activities in recent years, the discharge of garbage in the water body is increasing, which has seriously affected the water ecology. On the other hand, the pollution of water bloom in China is serious, which affects the maintenance of ecological environment and the development of freshwater aquaculture. At present, the equipment and technology for water garbage cleaning in China are still incomplete. In view of the critical situation of environmental pollution and the defects in the existing technology, the team designed and made a new type of water robot, which provides a new type of water surface garbage cleaning and water bloom management robot, which integrates identification, collection and transportation of garbage, and has many functions such as water bloom management and water quality detection. It provides an effective solution to the problem of water quality resources.

articleTitle: Research and application of key technologies of power grid model data management based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the operation and management of the power grid is complex and changeable, and the information islands between each link are obvious. In the process of promoting the transformation of the power grid, the blockchain technology meets the needs of multi-level collaborative management of power grid dispatching. Using the tamper proof and traceable characteristics of the blockchain technology, it can effectively solve the security and reliability problems of the interaction of regulatory data. Firstly, based on the characteristics of blockchain technology, this paper deeply analyzes the feasibility of integration of smart grid regulation business and deep application of blockchain. Secondly, according to the characteristics of smart grid dispatching application, the dispatching blockchain application architecture is designed, and the research on key technologies of the integration of blockchain technology and power dispatching application is carried out. Finally, with the tamper-proof and traceable characteristics of blockchain technology, the dispatching metadata management applications are deployed. Blockchain encryption technology and consensus mechanism are used to provide unified and traceable on-chain metadata which achieves effective control of the dispatching business system data.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based on Optimized D*Lite Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the problems of the existing D*Lite algorithm in the path planning of mobile robots, such as incomplete consideration of robot safety and excessive turning times, an optimized D*Lite path planning algorithm is proposed. The optimized D*Lite algorithm changes the safe path to the safe path in path search, and adopts the method of reverse search connection optimization after path planning.Smoothing the path planned by D*Lite algorithm is the same as marking the grid map with temporary obstacles when necessary, so as to avoid repeated searching of unnecessary grid areas by path planning algorithm. To verify the effectiveness of this method, the simulation is carried out by MATLAB software, The results show that the improved algorithm can obviously improve the safety of robot movement and the efficiency of reaching the target in practical application.

articleTitle: Research On an Image Dehazing Algorithm Based On MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, computer technology is gradually maturing. In the computer vision field, image processing technology in specific weather has become an important research field. For those photos taken in foggy weather, the mist will affect natural light leading to a certain impact on the visual effect making pictures seem unclear. Additionally, the useful information in the pictures will decrease. To solve the image blurring problem caused by natural weather such as haze, this paper adopts the histogram equalization method. By averaging the gray histogram of the image, the blurred areas are magnified and dispersed, and a clear state is visually presented. The retinex algorithm is used to process the histogram equalization result image to enhance the useful image information and further process the result details to defog the image and obtain the final defogged image.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Identification Technology of Power IOT Terminal based on Network Traffic Feature
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of heterogeneous hardware and complex access methods in power Internet of Things (IOT) terminal, it is difficult to achieve fingerprint identification through unified deployment of security probe agents. A fingerprint identification technology for power IOT terminal was proposed based on network traffic feature in order to carry out identity authentication, access control and other security protection of IOT terminal based on traffic fingerprint. According to the characteristics of the hierarchical model of power IOT, the technology extracts a traffic feature matrix by deploying traffic capture, analysis, and fingerprint identification model at the edge of the IOT agents, and then classifies and identifies the extracted traffic fingerprint data based on Multi-class support vector machine (MCSVM) to achieve fingerprint identification for accessing the power IOT terminal. The simulation results show that the technology can complete the classification of common power IOT terminal and identify their device types, and has better fingerprint identification accuracy compared to some machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Local Matching Relation Network for Few-shot Affordance Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Affordance refers to the potential ”operational possibilities” that a target object exhibits in an unknown external environment. Affordance classification is to classify objects with the same function into a class and predict affordance labels, which is a very important skill in the field of intelligent service robots serving human users. Classification models based on deep convolutional neural networks rely on huge amounts of training data, and there is a lack of datasets with a large number of annotations available for affordance classification, which can easily lead to overfitting. Therefore, it is of practical interest for us to train a model that can be quickly adapted to new affordance classification tasks by a small number of samples. Based on this, this paper applies the few-shot learning technique and proposes a local matching relation network. The model is based on relation network, and we propose a multi-scale fusion feature extractor as an embedding module to extract more effective image feature vectors. A local matching module is designed to improve the problem of poor classification due to the large intra-class variation of affordance images. Meanwhile, we build a dataset for affordance classification and conduct some affordance experiments. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Task Planning Problem of Vehicle-mounted Optical Measurement Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to enhance the detection capability of spatial targets, this paper studies the task planning problem of vehicle-mounted optical measurement equipment. Based on the working characteristics of the equipment and the detection task process, the task planning problem of vehicle-mounted optical measurement equipment is modeled, and the genetic algorithm is used to solve it, thus obtaining the optimal detection scheme. Simulation examples verify the effectiveness of the method and the related research results have certain reference value for the vehicle-mounted optical measurement equipment to better complete the detection task.

articleTitle: Adaptive sliding mode position tracking control of chain-driven rotating magazine based on disturbance observer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The polygon effect is inevitable during the movement of the chain-driven rotating magazine, and its load varies significantly throughout the loading process due to changes in the number of projectiles. The system parameters are nonlinear. Given these issues, it becomes apparent that the magazine is a complex nonlinear system that demands high control accuracy. This paper introduces an adaptive sliding mode control strategy based on a disturbance observer. The perturbation is estimated by the observer and then the estimated value is compensated to the controller. The influences of unknown parameters are weakened by the adaptive algorithm. Theoretical analysis and simulation results under various load conditions demonstrate that the control algorithm is insensitive to uncertainties, such as time-varying disturbance, unknown parameters, etc. The control can achieve a high control accuracy.

articleTitle: DS-KGAT: A Deep Session GAT with Knowledge Enhancement for CTR Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction accuracy is an important metric for recommender system strategies, and it always involves dynamic and continuous features. Previous methods based on user historical behavior usually capture the short-term interests of users, while ignoring the complex transitions between various historical behaviors of users and lack of interpretability. In order to model the user behavior sequence and capture the user fine-grained interests, we propose a novel model named Deep Session GAT with Knowledge Enhancement (DS-KGAT). Specifically, the user behavior sequence is divided into sessions of multiple graph data structures. On the basis of the session graph, Graph Attention Network (GAT) can represent each node as an aggregation of neighbor node embeddings. At the same time, the user’s interest in each session is propagated on the knowledge set to form the user’s preference distribution for candidate items. Then combining the long-term and short-term interest attention mechanism, each session is represented as a combination of item node embeddings. Finally, we utilize Bi-LSTM to model the interactions between sessions and the long-term evolution of user interests. We have done extensive experiments on the genuine dataset. The experimental consequences demonstrate that DS-KGAT improves the accuracy of click-through rate prediction, and has made substantial progress.

articleTitle: Analysis of Invention Patents Related to Testing Technologies for Communication Based Train Control System Applied by Thales SEC Transport Company
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Communication-based train control (CBTC) has become the main technical format of urban rail transit signal system. All kinds of software and hardware control logic in CBTC system need to follow the mechanism of rail transit train operation and meet the fail-safe principle. The research, development and test process of CBTC system should not only take the realization of software and hardware functions, but also take the realization of safety-critical principles into consideration. Analyzing relevant invention patents of representative enterprises with certain technical strength can help practitioners to better understand the test process and test technology involved in CBTC system. By considering that Thales Shanghai Electric Group Company (SEC) Transport is a signal system design, research and development enterprise with a large market share in China, this paper takes the relevant invention patents applied by Thales SEC Transport in testing technologies for CBTC system as research and analysis object, strives to grasp the main focus and development direction of test technology in the field of rail transit signal control.

articleTitle: Android-Based Binary Code Function Fast Positioning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To solve the problem that the existing Android reverse analysis method is inefficient and the applicable scenario is single. A fast positioning technology for binary code function based on Android is proposed in this paper, which includes preprocessing, behavior analysis combining dynamic and static, and binary code function comparison, which can accurately and quickly locate the location of binary code function. Based on this research, to further broaden the application scenarios of the fast positioning technology proposed in this paper and realize the automatic analysis of large-scale applications, an automated analysis tool AndPosit is designed. The proposed technology has been experimentally verified that it can be widely used in various Android applications, can accurately locate the target function code, and the efficiency is more than dozens of times higher than the original manual analysis method.

articleTitle: Research Status and Suggestions on Self-collected Data Sets on the Educational Application Practice of Emotion Recognition in China
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper makes a statistical analysis of the current situation of the research on the educational application of emotion recognition of China in the past 12 years, and finds that the data sets collected by the researchers in the educational application of emotion recognition of China cover facial expressions, physiological signals, speech and other modalities, and the classification of emotions reaches 35 kinds. This paper puts forward the idea of composing the academic emotion data set of Chinese cultural background on the basis of the existing practical research, and gives some suggestions for the construction of the data set in the next step.

articleTitle: Hydrogen energy management system based on blockchain technology and convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper introduces blockchain technology to record data in the hydrogen energy management system, which enables the recording and distributed storage of system data, clarifies personnel permissions and responsibilities, and deploys convolutional neural networks on one of the nodes to diagnose faults in the hydrogen energy management system equipment. Different rights are given to the operators in the system through smart contracts. The communication network of the hydrogen energy management system is divided into VLAN(Virtual Local Area Network) according to photovoltaic, wind power and hydrogen energy networks and classifies the data streams and smart terminals in the system to improve the efficiency of the communication network transmission. The role of the system is to coordinate the various devices in the system and to convert excess electricity generated by clean energy into hydrogen for storage using electrolysis of water to produce hydrogen. When clean energy is not producing, the system deploys fuel cells to convert the hydrogen energy into electricity.

articleTitle: DER-based Differential Testing of Certificate V alidation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The authentication of an X.509 digital certificate in the Secure Socket Layer or Transport Layer Security (SSL/TLS) protocol implementation is key to ensuring network security. Therefore, it is important to verify that the digital certificate can be validated correctly. Existing differential testing techniques based on certificate mutation are effective in detecting bugs in certificate validation, but mutation strategy is single. We address this problem by introducing our approach, a differential testing framework based on the mutation of Distinguished Encoding Rules (DER) encoded digital certificates. We obtain the DER-encoded X.509 digital certificate from the network as seed certificates, parse the label, length and value structure of seed certificates, and perform value mutation and Object Identifier (OID) guided mutation according to the parsed structure. We applied our approach on testing 3 popular SSL/TLS implementations, compared with the state-of-the-art differential testing technique (i.e., SADT). Experimental results show that our method is superior to SADT in detecting discrepancies.

articleTitle: Design of coal mine safety risk index analysis system based on big data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of mine intelligent construction which requiring the reduction of person, the increasment of safety and the improvement of efficiency, a coal mine safety situation awareness analysis platform based on multi-source data fusion is designed and implemented by using the mode of “platform + end” and micro service. Through multi protocol adaptation, coal mine safety risk data integration is realized, data credibility measurement and analysis indicators are established, and safety risk data quality judgment is realized. Based on the neutral reference object, we have established the risk evaluation index system and builded the two-level risk evaluation model applied to the company and the mine, which realizing the risk quantitative and hierarchical evaluation. The automatic identification of mine typical anomalies is realized by establishing the characteristic map of monitoring data. The visual analysis of safety situation is realized by using GIS technology and spatial interpolation technology. The field application reflects that the platform improves the ability of mine safety risk identification and risk exception handling, and provides guarantee for coal mine safety production.

articleTitle: Study on optimization of image lag process based on 4T CMOS image sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The trap energy level and electric potential deviations caused by the presence of non-ideal effects in CMOS image sensor pixel cells during the manufacturing process often lead to incomplete charge transfer during the transfer of photo-generated signal charge from the PPD to the FD, resulting in image lag from the residual charge trapped in the PD, thus affects the sensor imaging effect. The commonest method to improve the image lag phenomenon is to optimize individual process parameters. In this paper, a more systematic process parameter optimization method which is simulated and optimized for the image lag aimed at two aspects: the threshold voltage implantation adjustment of TG channel and the implantation dose of N-type impurities in PPD is proposed. The optimal process state and operating conditions for minimizing image drag are obtained as follows: TG channel implantation dose 8.0e12 cm-2 and PPD N impurity implantation dose 3.0e12 cm-2. The research method in this paper provides theoretical guidelines for optimizing and improving the performance of 4T pixel design for CMOS image sensor.

articleTitle: Digitalized design and realization on mine intrinsic safe mode geologic compass
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of large error and low efficiency of the traditional mechanic needle compass in underground coal mine, the mine intrinsic safe mode geologic compass was designed and realized by digital1 instrument technology. It was data acquisition technology used magnetoresistive and acceleration sensor. It was adopted optic-electric integration design in structure, and added two sets of laser modules for laser orientation and laser (projection) to measure the inclination. A simulated instrument panel, analog level calibration and digital display were applied to the operating interface. In terms of software, a special geologic occurrence measuring program was designed, so that the measurement of geologic occurrence could be semi-intelligent. The applied experiments showed that the compass could make azimuth angle measurement from 0° to 36° and inclination measurement from 0° to 90°, and the reading error could be eliminated; The auxiliary laser could realize non-contact measurement, improve the safety factor, work efficiency and measurement accuracy of the operator in dangerous environments such as underground mines and in the wild, and could be widely used in mine geology, geologic exploration and other fields.

articleTitle: Mowing robot trajectory tracking control algorithm research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A trajectory tracking control algorithm is proposed for a mobile weed control robot. The kinematics, dynamics and positional errors of the wheeled mobile robot are mathematically modelled, and the convergence and stability of the system are demonstrated by the direct method of Lyapunov functions. Finally, through simulation and prototype verification, the results show that the trajectory tracking control algorithm designed in this study has a good dynamic response curve with a longitudinal deviation of 0.03m, a lateral deviation of 0.02m and a heading angle deviation of 6.1° which proves the effectiveness and feasibility of the control algorithm.

articleTitle: Research Status and Improvement Methods of Manta Ray Foraging Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The manta ray foraging optimization algorithm is a bionic optimization algorithm that imitates the manta ray foraging behavior. This article introduces the basic concept and operation process of the MRFO algorithm. By summarizing the research status of the manta ray foraging algorithm and several improved methods for the manta ray foraging algorithm, the performance differences and their respective advantages and problems are analyzed and compared. Finally, the future development and improvement direction of the manta ray foraging optimization algorithm are prospected.

articleTitle: Research on The Inventory of General Information System Equipment Based on Main Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: General information system equipment reserve catalog is determined to be the foundation of the equipment reserve. This paper analyzes the military value and loss law of various kinds of equipment in the battle process, and combines the three aspects of the equipment reserve, and puts 19 assessment indexes. This paper analyzes and quantifies the indexes, and extracts the main factors that determine the reserve of equipment, and verifies the examples, and obtains the more scientific and reasonable results, and provides some reference for the relevant institutions to determine the inventory of the general information system equipment.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection based on traffic packets in cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Because the network traffic data is large and the flow rate is high, the abnormal traffic can provide support for the host vulnerability warning, which makes the real-time detection of abnormal network traffic become a key problem. This paper proposes an online anomaly detection model. Firstly, based on the encrypted traffic features of network traffic header, a threshold is set for the feature quantity and the extraction time of each stream to ensure the timeliness of feature extraction. On this basis, an anomaly classification model is constructed based on the classical LeNet-5. Finally, a simulation experiment was carried out to evaluate the anomaly detection accuracy of the above anomaly detection model. The experimental results showed that a small number of header messages could achieve a high anomaly detection accuracy, which provided certain proof for the feasibility of online anomaly detection, also provided support for the subsequent host vulnerability warning, and protected the security of cloud platform. Reduce the impact of attack traffic on the server.

articleTitle: A Method of Calculating the Accessible Capacity of Distributed Photovoltaic in a Distribution Network Considering Capacity Ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The unconstrained access of distributed photovoltaic or the extensive use of distributed photovoltaic grid connection leads to the change of system power flow and voltage distribution, voltage out-of-limit, and other problems. In this paper, the relationship between the distributed photovoltaic capacity ratio and the output power of the inverter AC side is analyzed. Considering the constraints between energy storage and distributed photovoltaic capacity, the energy storage control strategy is proposed. Then, the distribution photovoltaic consumption constraints, the line limit transmission capacity constraint, and voltage constraint are considered. The objective function of the maximum capacity of configurable distributed photovoltaic capacity on the inverter DC side is established. The calculation method of access capacity of distributed photovoltaic considering the capacity ratio is proposed. Finally, a distribution network example is given to verify the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: L2-norm Total Variation Regularization Deconvolution Algorithm for Radar Angular Super-resolution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The deconvolution super-resolution technology scan improve the angular resolution of the radar without increasing the aperture of the radar antenna. There is problem of poor noise adaptability with the commonly used deconvolution algorithm based on Bayesian criterion, and it’s difficult to find the optimal solution using the conventional regularization algorithm based on total variation because the objective function is not differentiable. This paper proposed an improved L2-norm total variation regularization algorithm, which can reduce noise by controlling the total variation, and can be solved iteratively through gradient descent. The simulation results show that the algorithm has better super-resolution performance than Bayesian algorithm, L2-norm regularization algorithm, and traditional total variation algorithm, especially in low signal-to-noise ratio situations.

articleTitle: A Method of Gear Control and Acquisition for Unmanned Boat Outboard Gear Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Unmanned surface vehicle is a kind of naval vessel, which is a comprehensive carrier integrating multiple disciplines and multiple technical fields. It has the characteristics of autonomous navigation, remote control, offshore operations, and maritime security. In the waters of remote islands and reefs, the marine environment is harsh, the sea conditions are complex and changeable, and the surrounding terrain is prominent. unmanned surface vehicle propelled by jet pumps are difficult to meet the requirements of complex marine tasks in terms of speed, efficiency, and power. The high-power dual side external storage machine can meet the maneuverability, safety performance, and operational ability of unmanned surface vehicle in harsh environments, effectively improving the control accuracy of unmanned craft’s maritime navigation trajectory. In addition, the traditional outboard hook has the disadvantages of inaccurate gear control and remote control. Therefore, a method for controlling and collecting the gear of the unmanned surface vehicle hook based on STM32 is designed.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Path Planning Algorithm Based on Improved RRT*FN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For the problem that the rapidly-exploring random trees star fixed nodes(RRT*FN) algorithms, with a fixed number of nodes have large randomness and low search efficiency. An improved RRT*FN path planning algorithm for mobile robots is proposed. First, the improved algorithm inherits the advantages of RRT*FN in optimizing memory and introduces a heuristic sampling strategy to add high-performance nodes to replace inefficient ones when the total number of nodes in the tree reaches a preset value. Secondly, an adaptive extension strategy is used to automatically adjust the weights of tree growth toward random and target points by collision detection methods. Finally, it is demonstrated through simulation experiments that the improved algorithm takes into account the exploration of obstacle-dense and narrow regions while fixing the number of nodes and optimizing the memory. The improved algorithm is more efficient in the path planning process and has stronger environmental adaptability.

articleTitle: An Augmented Lagrange Method for Second-Order Cone Constrained Variational Inequality Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, an augmented Lagrange method is constructed to solve the second-order cone constrained variational inequality problem. From the perspective of practical application, the Lagrange iterative formula is transformed into an equation system, and the equation system is solved by an inexact Newton method. Numerical results for three examples are reported to verify the effectiveness of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: An Improved Harmonic Detection Algorithm Combined with Blackman Window Bispectral Interpolation and Time Shift Phase Difference Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the analysis accuracy, anti-interference and stability of the harmonic detection algorithm, an improved harmonic detection algorithm with Blackman window bispectral interpolation combined with full-phase time-shift phase difference method is proposed. Based on the analysis of the principles of the Blackman window bispectral interpolation method and the full-phase time-shift phase difference method, the harmonic detection algorithm is combined and optimized. And the frequency measurement accuracy is improved, and the measurement stability in the case of harmonic frequency fluctuation and noise interference is verified. The results show that the algorithm has high measurement accuracy and good performance, and has high application value.

articleTitle: Tri-GACNet: A Storm Surge Point Cloud Segmentation Algorithm Based On Three-Channel Graph Attention Convolution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Storm surge is one of the most important marine hazards in China, and in the previous numerical calculation of storm surge volume, the model is less effective in calculating the near-shore sea area with complicated topography. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a method for semantic segmentation of storm surge based on the three-channel graph attention convolution, called Tri-GACNet, using point cloud data to identify and segment different regions such as storm surge tides and coastal slabs. First, construct the storm surge point cloud dataset. Then, three modules of global feature extraction, local similarity calculation and edge feature enhancement are designed and constructed to enhance the model’s ability to extract multi-scale features of storm surge. Finally, the storm surge point cloud features at different scales are fused in three dimensions: global, local and edge to improve the performance of semantic segmentation of storm surge point cloud data. The experimental results show that Tri-GACNet is able to accurately partition the different regions of the storm surge, thus reducing the impact on the storm surge volume calculation due to the large differences in coastal morphology between different shore sections.

articleTitle: A fast finding method for power Internet of Things equipment vulnerabilities based on page adaptive replacement cache replacement algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper aims at the problem that the passive detection and search speed of power Internet of Things equipment is not high. This article proposes a new fast vulnerability finding method, adopts the cache idea, establishes a secondary cache database, and uses the page adaptive replacement cache replacement algorithm idea and mobile The average algorithm is used as a grading rule. This grading rule solves the problems of frequency, timeliness, and noise points. It selects a higher priority CVE and stores it in the first-level cache. The gradient search greatly improves the The search speed of CVE reduces unnecessary waste of computing resources, thus greatly improving the search speed of vulnerabilities.

Author Keywords: page adaptive replacement cache replacement algorithm

articleTitle: Design of Table Tennis Collection System Based on STM32 and μC/OS-III
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of frequent manual picking up ping-pong balls during training, an automatic system for picking up ball is designed. The system combines single-chip computer technology, sensor technology and embedded technology to achieve the recognition, tracking, and picking up of ping-pong balls. The OpenMV visual module is used to identify and track table tennis balls, and the roller structure is used to pick up balls. The μC/OS-III embedded real-time operating system is transplanted to STM32 to achieve multitask management and task scheduling of the system, which improves the performance and stability of the system at a certain extent. The practice of the automatic ping-pong ball collection system shows that the rate of success picking up ball is high and its stability is good, which can reduce the burden of manual ball picking at a certain extent.

articleTitle: Applications of 5G Mobile Positioning Techniques in Vertical Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As a new generation of information and communications technology (ICT), 5G has been becoming a considerable driving force for the digital transformation of economic society. The rapid development in both technical and industrial fields has introduced abundant functions and possibilities for 5G, beyond its inherent communication capabilities. Precise positioning is one of these emerging characteristics and has been attracting increasing attentions from various industries, since its universal and general usability for industrial requirements. Effective employment of 5G as new infrastructure for seamlessly high-precision location services has become a new direction of global development, which is of great significance for solving the “last mile” of high-precision and low-cost location services from outdoor to indoor. Nine typical application scenarios in various industries are summarized in this paper. As an outlook, several possible development trends and challenges are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Data Quality Improvement Program Based on Big Data Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the rapidly developing information age, the explosive growth of data increases the difficulty of big data application. Through analyzing the challenges faced by big data applications such as data collection, data timeliness, data security, data quality and data expected results, based on the key characteristics of big data and the measurement indicators of data quality, the improvement procedures of data quality are proposed, that is, following the pre-processing stage, the quality measurement stage, the quality defect identification stage and the pre-processing work tracing stage, in addition, the effect of the data quality improvement procedure is evaluated, to improve the data quality and reduce the potential risks in the application process of big data.

articleTitle: EfficientRF: Facial Age Estimation Based on EfficientNet and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Age estimation by analyzing facial images has always been a challenging problem in computer vision. With the maturity of face recognition technology and the popularity of mobile devices, it is of great significance to deploy face age estimation algorithms on mobile devices. Aiming at the problems of high model complexity and low running speed of the current face age estimation model, this paper proposes a new end-to-end model named EfficientRF for the age estimation task. EfficientRF integrates random forest based on EfficientNet network architecture, wherein the split nodes of the random forest are connected to the last fully connected layer of the convolutional neural network. The experimental results show that, on the premise of ensuring high accuracy, the new method uses 1.6 times less parameters and 60 times faster running speed in face age estimation compared to three public age estimation benchmarks, and is superior to the most advanced standard on FG-NET dataset.

articleTitle: API Gateway Optimization Architecture Based on Heterogeneous Hardware Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, more and more businesses are developing towards microservices. As the entrance of request traffic, the API gateway carries a huge load. It needs to avoid becoming the bottleneck of the entire system and needs to have high performance. At the same time, the traditional gateway implementation method strongly relies on the processing power of the CPU itself. However, with the slowdown of CPU Moore’s Law and the sharp increase of business types and data volume, the CPU’s performance improvement on API gateways is limited. In response to these problems, this paper proposes a heterogeneous hardware-accelerated API gateway architecture, which uses heterogeneous hardware devices such as QAT to offload functions such as HTTPS and Gzip of the API gateway, thereby greatly improving the overall gateway performance, and significantly reduce CPU usage and improve overall system utilization.

articleTitle: Finite element modeling and simulation into clothing pressure of human body lower chest
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Most women will feel uncomfortable when wearing a bra for a long time. With the extension of time, the pain and discomfort of pressure will increase gradually. When the human body finally feels uncomfortable, it is actually the effect of internal stress. Establishing a reliable mechanical model through simulation can predict the internal stress of the human body when wearing a bra theoretically. In this paper, the size standard of 160/84 A mannequin is used as the basic human body model, and the FLEXIFORCE film pressure sensor is used to measure the clothing pressure data of the lower chest of the human body, and the clothing pressure prediction model of the lower chest of the human body is established in COMSOL Multiphysics through the theory of structural mechanics. This paper mainly studied the internal stress distribution when women wearing bras. The simulation results show that when wearing a bra, the internal stress is much greater than clothing pressure. Therefore, consumers are advised not to wear a bra for a long time unless it is necessary, and it is better to wear a vest or loose clothing as a substitute.

articleTitle: Preserving edge with Transformer for deep image inpainting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Most inpainting methods adopts convolutional neural networks (CNNs) due to its remarkable modeling capabilities. However, CNNs have certain limitations in understanding the global edge structure due to their inherent properties, such as local inductive priors. This has led to poor performance in reconstructing reasonable edge structures. Recently, deep generative methods have made considerable progress in image restoration by introducing edge priors. In contrast to CNNs, Transformers have demonstrated powerful capabilities in edge reconstruction. To this end, we propose a two-stage model PE-Net that combines a Transformer edge generator and a CNN image generator network. The edge generator is responsible for reconstructing the edges of the missing regions of the image, while the image generator uses the edges from the previous stage as auxiliary information to fill the missing regions. We conduct qualitative and quantitative experiments on the publicly available datasets CelebA and Places2, and the results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Water Resources Management Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
