abstract: As an important support for social informatization, big data technology not only brings convenience to human beings in life, but also plays a very important role in the process of water resources management. Big data technology can effectively solve the problems of low data value, data island and low utilization rate in water resources management. The application of big data also requires management departments to improve the level of digital construction. Based on the application of big data technology in water resources management, this paper analyzes the possible hidden dangers of big data technology in system security, data management and water ecological prediction, and puts forward feasible suggestions.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Liver Tumor based on Mobilenetv3 U-shape Net
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Segmentation of tumor regions from medical images is crucial for clinical diagnosis. U-Net is a practical encoder-decoder framework proposed for better image segmentation. In segmentation of medical image, U-Net performs more excellent than other network. At present, medical image segmentation usually continuously deepens the network to improve the feature extraction capability for the accuracy of image segmentation, rarely considering the practical performance of the network. This paper aims to simplify the network feature extraction layer, proposed to segment the liver tumor area by mobilenetv3. Then, the attention mechanism is added to the skip connection layer of the encoder-decoder to increase the correlation ofit. Finally, Experimental results shows that the precision, recall, dice, and AUC were 0.8854, 0.9704, 0.9187, and 0.9864, respectively, outperforming other state-of-the-art networks. Therefore, the proposed method has the potential for the automatic segmentation of liver tumors in clinical setting.

articleTitle: Typical Applications and Key Technologies of 5G Chips in Power Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As an important component of infrastructure construction, electric power system is a nationally major strategic development direction. The technical characteristics of 5G networks, such as low latency and high reliability, effectively support the business requirements of smart power systems, which has become an inevitable and recognized trend in technological evolution process. With the rapid development of digital power grids, customized chips in power application scenarios have become key devices supporting the transformation of power digitization, raising widespread attention and sustained concern. This paper focuses on application scenarios in power industry, introducing and analyzing the performance requirements in actual applications, especially for customized chips. A typical standard system is proposed for customized power chips.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation of Marine Law Enforcement Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Based on ADC Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the pattern of manned-unmanned and ship-aircraft coordination is gradually implemented in marine law enforcement, and evaluating the effectiveness of equipment has become one of the important topics. From the view of confrontation in marine law enforcement, this paper described the key factors which influenced on unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) efficiency, and a comprehensive operational effectiveness evaluation index system was established. According to the characteristics of three-level index which belonged to law enforcement capability, they were quantified and normalized, and built operational capability matrix (C). The analytic hierarchy process(AHP) was used to determine the weights of index at each level, the expert scoring method was used to determine the three-level qualitative index value, and taken the data of UAV operation and training. The ADC model is verified by an example, it is practicable and provides a method which used to evaluate the law enforcement equipment effectiveness.

articleTitle: Bright-Dark Channel Defogging Algorithm Based on SLIC Super-pixel Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of block effect and distortion in the distant view after using dark channel prior algorithm to remove fog, this paper presents a bright and dark channel defogging algorithm based on SLIC super-pixel segmentation. Firstly, the irregular region obtained by SLIC super-pixel segmentation is used to replace the fixed window to obtain the bright and dark channel map; Secondly, the weighted atmospheric light is obtained by weighting global atmospheric light and pixel-level atmospheric light; Then the transmittance of the bright area is corrected; Finally, the defogging image is obtained based on the atmospheric scattering model. The outcomes demonstrated that the block effect at the edge of the image and the distortion at the perspective of the image can be basically solved after using the proposed algorithm, which is superior to other contrast algorithms in subjective evaluation and objective analysis.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Clustering Routing Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the uneven node distribution and the limited energy of nodes in wireless sensor networks, a clustering routing algorithm for wireless sensor networks based on hierarchical clustering is proposed. No need to calculate the optimal number of cluster heads in advance. Randomly distributed nodes in the network were divided into several original clusters according to the hierarchical clustering algorithm. During network working, the clusters were selected according to node residual energy and position in the original clusters. The cluster head got the distance of the node farthest from it within the original cluster and used that distance as the communication range for sending broadcast messages. Ordinary nodes chose to communicate with the cluster head of the same original cluster or with the sink node depending on the distance. The simulation results show that the algorithm can reasonably complete the clustering and better extend the network life cycle compared with LEACH and KM-LEACH.

articleTitle: Federated Graph Learning with Cross-subgraph Missing Links Recovery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Federated Graph Learning (FGL) has been developed to enable multiple parties to collaboratively train a graph neural network while maintaining their local graph data. Despite its advantages, FGL is not immune to the issue of cross-subgraph link missing, which arises when there are edges between nodes in different subgraphs that are not observed by any of the parties. This can have a substantial negative impact on the performance of the Graph neural networks, particularly in cases where the missing edges are of crucial importance. This paper proposes a novel Federated Graph Learning Framework with Cross-subgraph Missing Links Recovery (FGL-CMLR) to address this issue by capturing the global graph structure and identifying the missing links. FGL-CMLR reduces the search space of nodes with potential link loss from the entire subgraph to a target set comprising clustered central and edge nodes. Next, a federated GCN-based link prediction model is trained to repair the lost links between central-edge nodes pairs belonging to different subgraphs. By aggregating representations of neighboring nodes in cross-subgraphs, the previous embedding of nodes with missing links can be corrected. Numerical experiments demonstrate that FGL-CMLR successfully alleviates the issue of cross-subgraph link missing and achieves improved accuracy.

articleTitle: Impression Network for Video Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Object detection in videos is more challenging than in static images. It’s proved that naively applying object detector frame by frame can be slow and inaccurate - visual clues can get weakened by defocus and motion blur, causing failure on corresponding frames. Multi-frame feature fusion methods proved effective in improving the accuracy, but they largely sacrifice the speed. Feature propagation methods proved effective in improving the speed, at the cost of lower accuracy. So is it possible to improve speed and performance at once?Inspired by how human utilize impression to recognize objects from blurry frames, we propose Impression Network that embodies a natural and efficient feature aggregation mechanism. In our framework, an impression feature is established by iteratively absorbing sparsely extracted frame features. The impression feature is propagated all the way down the video, enhancing features of low-quality frames. This impression mechanism makes it possible to perform long-range multi-frame feature fusion among sparse keyframes with minimum overhead. We demonstrate that Impression Network is significantly more accurate than per-frame detection baseline on ImageNet VID, while being 3 times faster (20 fps).

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Method in Infrared Image Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of difficult feature extraction and low detection accuracy of target detection technology under low visible light conditions, an improved YOLOv7 infrared image pedestrian detection algorithm is proposed. In the improved algorithm, the self-attention COT module is introduced to combine the adjacent local information of the convolution neural network with the global information of the Transformer to enhance the visual representation ability, and the SPPF module is introduced into the SPPCSPC to optimize it to obtain SPPFCSPC, reducing the number of parameters and calculation, so as to improve the detection speed while keeping the receptive field unchanged. The algorithm also introduces $\alpha$-IoU Loss to speed up convergence and improve detection accuracy. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, the data sets LLVIP and FLIR are compared with the mainstream algorithms YOLOv3 and YOLOv5. The experimental results show that the improved Yolov7 model has good detection accuracy and detection speed under low visible light conditions. On the data set LLVIP, the mAP is increased by 4.4% and 1.9% respectively. It also performs well on the dataset FLIR.

articleTitle: A Multi-level Parallel Tie-dye Algorithm for Auto-CFD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of high-performance computing and automatic mesh generation, large-scale Automatic Computational Fluid Dynamics (Auto-CFD) not only improves efficiency and reduces manual labor but also reduces industry barriers and expands application scope, which has urgent engineering needs. The preliminary work of the tie-dye algorithm has completed the qualitative analysis of its suitability for large-scale Auto-CFD applications, and there is an urgent need for algorithm breakthroughs and quantitative research in engineering. Aiming at the uniqueness of the tie-dye algorithm based on the unstructured finite difference method, after systematically analyzing and designing multiple aspects such as algorithm framework, data structure, partitioning strategy, topology mapping, and communication optimization, a multi-level parallel tie-dye algorithm (MPTD) for Auto-CFD is proposed in this paper. The correctness and performance tests of MP-TD for NACA0024 airfoil and car exterior shape were carried out on the Sugon supercomputer. The test data show that the MP-TD algorithm for Auto-CFD can input 2D CAD models or images, set relevant parameters, automatically generate CFD grids, and quickly complete flow field calculations without manual participation in geometry cleaning. The algorithm has good parallel efficiency and scalability, with a maximum parallel computing scale of 100 million grids and 7.84 million surface nodes, and up to 256 computing nodes.

articleTitle: IceDCST: A Dilated Convolutional Segmentation Transformer for Ice Crystals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Ice crystals are one of the key factors limiting the quality and efficiency of preserved biological materials. However, the current quantitative analysis of ice crystals is often performed by the subjective judgment of the experimental operator, which leads to subjective and error-prone experimental results. Therefore, in this paper, IceDCST is proposed for the semantic segmentation of ice crystals images for objective and accurate quantitative analysis of the ice crystal growth process.IceDCST designed Crossed Patch Merging to enable multi-scale features to be obtained while maintaining local information. Also, we designed Learable Location Information Module (LLI) to reduce the computational effort and introduce learnable location information. In addition, we design the Dilated Convolutional Block (DCB) to increase the perception of contextual spatial information. On the homemade ice crystals dataset, IceDCST performs best with 94.51% accuracy and 87.76 mIoU, which is 2.1% and 1.89 better than the accuracy and mIoU of the second-performing network, respectively. In this paper, the visualization results are analyzed and verified by quantitative analysis of ice crystals growth using IceDCST. The experimental results show that the quantitative analysis of ice crystals using IceDCST is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Target Analysis and Optimization Strategy of Peak Cutting and Valley Filling based on Actual Engineering Requirements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The peak of power grid load curve gradually increases, resulting in a serious imbalance between supply and demand of the power system, and the proportion of new energy generation is also rising rapidly. If not handled properly, it will also cause serious wind and light abandonment. At present, the problems to be solved are as follows: in the aspect of behavioral purpose, based on the actual engineering needs, how to understand the target of peak cutting and valley filling more reasonably; In the aspect of problem solving strategy, how to use the complementary characteristics of resources to cut peaks and fill valleys better. Based on this, this paper studies peak cutting and valley filling, proposes new understanding and indicators, and puts forward optimization strategy of peak cutting and valley filling based on indicators combined with flexible resources such as energy storage and adjustable load. Finally, an example analysis shows that the proposed model can better solve the original serious problems, and by comparing the cost, it is concluded that the strategy of peak cutting and valley filling can achieve better peak cutting and valley filling effects.

articleTitle: SAGAN: Maximizing Fairness using Semantic Attention Based Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this work, we present an end-to-end framework with a predictor model that provides classifier outputs from given input features and an adversary that tries to predict protected or sensitive features in order to mitigate intrinsic biases with respect to sensitive features (e.g., race, sex). Our proposed model increases the predictor’s capacity to produce correct predictions, while decreasing the adversary’s ability to anticipate sensitive features. We include a novel Semantic Attention (SA) module to the framework and demonstrate that our SA based Generative Adversarial Network (SAGAN) is able to significantly minimize the adversary’s capability to predict sensitive features, while retaining the predictor’s predictive accuracy. UCI Adult (Census) dataset was used a benchmark dataset for the testing. Our results demonstrate that the predictive model does not lose much accuracy, while achieving a Disparate Impact (DI) score very close to 1. The flexibility of the method makes it fitting to be applicable to a broad spectrum of gradient-based learning models, including both regression and classification tasks as well as different definitions of fairness. The source code for the implementation is available on github [1].

articleTitle: Design and simulation of a low pull-in voltage RF MEMS switch in series for X-band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Considering the demand for miniaturization of electronic precision components for 6G communication development, broadcasting satellite and radar communication, this paper proposes the structure of a Radio Frequency Micro-Electro-Mechanical-Systems (RF MEMS) switch in X (S-12GHz) band that operates on the basis of metal-to-metal contact configuration. The pull-in voltage is the main indicator of switch power consumption, and a great challenge for RF MEMS switch design is the conflict between high pull-in voltage and switch reliability. Therefore, this paper designs an RF MEMS switch with a spring-ring structure to reduce the pull-in voltage. The switch adopts the structure of multi-contact microstrip line and uses an electrostatic actuation approach to control the mechanical movement of the upper electrode plate, so as to achieve the purpose of switching the operating state of the switch. High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) electromagnetic simulation software is used to analyze the influence of each part of the switch parameters on the switch performance and optimize it. Meanwhile, the mechanical performance of the switch is analyzed by the finite element method using COMSOL mechanical simulation software. Furthermore, the optimized spring-ring switch shows an exceedingly low pull-in voltage of 1.43V. The switch is designed to operate only in X-band frequencies with insertion loss better than 0.17dB, which meets the requirements of RF active devices for RF MEMS switch performance. On the foundation of the standard surface micromachining process, a complete fabrication process based on the metal lift-off technology was designed using a bottom-up approach. The switch is convenient to integrate, highly reliable and has a simple manufacturing process, which is relevant in the research of new generation mobile communication devices.

articleTitle: Research on service-oriented communication technology supporting inter-regional information security interaction in substation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The method of sensing terminal information access of substation is proposed to cope with various terminal sensing equipment, security partition isolation transmission restrictions, complex information, and remote monitoring difficult problems at unattended substation. By deploying the edge IoT gateway, we achieved unified access to the terminal equipment based on the communication service mapping technology, instantiated collected data and modeled in E format, achieved the data requests transmitting to the lower level and the reverse transmission between the shutdown of data communication network and the edge of the Internet of things based on the edge of things agent technology and establish remote service communication system to realize plug in-and-function with the dispatching center data, instead of only relying on the traditional communication protocol and forwarding table monitoring mode, improve the equipment remote monitoring level and capacity for handling power grid accident emergency.

articleTitle: Application Of C4.5 Decision Tree Algorithm For Evaluating Research-Oriented Dual-Qualified Teacher
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on the integration of discipline knowledge among majors, education and research, the Profession Education Study Capability (PESC) system is proposed. The system includes 14 feature indexes and 2 evaluation indexes, and uses C4.5 algorithm for intelligent selection of teachers’ feature to build an evaluation model for research-oriented dual-qualified teacher. On the basis of capability assessment, the college carries out four-stage collaborative management for different types of teachers. There are some differences in the PESC level of teachers in higher vocational colleges. Teachers’ professional competence and educational capability are related to their research capability. After the implementation of the four-stage collaborative management, teachers’ PESC level is significantly improved. The capability assessment model for research-based dual-qualified teacher can comprehensively analyze the feature of teachers’ multiple abilities and effectively improve the problems existing in the positioning and development of teachers. Intelligent analysis method has important application value in the construction of teaching staff with complex personnel structure and difficult management.

articleTitle: BSPST:A classification algorithm based on shape transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of sensor components, a large number of time series have been generated by various sensors, and many time series classification (TSC) algorithms have been proposed to process these data. Among them, the algorithm based on hapelet attracts much attention because of its high accuracy and explanability. However, the high time complexity of the algorithm based on Shapelet and the poor quality of the selected Shapelet limit the accuracy and running time of the classification. This paper presents an improved time series classification algorithm based on Shapelet transformation (BSPST), which greatly reduces the time for Shapelet selection and greatly improves the quality of Shapelet discrimination. A high-quality set of candidate Shapelets is preserved to build classification models using Bloom filters and similarity matching. Data is converted using Shapelet conversion technology. Sufficient experimental validation was performed with 44 common datasets. Testing the classification accuracy and running time, experiments show that BSPST keeps a high accuracy and is significantly faster than the existing Shapelet selection algorithm. It effectively solves the problem of time series classification for a variety of sensor instruments.

articleTitle: Research on the rooftop photovoltaic business model of the whole county
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: China strongly supports distributed photovoltaic power generation, but subsidies are declining year by year. In order to explore the dependence of distributed rooftop PV projects on policy and their economic sustainability, firstly, the policy environment of distributed PV power generation is introduced, and the current situation of distributed PV development at home and abroad is studied, based on which two major types of business models are summarised, namely the centralised continuous development model and the user-built model; secondly, the economic efficiency index system of distributed rooftop PV is established, and an example of a distributed PV investment payback period and internal rate of return is measured for a distributed PV project in Gansu Province. Finally, a sensitivity analysis was conducted on the economics of the two business models and the key factors affecting the economic efficiency, based on which the impact of power generation revenue, feed-in tariff, investment cost and subsidies on the internal rate of return was analysed. The results show that under the current subsidy policy, investment cost and key factors, both business models show positive returns, with an average payback time of about 8 years, compared to the customer-built model, which provides a reference for the economics of distributed rooftop PV project investment and construction.

articleTitle: A K-means Clustering Method for Fuzzy Neighborhood Granules
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: K-means algorithm is a typical distance-based clustering analysis algorithm, and the neighborhood granular K-means clustering algorithm uses the neighborhood granulation technique on its basis to solve the problem of poor clustering of the K-means clustering algorithm on non-linear separable datasets. However, the use of neighborhood relations in the granulation lead to the inability of the algorithm to deal with outliers effectively, resulting in some samples being misclassified. By introducing the concept of fuzzy set and combining granular computing theory, a new neighborhood granular K-means clustering method is proposed, where samples are constructed using fuzzy neighborhood granularity technique to construct fuzzy neighborhood granules, and the membership between samples is used for neighborhood granularity instead of clear neighborhood relations, which reduces the impact of outliers. A new distance measure for fuzzy neighborhood granules is proposed based on the size and form of the fuzzy neighborhood granules, which reduces the computational complexity. In addition, the algorithm combines the idea of K Nearest Neighbor to define a neighborhood threshold metric that adaptively generates neighborhood thresholds for any data set. It considers the size of the data set objectively and reduces the subjective influence of manual selection of neighborhood threshold. Finally, the Accuracy and Fowlkes Mallows Index values of the algorithm are increased by 6.4 %, 9.21%, 3.5%, and 7.89% on the synthetic data set and UCI data set, respectively, and increased by 8.65% and 9.43% on the seismic facies lithology identification data set, respectively. The experimental results prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the fuzzy neighborhood granular K-means clustering method.

articleTitle: A Survey of Traditional and Machine Learning-based Malware Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Malware activities have become more and more frequent in recent years, and malware has become an essential threat in the field of network security. Malware detection technology has also received more and more attention. Since the machine learning method can effectively solve the classification problem in malware detection technology, the malware detection technology based on machine learning is gradually applied in various scenarios. This paper first summarizes the traditional malware detection technology, then introduces the classification and specific implementation methods of machine learning-based malware detection technology, and finally summarizes the problems faced by the current detection technology and expounds possible future research.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Adaptive Routing in Identification Self-organized Network Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Identification self-organized Network is a newly developed private self-organized network that utilizes identification network technology and imposes stricter requirements on differentiated quality of service guarantees. However, due to the highly dynamic changes of the network and the limited use of network resources, routing design for self-organized network presents significant challenges. The existing wireless self-organized network routing protocols are difficult to meet the requirements of the new private identification self-organized network for differentiated service quality assurance, as well as the requirements for low delay and low energy consumption. This paper proposes a new multi-objective adaptive routing protocol based on reinforcement learning for identification self-organized networks. The proposed protocol provides differentiated quality of service guarantees with low delay and low energy consumption for different link states. It adapts to dynamic network topology and resource constraints by designing a differentiated reward function and adaptively adjusting Q-learning parameters. The simulation results show that this method achieves lower delay, higher packet delivery rate, and lower energy consumption while ensuring differentiated service quality, as compared to the active routing DSDV protocol and on-demand routing AODV protocol.

articleTitle: Research on the influencing factors of LLVM IR optimization effect
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The intermediate representation has a natural advantage in solving the problem of cross-architecture binary code similarity detection, which can greatly reduce the amount of data required for machine learning model training and improve the versatility and scalability of the model. optimizing the intermediate representation can solve the problem of binary differences caused by different compilation architectures, compilers, optimization options, and obfuscation strategies, which is conducive to improving the accuracy of binary code similarity detection. We explored the effects of compilation architectures, compilers, optimization options and obfuscation strategies on the optimization of intermediate representations through four experiments. The experimental results show that the compilers GCC and Clang at the time of binary file compilation have a significant improvement on the optimization effect of intermediate representation. In addition, the optimization effect using opt-Ol and opt-O2 is the best, and the similarity can be improved by up to 21.7%. The compiler architectures XS6_32, XS6_64, ARM32, ARM64 and optimization options −OO, −Ol, −O2, −O3 have little effect on the optimization effect of the intermediate representation. The compiler architecture MIP32 and obfuscation strategies F1a, Sub, Bcf, All have a negative effect on the optimization effect of intermediate representation.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network for Prison Term Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Legal judgment prediction (LJP) is one of the most critical tasks in legal artificial intelligence. One of the most important subtasks is the prison term prediction, which aims to predict the term of the penalty based on the documents of the criminal case. Existing methods consider the problem of the prison term prediction either as a pure text classification problem or a pure text regression problem. The drawback of such approaches is that the accuracy of the prediction is largely affected by the imbalanced data which is due to the complicated distribution of the prison terms. Moreover, most existing methods fail to use the prior legal knowledge or fail to have a better representation of it that may enhance the interpretability of the methods. To address these issues, we construct a heterogeneous graph attention network (HGAT) with a multi-scale structure for the prison term prediction. Our method first takes sentencing elements as the input, which can be considered as the summaries of the information of the legal documents by legal experts. We then use the graph network as the basic module to represent the sentencing elements and to obtain the relationships between the groups of the sentencing elements. Most importantly, we propose a multi-scale structure, which essentially separates the prison term prediction problem into a classification problem of the time intervals and a regression problem of the accurate term. Since this structure decomposes the original complicated distribution of the prison terms into simple distributions, it effectively promotes the learning ability of the regression models and consequently improves the overall performance of the prediction. We conduct a series of experiments on the dataset of the crime of fraud in mainland China. The results demonstrate that our model can outperform most of the baselines and generate good robustness. In addition, in the classification problem, we find a good legal interpretation for the labels of the intervals when clustering the prison terms. This may enhance the interpretability of our method in the eyes of legal practitioners.

articleTitle: Class Distribution Pyramid Experts for Long-tailed Visual Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Deep long-tailed visual recognition is a challenging task due to its extreme imbalance in classes. Existing methods improve the overall performance by making a trade-off between head and tail classes. We conduct experiment find that in this way, not only the performance of the head classes is compromised, but also the performance of the tail classes is not maximized. Based on these observations, we propose Class Distribution Pyramid Experts(CDPE), a clean and simple framework for end-to-end training.T each expert are calculated by insta hrough the idea of divide and conquer, we maximize the representation of classes at different quantitative levels by different experts and further propose a novel instance-aware aggregation network that dynamically integrates the predictions of different experts. We conducted extensive experiments on CIFAR10/100-LT, ImageNet-LT and iNaturalist2018 datasets to demonstrate our method’s effectiveness, practicability, and state-of-the-art performance. We hope this simple method will motivate people to rethink the divide-and-conquer strategy in long-tailed visual recognition.

articleTitle: Power System Static Voltage Stability Risk Assessment Considering Load Type and Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a risk assessment method based on modeling of load type and uncertainty is proposed for power system steady operation analysis. Composite load model are equivalently transformed to incorporate the impact of load type into conductance matrix. Correlated fluctuation is investigated by fuzzy clustering method, and a load model is proposed to simulate uncertainty in loading trajectory from current operating state to the critical point. To determine load buses realistically, a comparability identify system including correlation coefficient and mutual information indexes is proposed. Above models are inserted into the continuation power flow algorithm combined with Monte Carlo method. The integrated risk assessment method is examined on 57 bus system. Risk ranking list and graphic results under different load types are presented and analyzed to verify validity and effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Wild mushroom classification based on improved MobileViT_v2
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Accidental ingestion of toxic or inedible wild mushrooms is very dangerous. Because identifying their species is a fine-grained classification problem, it is difficult to directly apply general deep learning classification methods to obtain excellent fine-grained classification results. For mobile application scenarios, MobileViT_v2 with characteristics of convolutional ViT blocks is selected as the basic network. In addition, lightweight coordinate attention (CA) blocks are inserted to enhance the ability of filtering local foreground areas and feature channels of the network. After the shallow local fine-grained features processed by SoftPool, skipping connections are introduced between blocks to achieve fusion with global semantic features of deep layers to help achieve fine-grained classification that pays more attention to local detail features. Experimental results show that the improved method can improve the classification accuracy of Top1 from 96.83% to 97.39%, and reduce the loss by about 10%, indicating stronger generalization ability. Moreover, our improved network outperforms typical lightweight and heavyweight ones (MobileNet_v3, ShuffleNet_v2, ResNet50 and ResNeXt50-32×4d etc.).

articleTitle: An NTRU-based Homomorphic Encrypted Data Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the current data processing systems, there exist widespread threats to the privacy of data providers. To solve the problems in privacy protection in data processing, this paper proposes a homomorphic encryption data analysis system-MeSec, which is based on NTRU cryptosystem. Firstly, MeSec constructs a new type of password-based authorized key exchange protocol (PAKE). Secondly, MeSec adopts a more efficient NTRU-based homomorphic encryption system. And respectively designs a federated learning scheme for encrypted distributed training models and a privacy machine learning prediction scheme whit the encrypted private data as inputs; finally, an effective multiuser agent NTRU-based re-encryption module is designed to realize safe and convenient data intercommunication and sharing between users, which completely breaks the barriers of data islands. This system can be widely used in various fields for data sharing, analysis, and processing.

articleTitle: Software and Hardware Platform Technology of Embedded Device Based on Heterogeneous SoC Chip in substation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to meet the demand of high-precision harmonic sampling in electronics power grid, and further improve the performance of secondary equipment such as substation measurement and control, PMU and broadband measurement, the application scenarios and performance requirements of high-performance hardware platform are analyzed, and the technical status of domestic chips in mass production is investigated. The hardware platform scheme of heterogeneous SoC chips is adopted, and the dual-system software architecture based on Linux and RTOS system is adopted, We have designed a large-capacity real-time data parallel processing and layered drive technology scheme, fully developed the computing potential of heterogeneous multi-core chips, improved the performance of hardware platform based on domestic chips, and completed the development and testing of the hardware platform of broadband measurement device prototype. Finally, the feasibility of the hardware platform technology scheme based on heterogeneous SoC chips is verified through the comparison of various performance tests.

articleTitle: Non-smooth High-precision Control of Drag-free Satellite for Space Gravitational Wave Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, the control mode and working requirements of the drag-free system are introduced. The dynamic model of drag-free satellite with single mass is established along the direction of the sensitive axis in the displacement mode, and the non-conservative forces acting on the satellite platform are analyzed. A continuous time-invariant non-smooth nonlinear state feedback control law is designed for the drag-free system with double integral characteristics, and the stability of the closed-loop system is proved based on Lyaponuv theory. The simulation results show that the non-smooth nonlinear control strategy similar to PD control can ensure the ultra-low bandwidth requirement proposed by the space gravitational wave detection mission while satisfying the high-precision control index requirement for the relative displacement and the residual disturbance acceleration of drag-free satellite platform.

articleTitle: Research on access control technology of big data cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the big data cloud computing environment, traditional access control technology is difficult to adapt to the access control of large-scale users to massive data. Aiming at the dynamic nature of big data resources, the wide range of sources, and distributed management, cloud computing has the characteristics of large-scale, sharing, openness, and scalability. First, it introduces big data cloud computing and access control technology from the perspective of big data cloud computing user roles and entity attributes, and compares the existing access control technology with user roles and entity attributes, and gives big data cloud computing access control Framework, proposed an access control model based on big data cloud computing, and finally from big data cloud computing identity provision, big data cloud computing authentication, big data cloud computing identity federation, attribute encryption access control, multiuser access mechanism, access control The system and cross-domain authorization mechanism expounds the big data cloud computing access control technology.

articleTitle: Gait Recognition Algorithm GCGait based on Skeleton
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To solve the problem of low accuracy of gait recognition in complex scenes, a novel skeleton-based gait recognition algorithm, GCGait, is proposed. Taking human posture as the input of gait feature, the interference caused by wearing changes and other factors is reduced. To extract sufficient input features, multi-branch input is used in the early stage of the model. By introducing the multi-attention mechanism, the network can learn the semantic information of the non-directly connected joints, excavate the most discriminative features from complex videos, and further improve the recognition performance. In order to reduce the influence of cross view, the fusion loss function is used in the experiment. Experimental results show that the average recognition rate of the proposed algorithm on the CASIA-B dataset is improved by 5.2%, and the average recognition accuracy on the OU-MVLP dataset is increased by 66.3%, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Indoor Positioning System Based on Improved Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the increasingly complex indoor environment nowadays, people still have high requirements for indoor positioning accuracy. Indoor positioning errors are mainly caused by signal band interference and non-line-of-sight. In the face of frequency band interference, this paper chose Ultra-Wide-Band signal as the positioning basis. Deal with the non-line-of-sight, this paper proposed an indoor positioning system based on improved Kalman filter, which reduces the new error caused by Kalman filter in complex scene conversion and improves the positioning accuracy. The system used five or more base stations for positioning, and selected the CHAN algorithm, which is sensitive to positioning errors, to solve the initial position. Residual processing was performed on the initial position and the positions of each base station to generate a credible factor, and then different confidence regions were divided according to the factor. For different confidence regions, the Kalman filter gain coefficient K was pre-set to improve the stability of the positioning results for frequent transitions between line-of-sight and non-line-of-sight scenes. The experimental results show that the system can reduce the error to 80cm in the simulation environment. And in actual scenes, it can reduce to 60cm.

articleTitle: EV Charging Navigation Strategy based on Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As a kind of distributed energy, electric vehicle (EV) has the characteristics of both vehicle and mobile load, and its large-scale disordered charging navigation will have a huge impact on the power grid and traffic road network. Therefore, an EV-based charging navigation strategy is proposed. Firstly, according to the topological characteristics of the traffic network and the practical speed-flow relationship model, the traffic characteristics of electric vehicles under the road network constraints are simulated, and then the starting node and destination node of electric vehicles are obtained by the OD analysis method. Then, based on the evolutionary game, a charging navigation optimization model considering the charging capacity of electric vehicles, the charging station queuing model and the charging station selection strategy is established. Finally, taking the transportation network and its distribution system with 10 charging stations in the central part of a city as an example, the numerical simulation is carried out to analyze the impact of different pricing strategies of charging stations on the power grid, transportation network, charging station revenue and user costs during the rapid charging of large-scale electric vehicles. The results verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Moving Object Detection and Recognition Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the deep learning detection framework based on video moving object detection cannot make full use of the motion information of the upper and lower frames, and the computational complexity is high, an improved SSD detection algorithm is proposed. The algorithm uses the lightweight network MobileNet as the basic network in the SSD model to reduce the time and computation spent in extracting image features, and establish the correlation between frames. Based on the Tensorflow deep learning framework, training is carried out on COCO (Common Objects in Context) dataset, and comparative experiments on moving object recognition accuracy and recognition speed are carried out. Experimental results show that the algorithm has good performance in terms of detection accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: FAS-reid: Fair Architecture Search for Person Re-IDentification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The development of deep learning has driven the development of ReID, and more and more excellent methods have been proposed, but most of these are artificially designed network backbones. Automation is a trend in the development of deep learning. This paper propose FAS-ReID(Fair Architecture Search for Person Re-IDentification), which can automatically design and generate a neural network backbone for ReID. This paper compare operation selection to competition, and inject noise to make the competition fairer, while making the architecture of automated search More adaptable to ReID We use TriHard loss to improve the feature extraction ability. Our experiments show that the backbone searched by FAS-ReID is better and reduces the search time. Meanwhile, as for the problem of performance collapse caused by skip-connection enrichment in the search process, FAS-Reid does not use the early stop strategy to avoid performance loss like other solutions, which is also the reason why our method is more reliable and robust.

articleTitle: Economic dispatch of power system based on neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the absorption of new energy and quickly solve the economic dispatching problem of the power system, this paper uses neural network algorithm to build a neural network model framework to solve the unit power generation plan, cluster the load forecasting data and photovoltaic power generation data, use the improved six-node system to construct a data set, train the neural network algorithm, and finally verify the accuracy of the algorithm, providing a basis for the framework requirements in the actual project.

articleTitle: A Wireless Animal Robot Stimulation System based on Neuronal Electrical Signal Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As a stimulus signal, coded electrical signals can control the motion behavior of animals, which has been widely used in the field of animal robots. In current research, most of the stimulus signals used by researchers are traditional waveform, such as square waves. To enrich the stimulus waveform, a wireless animal robot stimulation system based on neuronal electrical signal characteristics is presented in this paper. The stimulator uses the CC1101 wireless module to control animal behavior through brain stimulation. The LabVIEW-based graphical user interface(GUI) can manipulate brain stimulation remotely while the stimulator powered by battery. Additionally, the spikes of animals have been simulated by this system through Direct Digital Synthesizer(DDS) algorithm. The GUI enable users to customize the combination of these analog spike signals. The recombined signals are sent to the stimulator through CC1101 as stimulus signals. In vivo experiments conducted on five pigeons verified the efficacy of the stimulation mechanism. The analog spike signal with an amplitude of 3-5V successfully caused the pigeon’s turning behavior. The feasibility of the analog spike signals as stimulus signals was successfully verified. Increased the diversity of stimulus waveform in the field of animal robots.

articleTitle: Research on Testing Technology of Embedded Processor Cache Controller in Programmable SoC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the progress of Integrated Circuit technology and the multiple needs of human for scalar and reconfigurable operations in intelligent electronic system, a new chip architecture combining traditional FPGA and embedded processor appears, namely programmable SoC. Programmable SoC products have been widely used in mission and safety-critical applications, but production defects in hardware and time-related defects in the working process often lead to system misbehavior, which leads to disastrous consequences. Therefore, in view of the long-term reliability application requirements of programmable SoC products, it is necessary to carry out relevant research on its in-field test technology. In this paper, we will use the Software-Based Self Test (SBST) method to explore and implement the function of data cache controller for Zynq-7000 series Programmable SoC embedded processors (Enable\Disable, Invalidate, Clean) test technology research. By making full use of the fully programmable features of hardware and software resources in Zynq-7000, we have respectively realized the test generation technology based on PS and the test observation technology based on PL, and designed the prototype test system. Finally, the experimental results show that the prototype test system meets our expectations and can realize the in-field test of the cache controller of the embedded processor in the Zynq-7000 series programmable SoC. At the end of this paper, we summarize the work done and look forward to the future research direction.

articleTitle: Multi-strategy Adaptive Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Whale optimization Algorithm (WOA) is a metaheuristic algorithm proposed based on the simulation of the hunting behavior of whales. It has advantages such as simplicity and few adjustable parameters. However, WOA suffers from insufficient exploration and exploitation abilities in the later stage of iteration, resulting in low solution accuracy and a tendency to get trapped in local optima. In response to the shortcomings of WOA, including slow convergence speed, low accuracy, inadequate global exploration ability, and a tendency to get trapped in local optima, an improved Whale optimization Algorithm (MSIWOA) is proposed. Firstly, a nonlinear decreasing mechanism for iteration number is designed to balance the global search and local exploitation abilities. Additionally, a Cauchy mutation mechanism is introduced to improve the problem of low convergence accuracy and avoid getting trapped in local optima. The effectiveness of the MSIWOA algorithm is tested on 19 widely used test functions, and the results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm has better performance than traditional WOA and other improved algorithms, proving the effectiveness of the MSIWOA algorithm.

articleTitle: Systematic Construction and Application of Intelligent Teaching Environment in Medical Colleges
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Smarter learning plays an important role in promoting the reform of higher education and teaching. This paper first analyzes the problems of intelligent teaching in the field of medical education. On the basis of the current campus learning environment, a more systematic, comprehensive and interrelated intelligent teaching environment is constructed, and the intelligent teaching mode is explored, which provides favorable software and hardware conditions for better network teaching in medical colleges and universities in the future, and makes the intelligent teaching research in the medical field more accurate and in-depth. Teaching behavior pays more attention to the reasonable connection between theory and practice.

articleTitle: An Acne Detector for Skin Image Based On Attention Enhanced Feature Pyramid Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Automatic acne detection can help people more quickly detect acne disease. At present, most of the researches are based on two-stage detectors, and the researches based on single-stage detectors are very few. However, smaller and faster models are required in practical applications. In this paper, we build a faster and more accurate acne detection model based on YOLOX. First, we propose an Attention Enhanced Feature Pyramid Network (AEFPN) to improve the efficiency and quality of feature fusion. It works by controlling the delivery of feature information and using attention. Then, we propose a stronger data augmentation strategy named MixAug, which uses Copy-Paste and Mixup by turning with a certain probability to make the model converging faster and the training curve smoother. In addition, to assign higher quality samples for small objects, we use Normalized Wasserstein Distance to improve the label assignment strategy called Simplified Optimal Transport Assignment (SimOTA). Finally, we conducted a number of experiments on the AcneSCU dataset. The results demonstrate the proposed method could improve the performance of YOLOX in acne detection, allowing YOLOX to increase 2.62% average precision (AP). At the same time, it can effectively improve the convergence speed of the model. Our model is superior to the current research in model size, detection speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Image-Point Cloud Bidirectional Fusion Network towards 3D Object Detection in Self-Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rise of self-driving, the fusion technology of image and point cloud is widely used in the perception system of unmanned vehicles to overcome the limitation of single modal data. As a task in the field of multimodal data fusion, image and point cloud fusion is challenged by dimension gap and data density difference. Research efforts in recent years have focused on ROI-based fusion or fine-grained pixel-point fusion approaches that have not achieved significant performance gains. This paper considers that the most important factor limiting the fusion effect is that 2D image features are difficult to align with the point cloud features in 3D space. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes to use the depth completion model to convert 2D pixels into pseudo point clouds in 3D space, and designs a bidirectional fusion mechanism based on 3D sparse convolutional network to realize the exchange of two modal information between image and point cloud branches. In this paper, the proposed fusion network is applied to the 3D object detection framework, and the experimental comparison is carried out on KITTI dataset. The experimental results show that our network performs better than most existing fusion works.

articleTitle: Design of A New Energy Regulation Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The new energy control terminal presents the distributed energy power station as a large-capacity unit to the dispatching center, making it adjustable and controllable. It is a bridge for the dispatching center to realize friendly control of the distributed energy power station, effectively improving the acceptance capacity of the grid to the distributed energy, and realizing the continuous regulation and coordinated control of the active/reactive power of the distributed energy. The new energy control terminal is composed of core main control, power supply system, IO board, local communication board, metering board and Ethernet communication board. The operating environment of the system software is the Linux operating system, which only involves the application part. The peripheral interfaces (DI, OUT, net, wifi, Loar, RS485, RS232, etc.) are assembled by module plugging, adapting to the design concept of “plug and play”. The new energy regulation terminal is the edge device of the “cloud management edge” architecture of the intelligent Internet of Things system. It needs to have the functions of information collection, storage, analysis and calculation, and forwarding to achieve the purpose of energy regulation.

articleTitle: Design of a Polyphase Parallel DDS Waveform Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to meet the flexible signal generation requirements of modern radar systems, a polyphase parallel Direct Digital Synthesizer (DDS) waveform generator was designed. This paper includes the principle and simulation of linear frequency modulation signal (LFM). Then introducing the design method of circuit and testing it. The circuit uses Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) and high-speed Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) as the hardware platform. With the chips programmable function, the generated waveform has the characteristics of adjustable parameters and large bandwidth. The parallel structure of the circuit reduces the processing clock and adapt to the high sampling clock. The waveform generator has been applied to practical projects in different fields because of its general function.

articleTitle: Design of Radio-frequency Power Supply System for Low Temperature Plasma Medical Surgery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a design scheme of radiofrequency power supply system for medical operation with low temperature plasma is proposed, and its feasibility is verified by a prototype. The system is mainly composed of controller, Electromagnetic compatibility and input current correction, phase-shift full-bridge voltage regulator, working capacitor charge and discharge, high-frequency half-bridge power conversion, output and other submodules. The controller module is composed of CPU and FPGA. Two functional modes of cutting and coagulation are designed, each of which has 10 power gears. During operation, the controller obtains the gears of cutting and coagulation modes through the control screen, monitors the state of electric scalpel button or foot switch, and periodically adjusts the power at all levels according to the state changes. The scalpel designed to achieve 800W/1MHz sine wave stable output, cutting and coagulation function test on pork skin, the function is normal, to achieve the expected design objectives, to provide a reference for further practical application of this kind of RF power supply.

Author Keywords: Radio-frequency power supply for medical surgery

articleTitle: Research and Design of a Remote Bionic Signature Robot based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the context of the COVID-19 pandemic and special scenarios, the normalization of online work, office and learning has brought the issue of digital signature to be solved. This paper presents an innovative research on a remote biomimetic signature robot based on IoT, utilizing Raspberry Pi 4B and single-chip microcomputer as the core devices. This project mainly consists of three modules: client module, server module, and transmission module. The client module designs the client app using the Vue framework, supporting component-based and module-based development. The server module adopts embedded development with single-chip microcomputer and Raspberry Pi. The transmission module develops a new algorithm suitable for this project by learning sha1, md5, base64 and other algorithms, and using secure encryption algorithms and data destruction to ensure the data security of the signature robot, avoiding data leakage and tampering issues. After testing, the remote signature robot is reliable and practical. Through this project, not only has the theoretical and practical ability of university students been strengthened, but also their self-learning ability and application innovation ability have been expanded, and their social service awareness has been enhanced, laying a solid foundation for their future career development.

articleTitle: Two-stage processing of image restoration problem based on generative adversarial network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that texture details and edge information of images are easily lost in the process of image recovery, a two-stage processing algorithm is proposed that combines denoising processing and super-resolution reconstruction processing. The algorithm is divided into two stages, the first stage uses the improved DEGAN network to denoise the image, and the training set and the test set are denoising the training set and the test set respectively through the optimal path obtained by training, and the result is directly transferred to the dataset for the second stage of super-resolution processing. In the second stage, the denoising training set is reconstructed with the improved SRGAN network, and a clean image dataset with the noise processing needs to be added as the target image for super-resolution processing. Compared with single denoising and super-resolution reconstruction, the images recovered by two-stage training processing have significantly improved subjective perception and objective evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Research on Identification Method for Electricity User of Agricultural Irrigation and Drainage Based on Feature Fusion and Voting Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the work of "converting Power consumption into electricity consumption" carried out by the auxiliary water conservancy department, it is necessary to accurately identify the agricultural irrigation and drainage users on the power side, so as to improve the accuracy of converting power consumption into water consumption. For this reason, this paper, using big data analysis technology based on the daily 96 point load data of power users, proposes an intelligent identification method for agricultural irrigation and drainage users. This method is based on 96 point load data of agricultural irrigation and non agricultural irrigation users that have been manually labeled and 30 important features are screened and constructed. In addition, automatic generation tool of time series features (Tsfresh) is applied to help improve the identification accuracy of agricultural irrigation and drainage users. By the characteristics and training results of multiple classification models of RF, XGBoost, KNN, SVC, validation work has been carried out in some regions of Xinjiang. The results show that the classification model based on feature fusion and voting strategy has the highest accuracy in the comparative analysis among various methods, which verifies the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Research on network resource sharing based on distributed ledger technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Network resource sharing needs more flexible and efficient for diversified services with the rapid evolution of 5G network and IoT technology, the current sharing cannot support highly decentralized resource collaboration and sharing. In this paper, we proposed a solution to establish a sharing ecosystem by DLT, and research the relationship and activities of roles in this ecosystem. Based on these, we research the general framwork of network resource sharing based on DLT and give the scenarios and application by using it.

articleTitle: Research on Closed loop Control of Steering Angle for Intelligent Patrol Wheeled Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper uses the optimized PID control algorithm to realize the angle control of the intelligent patrol wheeled robot. Because the servo motor control mode used is the absolute value type, each control only needs to give the absolute speed value required by the motor servo control, not the speed increment value, so the optimized position type PID control algorithm is used as the calculation method of output control. This method designs the lateral distance deviation control, steering closed-loop control, acceleration and deceleration control through the navigation control of the intelligent patrol wheeled robot, and realizes the lateral deviation control in the navigation process of the intelligent patrol wheeled robot and the dynamic acceleration and deceleration control when the speed changes. In order to test the navigation accuracy of the navigation system, this paper also conducts navigation experiments under the simulation environment of the intelligent patrol wheeled robot, which verifies the effectiveness of the navigation algorithm.

articleTitle: Inexact Alternating Direction Method for Variational Inequality Problems with Second-order Cone Double Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, we apply the inexact alternating direction method to solve variational inequality problems with second-order cone double constraints. Under certain conditions, the implied equation in the inexact ADM method is semi-smooth, and we use the semismooth Newton method to solve this equation. Finally, this paper provides three numerical examples and verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of this algorithm by comparing it with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Hidden structural detection practice of coal mine re-mining working face
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Hidden structure in coal mine working face is an important hidden danger affecting safety production, and it is also a difficult technical problem to identify, Mine borehole logging analyzer is a comprehensive borehole logging device for underground drilling, which can quickly complete the work of video, natural gamma ray, trajectory data acquisition in underground coal mine at one time, Ground processing software can process data efficiently, and automatically derive the results of borehole trajectory plane map, borehole trajectory profile map and video core map, etc. By using underground drilling and mine borehole logging technology, the occurrence of coal seams and faults in No. 42224 mining face of Chaijiagou Coal Mine determined by trench wave seismic exploration was analyzed, the concealed structure of the working face was basically identified, and the high efficiency and practicability of the technology in detecting concealed structure were verified, which provides a strong technical support for mine safety production.

articleTitle: Solar Investment Decision Application System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of photovoltaic new energy industry, more and more investors have started to invest in photovoltaic projects. In order to help investors make wise investment decisions, a photovoltaic investment decision-making application system based on big data technology has been designed. This system uses temperature sensors, humidity sensors, light sensors, and power sensors in the equipment layer to obtain environmental data around photovoltaic solar panels, and uses NBIOT wireless network in the communication layer to transmit the data to the service layer. The service layer connects to the Web server cluster to access components and transfers the environmental data to modules such as big data encryption, parsing, and offline storage control. The system utilizes big data technology to encrypt, parse, and store the data offline, and then transfers the data to the application layer. The application layer provides data management and query functions for investors, making it easier for them to manage and query photovoltaic investment decision-making terminal data. The system has also undergone experimental testing, and the results show that the system can collect, network, and remotely transmit operating data of distributed photovoltaic solar panels. It can also provide remote access and control of data through a computer or mobile client. This system can help investors consider the impact of different geographical environments and seasonal climates on equipment, thereby making better investment decisions.

articleTitle: ERNCLS: A Cross-Lingual Text Summarization Model Integrating Entity Relation Extraction Task
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The current research on generative cross-lingual summarization models mainly adopts the framework of seq2seq, where entity relation errors are inevitable. How to reduce the occurrence of errors and improve the accuracy of summary generation needs to be addressed urgently. In this regard, we try to add the task of extracting entity relations as an auxiliary task in the Chinese-to-English cross-lingual text summarization model to reduce the entity relation errors in the summaries, and propose two fusion strategies for merging the auxiliary task. In addition, we also adjust the dataset for this task. The experiment proves that it is effective to reduce errors as well as improve the performance of cross-lingual text summarization model by merging the auxiliary task of extracting entity relations in the way of splicing summaries and entity relation triples as real labels of training sets.

articleTitle: Intelligent Classification Algorithm of the Big Data Platform for Urban and Rural Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The rapid development of big Chinese data and occupy an important position in urban and rural planning. Big data platforms have rooted urban and rural planning in many cities and counties, and people’s lifestyles and consumption have changed accordingly. The convolutional neural network method is used in this paper to plan land quickly and accurately. In this paper, ample data information of geographic information is processed to plan urban and rural land rationally, and the overall classification precision is 85.77%, which is of great significance to the utilization of natural resources and the harmony between man and nature.

articleTitle: A Survey of Green Development Level for Logistics Enterprises based on Likert Scale using the R Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With economic globalization and high-speed commodity circulation, logistics industry has become a pillar industry of modern society. Taking the path of green development is objective requirements for logistics enterprises to improve the market competitiveness, and is also an important social responsibility of logistics enterprises. In this paper, we first read extensive literature on green logistics and used technical methods to determine 16 key indicators, then made a 7-point Likert scale, distributed and collected 635 questionnaires. Among the valid 606 questionnaires, we used R language to visualize and analyze the data such as density distribution, heat map, and histogram, which revealed the pattern of the survey data and laid the foundation for the next step of principal component analysis, factor analysis, and regression analysis.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Wireless Sensor Network based on CC2530
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As an important part of the Internet of Things, wireless sensor network has attracted wide attention in intelligent sensors and radio monitoring. As a new short-range wireless communication standard, ZigBee technology has been widely studied and applied recently with the improvement of its standards. This paper aims to study the design and implementation of wireless sensor network based on CC2530. The wireless sensor network designed in this paper takes CC2530 as the wireless forwarding module, cooperating with the sensor signal acquisition and editing module, wireless controller, wireless hot spot (AP) and the upper position computer to realize the sensor signal acquisition and editing and data wireless transmission. Starting from the research background of this topic, this paper first introduces the current situation of wireless research and the current common wireless technology at home and abroad, and then introduces in detail Wi-Fi as a major field of wireless communication, involving related indicators and wireless networking technology. The main content of the article is wireless networking, hardware circuit design and module and upper computer software design. The hardware part is mainly for the selection and layout of the components related to the wireless forwarding module. The software part mainly includes the writing of the wireless forwarding module program and the module control and data sending and receiving software used by the upper computer. The main development part of the wireless forwarding module is the writing of UART interrupt program, the wireless transmission of signal data based on TCP / IP protocol, and the reception and judgment of commands issued by the upper computer, and the upper computer program is adopted. Written in the C language, using Socket programming, to realize the control of the wireless forwarding module and data reception and storage. Subsequently, the system was partially tested and generally tested, and the emerging problems were analyzed and solved. Finally, all the work is summarized, and the next step plan is put forward.

articleTitle: Design of a Non-destructive Testing System based on Terahertz Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Terahertz waves, electromagnetic waves possessing frequencies that fall within the range of 0.1 THz to 10 THz and wavelengths that span between 0.03 mm to 3 mm, have found their utility in various applications. It is, therefore, self-evident that the significance and imperative nature of deploying terahertz technology for non-destructive testing (NDT) cannot be overlooked. This article aims to acquaint the reader with a terahertz-based NDT system that comprises two parts, namely the hardware system and the software system, and explicate the operation principle of the system. Having successfully built the terahertz NDT system, diverse samples were subjected to testing. The results of these experiments reveal the suitability of the system for the inspection of different materials. In addition, surface imaging of composite structures was also performed, demonstrating the efficiency and precision of the terahertz NDT system in NDT. Consequently, the system presents a viable solution for the application of terahertz technology in the domain of NDT.

articleTitle: Micro-service anomaly detection based on second-order nearest neighbor
