publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: It is a very challenging task to analyze complex data sets. The technology of detecting outliers in data plays an important role in this task Clustering is the most commonly used method in the increasingly popular anomaly detection technology In this paper, an anomaly detection algorithm based on second-order nearest neighbor is proposed, which mainly includes two stages: clustering and anomaly detection In the process of clustering, the similarity matrix is obtained by the second order nearest neighbor method; In the process of anomaly detection, according to the relationship between the points in the cluster and the center of the cluster, the distance between all points in each cluster generated by the cluster and the center of the cluster is calculated to capture the anomaly state, and the density of each data point is taken into account to exclude the cluster boundary The use of the second order nearest neighbor makes the locality and globality of the data be considered at the same time, thus reducing the number of clusters obtained by clustering and increasing the accuracy of anomaly detection The experimental results show that it has certain feasibility and engineering application value.

articleTitle: An EMI suppression method for power wireless private network based on ICA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the particularity of power monitoring system, power communication and data network, the civil public communication information network is difficult to meet the requirements, so the construction of power wireless private network becomes increasingly important. In order to ensure that the power wireless private network can continue to provide basic services in the complex electromagnetic environment, anti-interference measures need to be considered. Therefore, this paper proposes an EMI suppression method based on independent component analysis algorithm for power wireless private network. This method first separates the background noise, then detects the EMI, and finally suppresses the EMI, and verifies the effectiveness of the method through experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Railway Electric Safety Production and Dispatching Command System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The electric safety production and dispatching command system records real-time equipment alarm information, dynamic environmental monitoring information and other historical data information, etc., and transmits it to the dispatching command center, providing data analysts and safety management personnel with a variety of field equipment status data, which can scientifically and orderly and effectively deal with various hidden dangers to ensure the good use of electrical equipment. This paper constructs a complete scheduling system by combining the data monitoring methods of various signal equipment with the safety production system, and adding the emergency handling function of scheduling. The system can timely deal with and overcome possible equipment defects, eliminate the failure in the early stage, realize the safe production management of the workshop and team in the pipeline, standardize the operation process according to the existing rules and regulations, improve the standardization of work quality, and then improve the quality of equipment.

Author Keywords: electric safety production and dispatching command system

articleTitle: Comprehensive analysis of life trajectory information of protection equipment based on Apriori algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper studies the correlation between the life trajectory information of protection equipment and key indicators of equipment, and comprehensively analyzes the life trajectory information of protection equipment. Research on accurate and efficient visualization technology of equipment life trajectory information, comprehensively display the panoramic information of protection equipment, and provide technical support for equipment operation and maintenance, maintenance and technical transformation. According to the basic attributes, behavioral characteristics and evaluation labels of the protection equipment, the Apriori algorithm is used to study the correlation between the life trajectory information of the protection equipment and the key indicators of the equipment, and comprehensively analyze the behavior characteristics of different stages of the whole life cycle of the protection equipment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Cement Production Control Information Integrated Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the control system of cement production has more single link control, and the production process, output, quality and other data lack of integration, so that a large number of data can not be used reasonably. This paper uses OPC technology, database technology, Web Service and other web client development technology, combined with cement control system and cement production technology, the cement production control system information integration and management. The integrated management system is divided into three parts: data acquisition module, database module and client function module. It has the functions of data integration, data monitoring and analysis. It realizes the effective management and utilization of the data information in the cement production control system.

articleTitle: Construction of deep mining and analysis system for science and technology information resources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Starting from intelligence information resources, through intelligence analysis and synthesis to determine scientific research topics, and then carry out scientific research, it is very meaningful to save the time of scientific researchers, expand and upgrade technology, etc. through intelligence activities. Starting from the deep mining and analysis system construction of scientific and technological information resources, the paper analyzes the current situation of domestic and foreign intelligence information system research in turn, and comprehensively discusses the strategic significance of the research. On this basis, it tries to build an intelligence information system and discusses the relevant research contents and key technologies of the platform. This provides some inspiration for the deep mining of scientific and technological information resources and the construction of the analysis system.

articleTitle: Research on The Design and Application of Visual Navigation Control for Patrol Wheeled Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The traveling speed of inspection wheeled robot is always constant in the visual navigation process, that is, the inspection wheeled robot is always traveling at a constant speed in the lateral position deviation control process. In order to make the inspection wheeled robot approach navigation line towards the side where navigation line is located in the case of position deviation, and constantly correct the error during driving, it is necessary to design a visual navigation control algorithm according to the proportional link control mechanism in PID. In this paper, firstly, proportional control is used as the deviation control method for visually guiding the inspection wheeled robot to navigation line, and its control effect is analyzed. Then, the influence of heading angle on the driving error trend is analyzed, and then the visual control function is designed, and the designed connection function is used to connect the control function in segments, so as to realize the lateral deviation control of the inspection wheeled robot in the visual navigation process and the dynamic acceleration and deceleration control when the speed changes.

articleTitle: Decision-making for Overtaking in Specific Unmanned Driving Scenarios based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Overtaking decision control in unmanned driving is a current research hotspot. Overtaking operations can improve driving efficiency, but blindly overtaking may cause traffic accidents. A critical issue is how to perform overtaking decisions in a specific driverless scenario safely. In this paper, based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) deep reinforcement learning algorithm, this paper establishes an end-to-end overtaking decision control model with continuous action output. The model uses low-cost sensors to obtain input state information (such as vehicle speed, position, road angle, etc.) and directly output vehicle action information (steering, acceleration, braking). The results show that the model can achieve end-to-end unmanned overtaking by training and testing the vehicle to complete the overtaking task in the TORCS (The Open Racing Car Simulator) platform environment. Finally, our work compared with the Deep Q-learning Network (DQN) overtaking model with discrete action output, and the experimental results show that the DDPG overtaking model has a better overtaking decision control effect.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Window System by Wind-light Complementary Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of society and electronic technology, the market for intelligent window is expanding owing to the people’s demands for home intelligent appliances. In order to address the inconvenience caused by traditional mechanical windows, an intelligent window system with wind-light complementary power supply is designed. The system can collect the real-time state data of the environment. The MCU can process the data to control the complementary window which will been widely used in the future.

articleTitle: Helmet Detection Algorithm Based on Transformable Attention and Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To solve the problem of whether workers wear helmets or not on the actual construction site, this paper proposes a helmet detection algorithm based on the integration of transformable attention and feature fusion. Since the hard hat is a small target, and the feature extraction is susceptible to background information interference and other factors, this paper proposes the TAM-YOLOv5 (Transformable Attention Mechanism-YOLOv5) detection model to detect whether workers wear the hard hat in the actual scene. Then, the detected head-and-shoulder Figure is binary classified in the Double branch-ResNet classification model. To determine whether the worker is wearing a helmet. The transformable attention mechanism is added to TAM-YOLOv5 based on the original YOLOv5 detection model, which will pay more attention to the feature information between channels and spatial positions. To solve the problem of inadequate feature extraction, feature fusion is added to the Double branch-ResNet model to enhance the expression ability of safety hat features. In addition, due to the diversity of safety helmets, this paper introduces mutual channel loss in terms of loss function to enhance the fine-grained classification between safety helmets. In this paper, the proposed algorithm is fully tested, and the results show that the algorithm has improved the recall and accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Abnormal Measurement of Power Meter under Critical Load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A company uses 220kV double-circuit line for power supply. Due to the no-load operation of the power supply line, the load state is critical capacitive load, which leads to the abnormal measurement of three-phase four-wire intelligent electric energy meter. This paper analyzes in detail the factors such as no-load operation of the power supply line, critical capacitive load, voltage mutual inductor and current transformer error mismatch, which causes the negative power factor, negative power, negative current and other metering anomalies occur, and corresponding measures are proposed to prevent them.

articleTitle: A Personalized Movie Recommendation System Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to alleviate the problems of low accuracy, poor interpretability and data sparsity of movie recommendation system, this paper simultaneously considers movie attribute information and user-movie interaction information, and proposes a personalized movie recommendation algorithm based on knowledge graph, referred to as KGCFR (Knowledge Graph Collaborative Filtering Recommendation) algorithm. On the one hand, the movie knowledge graph is constructed by using the relationship between movies and movie attributes, and the relationship between movies is extracted. The user preference is calculated by the KGCFR model. On the other hand, the user preference is calculated by the collaborative filtering algorithm using the interaction information between movies and users. Finally, the recommendation list is obtained by combining the above two aspects, and the Top-K recommendation is performed according to the recommendation list. The experimental results show that the proposed method has a significant improvement in the accuracy of the recommendation effect, and has better interpretability and alleviates the data sparsity problem.

articleTitle: Time-variable Weight Forecasting Method in Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the arrival of the era of power big data, higher requirements are put forward for the accuracy of power load forecasting. Accurate power load forecasting is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of the power system and to reduce the cost. According to the characteristics of different types of short-term user loads showing different load operation laws in different periods of time, different forecasting methods are adopted in different periods of timewithin the daily range. According to the applicable characteristics of the model, different weights are given in different periods, so that it can reflect the forecasting effect of each single model in different periods of time, and use this weight for combined forecasting. The simulation results show that the accuracy of load forecasting can be effectively improved by considering the characteristics of load behavior in different time periods.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on High Quality Development of Agriculture Driven by Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The vigorous development of digital economy has brought new opportunities to the high-quality development of agriculture. Based on combing domestic and foreign literature related to digital economy and high-quality agricultural development, the article constructs an indicator system of digital economy and high-quality agricultural development level, takes 12 prefecture-level cities in Hubei Province as research objects, uses entropy value method to calculate their digital economy development level and high-quality agricultural development level, analyzes the driving effect of digital economy on high-quality agricultural development, and puts forward corresponding countermeasure suggestions to promote the high-quality development of agriculture in China.

articleTitle: Cable Channel Fire Monitoring Method Based On Photoacoustic Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of urban scale, the proportion of cable lines in urban distribution network is increasing, but the maintenance and monitoring of cable channels are generally difficult, which makes it impossible to effectively monitor the fire in cable channels. Photoacoustic spectrum monitoring technology has the characteristics of sensitive detection, high accuracy and convenient installation, which provides a new research idea for realizing cable channel fire monitoring. Combining the high sensitivity and high accuracy of photoacoustic spectroscopy monitoring technology, this paper realizes the accurate identification and location of cable channel fire, and improves the power supply reliability of distribution network.

articleTitle: Research of Willingness to Use Digital Currency in International Shipping — based on Operations Research Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: International shipping is an important part of the digital economy. Digital RMB is essential to promote national economic development and paperless development. In this study, SOR theory and perceived value model were integrated to construct an influencing factor model for using digital RMB. The innovation of this paper lies in the use of structural equation model to verify the influence path of assumptions and variables, and analyze the condition configuration that affects willingness to use digital currency from the perspective of factor combination. The empirical results show that the stimulus variables positively affect the willingness to use digital RMB through perceived usefulness. The desire to use digital RMB is negatively affected by perceived risk.

articleTitle: Recognition of Tomato Leaf Diseases and Insect Pests Based on Multi-channel Parallelism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: It is reported that more than 300 million people are currently suffering from or facing the risk of severe food insecurity, and the detection and diagnosis of diseases and insect pests is one of the most challenging research areas in the agricultural field and has been highly valued. Traditional disease detection methods rely on extracting manual features from acquired images to identify infection types. Furthermore, the performance of these works is entirely dependent on the nature of the selected manual features. This can be solved by automatically learning features through Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). This paper presents a convolutional neural network called ToNet that uses two different dimensionality reduction structures for detecting infection types on tomato leaves. Experiments were carried out using 10 types of tomato leaves from the PlantVillage Dataset. The images were normalized and input into the neural network, and compared with several classic convolutional neural networks. Comparing several different activation functions, it is found that the accuracy of using Mish activation function is the highest. The experimental results show that, the proposed model can achieve a test accuracy of 95.96%.

articleTitle: An Auxiliary Function-Based Active Vibration Control Scheme for Flexible Cantilever Beams Using Piezoelectric Actuators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents a new control scheme for suppressing the flexible cantilever beam vibration by using the piezoelectric actuator. Based on the Hamiltonian principle, partial differential mathematical models of the flexible beam active vibration control system are characterized. Considering the complexity of the partial differential control system design, the Galerkin method is employed to decompose the partial differential dynamics model of the system into an ordinary differential model for the design of active vibration controllers. With an auxiliary function and the simplified ordinary differential mathematical model, a new active vibration controller is proposed to achieve fast vibration suppression. The stability of the closed-loop control system studied in this paper is demonstrated by means of the Lyapunov theory. Finally, numerical simulations are constructed in order to verify the effectiveness of the control strategy proposed in this paper. The results show that the proposed control method can reduce the vibration of the flexible cantilever beam effectively, making it a promising technique for active vibration control of flexible structures.

articleTitle: Generalized Design of Spacecraft Electromechanical Product Software Based on Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Software reuse is an important means to improve the productivity and quality of spacecraft embedded software. A variety of complex products based on permanent magnet synchronous motors have similar software requirements. Based on the structured requirements decomposition, this paper divides the software hierarchy, analyzes the data interaction relationship between layers, proposes a domain software component model, and designs 25 types of software components. In terms of program implementation, the software can be reused to the greatest extent from three levels of granularity: file level, project level, and product level. The software reusable assets in this paper have been successfully applied to 153 sets of products in 3 categories, and the software production efficiency has increased by 33 %.

articleTitle: The network algorithm for polyp image segmentation with fused attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Accurate segmentation of colorectal polyps can assist physicians in diagnosing gastrointestinal diseases and effectively reduce the risk of colorectal cancer. To solve the problem of accurate polyp segmentation, a multi-scale convolutional neural net incorporating attention mechanism for intestinal polyp segmentation is proposed based on the U-Net network model. First, a series of preprocessing techniques are used to process the original images. Secondly, with the help of images of colorectum, by incorporating channel attention mechanisms in the encoding and decoding stages of the U-Net network. The experimental results show that the model in this paper can accurately predict colorectal polyps and provide early prognostic information for patients.

articleTitle: A Manual Annotation for the Task of Pronoun Resolution for Events
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, we add an annotation for the task of Chinese pronoun resolution for events to the existing dataset. We first segment the article by sentence and parse the sentence into consistency parsing. Then we collect the pronouns from the consistency parsing. After that, we annotate them manually. Finally, we employ an existing model which contains BERT, LSTM, and MLP modules to test the performance of the annotated data. We also use two strategies to balance the number of positive and negative samples, making the F1 metric reach 0.537.

articleTitle: Research on fault location technology of DC transmission line based on Fault diagnosis method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper combines the advantages and disadvantages of traveling wave method and fault analysis method to propose a new fault location algorithm. Firstly, the distributed current along the DC line is obtained by fault analysis method, then the abrupt change of the distributed current is detected by stationary wavelet transform (SWT), and the wave head propagation curve of traveling wave is drawn. Finally, the wave head propagation curve at both ends is combined to determine the fault location. By comparing the method used in this project with the existing method, it can be found that the ability and reliability of the algorithm used in this project have been greatly improved. At the same time, because this algorithm also combines the principle of traveling wave ranging, its positioning accuracy is also high. The shortcoming of this algorithm is that the calculation process of the algorithm is complex, which may take a long time compared with the existing method. However, from the perspective of engineering application, the reliability and accuracy of fault location is more important than the rapidity.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Power Prediction Based on EMD-AttLSTM-ARMA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Wind energy is a type of clean energy which is widely used. Because of the high instability of wind, it is necessary to improve the prediction of the future wind energy power generation to avoid insufficient or excessive power generation due to weather and other factors. In this paper, the EMD-AttLSTM-ARMA model is used to predict wind power and has better results. It is used to decompose the wind power generation sequence, predict separately and finally obtain the result.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Siting of Traffic Accident Rescue Resources for Grid-based Operation of Urban Transportation Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the context of digital intelligence, urban transportation infrastructure is shifting towards a grid-based operational mode. The joint operation of multiple facilities has broken down information and resource barriers, but the problem of response gaps caused by resource congestion also brings new challenges to emergency risk management. This study uses the K-Means clustering algorithm to analyze the road network dependency of accident risks and identify traffic accident hotspots. Then, it analyzes resource reuse and resource congestion in the joint operation of multiple facilities, constructs a resource congestion model to classify hotspots and describe resource coverage requirements, and finally constructs an emergency resource location optimization model based on grid operation. An accident-prone elevated road network in Shanghai is selected for case validation. The results show that the proposed model can optimize emergency resource allocation, improve rescue response coverage, and reduce the loss of road network traffic quality caused by accidents.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient Cluster Routing Algorithm Based on Equivalent Equilibrium Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to extend the network life as much as possible by using limited energy, an energy-efficient clustering routing algorithm based on the equilibrium mechanism is proposed for wireless sensors in most application scenarios that cannot be replenished with energy. Firstly, we propose a clustering algorithm based on the equivalent equalization to achieve adaptive cluster head selection for heterogeneous local spatial relationships; then we design an energy-efficient inter-cluster dynamic routing strategy based on the routing cost to generate energy-efficient routes with the network path energy consumption and network energy balance. Simulation results show that this algorithm can significantly optimize network energy efficiency and achieve better network sustainability compared with related algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Traffic Flow Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of traffic flow prediction based on wavelet neural networks, an optimization algorithm for traffic flow prediction was proposed. The initial parameters of the wavelet neural network are optimized using the global optimization, fast convergence speed, and strong adaptive random search capabilities of the beetle antennae search algorithm, thereby overcoming the shortcomings of the wavelet neural network that is prone to fall into local optimization and cannot obtain optimal parameters. The BAS-WNN optimization algorithm is proposed and the traffic flow prediction model based on BAS-WNN is established. The experimental results show that the RMSE of the BAS-WNN traffic flow prediction algorithm is 8.0289, and the MAE is 5.3416. Compared with the WNN prediction algorithm, the prediction accuracy is significantly improved, with better prediction performance.

articleTitle: A Multi-scale Enhanced Lightweight Lane Line Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: n order to reduce the imbalance between the real-time performance and detection accuracy of current semantic segmentation-based lane detection algorithms to adapt to engineering applications, a multi-scale enhanced lightweight lane detection algorithm (MEL-LDA) is adopted, and a lane detection method based on improved Res_Unet is proposed in this paper. First, a multi-scale enhanced atrous spatial pyramid pooling module (ME-ASPP), used at the encoding-decoding connection, is designed to improve the algorithm’s multi-scale feature learning ability. Secondly, we propose a model pruning strategy based on the global-local threshold, which can approximately reduce the model and solve the fault phenomenon caused by excessive pruning rate to achieve both reducing the algorithm’s complexity and maintaining the same accuracy. Compared with the Res_Unet algorithm, MEL-LDA improves the mean intersection over union (MIOU) by 1.3%, reduces parameter quantity by 61.1%, and improves single-image inference speed by 27.7%. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can improve the accuracy and inference speed of lane detection, effectively reduce the complexity of the algorithm model, and better meet the needs of practical production.

articleTitle: A Model for Evaluating the Logistics Service Quality Level for Courier Enterprises Based on Principal Component Analysis in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The logistics industry has developed rapidly in recent years, and a large number of excellent courier enterprises have emerged, but the rapid development and the surge in business volume has also brought service quality problems. With fierce competition in the logistics industry, courier enterprises need to focus on the customer’s logistics service quality to be competitive in the market. In this paper, we used literature research and expert consultation methods to determine 22 elements that affect the service quality of courier enterprises. and then used the Principal Component Analysis(PCA) to establish the evaluation model of the logistics service quality for courier enterprises.

articleTitle: Lightweight Payload System for Commercial SAR Satellite
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the maturity of spaceborne synthetic aperture radar technology, the commercial spaceborne Synthetic Aperture Radar platform shows a broad application prospect. Compared with traditional spaceborne platforms, commercial satellites have a higher requirement on cost and volume. To make the payload lightweight, this paper designs a highly integrated SAR satellite payload scheme based on field programmable gate array chips to realize the function of the central electronic unit of the SAR platform. The design uses the method of combining a programmable processor and programmable logic to realize the functions of digital radio frequency, imaging control, and data transmission of radar electronic unit, and gives the solution of in-orbit anti-radiation. The central electronic unit realized in this scheme has the characteristics of high portability and low load occupancy.

articleTitle: Application of Branch Current Method in Power Flow Reverse Analysis of Single-phase Intelligent Meter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the low-voltage three-phase four-wire power supply line, the phase line behind the single-phase smart meter is wrongly connected, resulting in the negative current of the single-phase smart meter, the inconsistency between the phase line and the neutral current, and the reverse flow of the power flow, resulting in the risk of inaccurate measurement and high-quality service, causing complaints, and affecting the quality of power supply service. According to the stagger connection of the rear phase lines of two single-phase smart meters, collect the curve data of the system current and other electrical parameters, and analyze in detail the relationship between electrical parameters, the cause of reverse flow, the source of measurement error, and the correct method of electricity settlement. This paper puts forward detailed preventive measures from management and technology, evaluates and manages the whole process of the electric power metering device, and effectively guards against various risks.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Reconstruction of Traditional Chinese Medicine Decoction Pieces Using a 2D Computer Vision System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions play an important role in the treatment and prevention of COVID-19. This paper introduces a method based on enhanced 3D point cloud model and 3D point cloud comparison algorithm for the calculation of volume and density features of traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces, which provides reference for clinical medication safety. The algorithm strengthened the 3D point cloud model generated by multiple two-dimensional pictures, and calculated the volume of Chinese herbal decoction pieces by using the 3D point cloud comparison algorithm, and then obtained the density of Chinese herbal decoction pieces. This method was an innovation in the identification of Chinese herbal pieces. The average relative error of the calculated sample volume and density was less than 6.5% and 5.9%.

articleTitle: Disturbance Observer-based Integral Sliding Mode Control of Barrel Pitching Electrohydraulic Servo System with Model Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This research focus on the position tracking control of the barrel pitching electro-hydraulic servo system with model uncertainties. Based on the established dynamic model of the sytem, a disturbance observer-based integral sliding mode control approach is proposed. The mismatched disturbance observer and the matched disturbance observer are respectively designed to estimate mismatched and matched disturbances. Then, the obtained estimates of the mismatched and matched disturbances are added into the integral sliding mode controller to further improve the control performance of the electro-hydraulic servo system. The stability and convergence of the proposed approach are proved in the sense of Lyapunov theory. Comparative experiments further verified the practical effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Medical Image Encryption Algorithm Based on Improved Logistic Chaotic System and 3D Space
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the current medical detection means, medical images account for the vast majority of medical information, which is the main source of information for disease screening and diagnosis, and also an important means to assist clinical disease diagnosis and treatment. In order to improve the security of medical images, a medical image encryption algorithm with improved Logistic chaotic system is proposed. The encryption algorithm is based on Logistic chaotic sequence and three-dimensional matrix. The two-dimensional image is mapped to the three-dimensional space, and each layer in the three-dimensional space is scrambled and encrypted by using the sorted position index, and then the binary sequence of the three-dimensional space is mapped to the two-dimensional space to obtain the encrypted ciphertext image. Through the analysis of histogram, sensitivity and information entropy, the experimental data show that the medical image encryption algorithm has a good encryption effect.

articleTitle: Research on tourism attention and emotion analysis of Hongya Cave scenic spot based on Internet big data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Take Hongya Cave Scenic Spot in Chongqing as an example. Before travel: Baidu index is used to analyze the online attention of tourists before travel, and it is found that tourists’ attention to Hongyadong scenic spot is mainly concentrated in the golden week of the National Day, and the number of mobile search is increasing gradually; In terms of space, it is mainly concentrated in the southwest, east China and south China. In addition, Hongya Cave Scenic Spot has a very strong correlation with the Zhazi Cave and Ciqikou Scenic Spot, which will be the next tourist destination; After travel: through the text analysis of tourists’ comments, the scenic spot is a tourist destination with natural landscape, characteristic buildings, and characteristic food, attracting tourists, It also shows positive emotions, but there are also some negative emotions, mainly concentrated in scenic spot services, basic implementation, traffic settings and other aspects;Keywords—large-scale network; survivability association; set pair analysis theory; complex system; Finally, some rectification measures are proposed. To provide decision-making assistance and intellectual support for future tourism management.

articleTitle: Using machine learning models to forecast future prices – an exploration of investment strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Taking advantage of the fluctuations in the futures market by modelling and forecasting the commodity futures price is critical. This study aims to model and forecast the market price of commodity futures and to discover more profitable investment strategies for futures trading. I attempt to predict commodity futures prices through applying different machine learning regressions, then I select the optimal prediction model based on statistical results. Furthermore, I explore three different investment strategies based on previously predicted returns. I found that in the least squares regression, past futures prices are the most influential factor in forecasting. At the same time, it is a relatively lucrative investment strategy to choose the futures with the highest daily forecast returns to trade.

articleTitle: An Efficient Keywords Spotting System with Speaker Verification based on Binary Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Keywords spotting plays an important role for enabling voice interface between human and smart devices. It is challenging to build a real-time system with high wake-up accuracy and low false alarm rate, especially when computational resources are limited. In this paper, to achieve the trade-off between accuracy and false alarm rate, we employ a two-stage system that uses a primary keyword spotting stage and a secondary speaker verification stage. Speaker verification model based on deep neural networks requires massive memory and computational resources, which makes it difficult to be deployed on memory and power constrained devices. To solve this problem, we proposed a speaker verification model based on binary neural networks (BNNs) where floating point weights and activations are compressed into 1-bit. To mitigate the performance degradation caused by information loss, BNNs structure is optimized by adding shortcuts to connect layers. Experimental results on text-dependent and text-independent datasets show that performance of proposed speaker verification model reach the level full-precision neural networks with much less memory and computational cost. We implement this model into a two-stage keywords spotting system and experiments show that this system can reduce false alarm rate significantly while keeping wake-up accuracy.

articleTitle: Autonomous Mobile Sonobuoy and Its Combat Application Prospect
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Autonomous mobile sonobuoy is designed to be launched in a tube and has the ability to fly autonomously by combining the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) flying technology and sonobuoy. As it can be installed on all kinds of small and medium ships and unmanned platforms, Autonomous mobile sonobuoy can meet the long-distance and rapid perception requirements of the underwater battlefield situation as well as avoiding the dependence on high-value air delivery platforms. By introducing the development of UAVs technology and sonobuoy technology, the design method of autonomous mobile sonobuoy is proposed. Then the key technologies of autonomous mobile sonobuoy swarm operations are summarized, including the technology of swarm control, intelligent decision-making, network detection and so on. Furthermore, the application of autonomous mobile sonobuoy swarm in wide-area cooperative detection, precise location and effect evaluation is prospected. The results can provide references for the demand analysis, design and application of autonomous mobile sonobuoy swarm.

articleTitle: Study on Simulation Analysis of Secondary Board Card with Multi-Physical Field Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To predict and evaluate the change model of secondary board card which is sensitive to various physical fields such as temperature and stress, this paper conducted a thorough research on the simulation technology with multi-physical field coupling for the secondary board card, around the practical need to improve the reliability in MMC (modular multilevel converter) which is a component in flexible DC transmission system. According to the characteristics of MMC secondary board card, it was studied on the coupling mechanism between temperature and vibration, and an analysis approach of thermal-structural coupling was proposed. Based on this approach, an analysis application concerned thermal vibration coupling was developed, and a unit control board from MMC power module was adopted in thermal-structural simulation tests. The design defects of secondary board card were discovered, and corresponding suggestions were put forth. All these test results demonstrate that the reliability level of MMC secondary board card can be effectively improved by the proposed method - simulation test of multi-physical field coupling.

articleTitle: Design of Mobile Agricultural Data Collection Equipment Based on Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The development from traditional agriculture to intelligent agriculture needs to be driven by data. Acquiring agricultural environmental data through sensors and using advanced means such as wireless data transmission and IoT technology make agricultural data collection more refined and intelligent. In this paper, we design a prototype of Arduino-based mobile agricultural data collection device. The ESP8266-Node MCU development board is connected to a DC stepper motor driver board, a tri-color LED module and a buzzer. Using the driver module to drive two DC motors, the Arduino Nano development board is connected to a temperature and humidity sensor, a photoresistor sensor and a gas sensor. After compiling in the Arduino IDE environment and networking using the WiFi module of the ESP8266-NodeMCU development board, the device is controlled through a software application to receive and view the collected data. The four SG90 servos are controlled by connecting the breadboard power module and the Bluetooth module through the Arduino UNO R3 development board. After the Bluetooth connection, the four servos are controlled by the software application to achieve the robotic arm grasping function. The test experiment results show that the device runs smoothly, the light illumination, alarm and robotic arm grasping functions can be realized, and the movable collection of specific data about the environment where the crops are located, such as temperature, humidity, light level and gas can be smoothly realized, and the collected datas meet the objective regular changes.

articleTitle: optimization Method of Sewing Machine Case Manufacturing Resources Sets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the cloud manufacturing environment, manufacturing resources are divers, massive and dynamic, so it is difficult to achieve a quick match between supply and demand. Aiming at this problem, firstly this paper analyzed the manufacturing process of the sewing machine case, and carried on the ontology modeling of the manufacturing resources involved in the manufacturing process. Secondly, the improved K-means algorithm was used to realize the clustering of manufacturing resources of sewing machine case. On the basis of preprocessing the manufacturing resources of sewing machine case to form several resource classes, the manufacturing resources of sewing machine case in cluster center were evaluated based on extension comprehensive evaluation method, and the optimal selection of manufacturing resources sets was realized. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the method were verified by using the actual production data of the manufacturing resources of sewing machine case.

articleTitle: Flexible Strain Sensor Combined with B-ultrasonic Application for Abdominal Organs Deformation Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of flexible sensors, various implantable sensors have been developed, and implantable strain sensors also have attracted more attention. However, the development of implantable sensing field still faces many challenges, such as mechanical property matching, biocompatibility, and secondary surgical removal. In this paper, we propose an implantable wireless passive ultrasonic strain sensing system combined with a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm to predict the strain rate of the sensor in the proposed human tissue by CNN and then estimate the deformation of the target. The sensing system was a hydrogel compositing with nanohydroxyapatite (nHA), which had good stretchability, biocompatibility, and B-ultrasound visibility in vivo. Meanwhile, as its linear trend property of cross-section with strain, the ultrasound cross-sectional images of the sensor under different strains are extracted using CNN and divided into training and test sets according to the ratio of 8:2 for model training and evaluation. Finally, AlexNet has the best prediction result (91.70% accuracy) among the four selected CNN classification algorithms. It shows that the proposed scheme is an effective choice for predicting organ deformation.

articleTitle: Research on new energy direct participation in cross-provincial power trading mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Wind, light and fire bundled outward transmission is a common trading method for new energy trading across provinces and regions, which is conducive to smoothing out fluctuations in new energy output and improving the economics of long-distance transportation of new energy. At the same time, the low price of subsidized new energy plays an important role in enhancing the purchasing motivation of power users and promoting the consumption of new energy through the market. To this end, this paper makes a technical and economic analysis of the wind-light-fire bundling mode, puts forward the principle of reasonable allocation of wind-fire bundling capacity, and designs the wind-fire bundling trading mechanism from three aspects: trading price, trading mode and guarantee measures. Finally, it is proved that this mode is economical, reduces the impact caused by the fluctuation of new energy output, and promotes the consumption of new energy through calculation examples.

articleTitle: Agricultural Planting Big Data Q & A System Technology Research Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the process of agricultural production, planting has the characteristics of decentralization, complexity, seasonal differences, and regional differences, which affects agricultural growers to easily obtain effective planting information to help their own agricultural planting. The purpose of this study is to apply knowledge graph technology and natural language processing technology to the process of agricultural planting, and use the intelligent Q & A system to provide agricultural growers with regional natural conditions and suggestions and decisions of agricultural plant problems. Provide agricultural growers with a new solution for question and answer to high - efficiency and professional crop planting decisions. Finally, the intelligent decision -making and knowledge generation of farming planting, production, and operational process is achieved, and it is agricultural growers and improves farming income and farmland production efficiency. Change the agriculture from “watching the sky” to the intelligent “knowing the sky”.

articleTitle: Simulation of Wind Farm Echoes from Radar in Scanning Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power generation, an increasing number of wind farms may have a serious impact on radar target detection performance. It is of great significance to establish the model of wind farm echoes from radar. Firstly, a single wind turbine echoes model is established based on the scattering points superposition model. On this basis, the impact of terrain obstacles on the visibility of each wind turbine in the wind farm is considered. The model of wind farm echoes in radar scanning mode is studied. The echo characteristics are simulated and analyzed to provide a theoretical basis for the identification and suppression of wind farm echoes. The simulation results prove the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Big Data Analysis and Integration Capability on Enterprise Innovation Performance—The Intermediary Effect of Supply Chain Collaborative Innovation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The big data analysis and integration capability overlaps with the big data capability and big data analysis capability in concept. The current research on the big data analysis and integration capability usually focuses on the big data capability and big data analysis capability, while the research on the big data analysis and integration capability is less. From the perspective of supply chain collaborative innovation, this paper studies the impact mechanism of big data analysis integration capability on enterprise innovation performance. Based on the dualistic innovation theory, we uses two dimensions of breakthrough innovation and incremental innovation to express supply chain collaborative innovation, and reveals the intermediary effect of supply chain collaborative innovation. Based on 205 effective samples of manufacturing industry with big data application practice, a structural equation model with supply chain collaborative innovation as the intermediary is constructed. It is found that the ability of big data analysis and integration has a significant positive impact on enterprise innovation performance, Both dimensions of supply chain collaborative innovation have a significant positive impact on enterprise innovation performance. The research expands the research on the antecedents of big data analysis and integration capability on enterprise innovation performance, enriches the theoretical analysis of the aftereffect of big data analysis and integration capability, and provides theoretical reference for the empirical research of big data analysis and integration capability and innovation management practice.

Author Keywords: big data analysis and integration capabilities

articleTitle: English Text Classification based on BiLSTM and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Different English text types directly affect the accuracy of the English translation. To give full play to the value of text information and improve the accuracy of the English translation, an English text classification model combining BiLSTM and the attention mechanism is proposed. Firstly, the text features are extracted using a BiLSTM network, and the attention mechanism is introduced, which assigns secondary weights to the selected features according to the importance of the words expressing the sentence meaning, and finally, the text representation is cascaded into the softmax function to classify the text. The experiments show that the method achieves 86% accuracy, 85% recall, and 84% F1-score index in the News Category dataset.

articleTitle: A Method to Improve the Accuracy of Face Recognition in Application Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the method to improve the accuracy of face recognition by using the multi sample discrimination method and the automatic optimization method of the sample library through analyzing the problems in the face recognition application scenarios with continuous input data such as intelligent video analysis. In the automatic optimization process of the sample library, a method of dynamically updating the face sample library while face recognition is proposed. The essence of this method is to find the sample combination corresponding to the optimal constraint function value. The conditional constraint function contains two criteria: global center approximation and single distance approximation. In the simulation experiment, the recognition accuracy has been improved after using this method.

articleTitle: Design and development of cement intelligent control cloud platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, there are some problems in the informatization of cement enterprises, such as data lag, poor timeliness, single data source, etc., which can not provide a timely and accurate basis for production decision-making for enterprise management and scheduling personnel. In the aspect of intellectualization, most of them still adopt the “semi-automatic” operation mode, which is difficult to realize the optimized operation and refined management of the cement production process, which will inevitably lead to many problems such as unstable production and operation, high energy consumption, low thermal efficiency, and large fluctuations in product quality and output. In this paper, the cement intelligent control cloud platform is designed by using the. NET development platform, AJAX front and back data asynchronous interaction technology, database technology, Web Service and other web client development technologies, combined with the cement production process and the production needs of cement enterprises. The cloud platform system developed is divided into three parts: data acquisition layer, service layer and client. It has data analysis, control system management, fault alarm, multi-algorithm model simulation application and other functions, which greatly improves the production efficiency of cement enterprises.

articleTitle: Forecasting Calling Activity Based on ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Call frequency time series are extracted from Call Data Record and widely used to explore human activity patterns as well as predict calling activity. Accurate call frequency forecasting is a fascinating and challenging work. In this paper, we propose a recursive approach based on ARIMA model to forecast short term call frequency. This approach contain three steps. First two steps are modeling process and the third one is forecasting. The main work of step1 is data preprocessing and determining d (differential order) in ARIMA model. Further, a series of potential p (auto-regressive order) auto-regressive parameters values and q (moving average order) parameters values can be determined by examining the ACF (Auto Correlation Function) diagram and PACF (Partial Auto correlation Function) diagram. Then, the minimum BIC (Bayesian Information Criterion) rule is used to determine a p parameter value and a p parameter value. In the third step, the next day call frequency is predicted and all parameters are updated in a automatically recursive manner. We apply this approach on 10 call frequency time series and analyze forecasting error. The average MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) is 4.792%, which is much lower than other methods based on ARIMA model. The results show that our approach is efficient and can be used to in practical work.

articleTitle: An image encryption algorithm based on cascaded chaotic map and staggered combination diffusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a cascaded chaotic map (SL-L map) is improved to obtained wider chaotic ranges and more complex chaotic behaviors. Using the characteristics of bit plane decomposition, an image encryption algorithm based on improved chaotic map and staggered combination diffusion is designed. Firstly, the plain image is separated into 8 bit-planes by bit plane decomposition, and 4 bit-planes are formed by staggered combination. Then the improved Zigzag transform and bit-level diffusion are used to complete the permutation and diffusion respectively. Finally, the encryption is completed by using chaotic sequence to control plane synthesis. Simulation results and security analysis show that the algorithm can effectively resist various typical attacks.

articleTitle: Business systems KPI anomaly detection based on an adversarial variational autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: An anomaly KPI detection method is proposed based on an adversarial variational autoencoder (AVAE) for business systems. The proposed AVAE model is a combination of conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and generative adversarial network (GAN). Firstly, to effectively extract the periodic characteristics of KPI data, time information is introduced into the CVAE network as the input condition. Secondly, the discriminator of GAN network is introduced on the basis of CVAE to improve the sample inference ability of the generated network. Finally, CVAE, whose encoder can better obtain the mapping from real samples to hidden space, is used as a generator. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Vulnerability Detection System for Power Internet of Things Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, the number of smart terminal vulnerabilities in IoT scenarios and live network scenarios has been increasing. Whether the vulnerability information of devices can be detected effectively and efficiently directly determines whether effective and efficient prevention solutions can be designed in time to reduce equipment losses. In the power Internet of Things, there is a gap in the vulnerability detection of intelligent terminal equipment, and the security of the equipment is generally poor. If malicious external intrusion occurs, it is easy to cause network paralysis and threaten the safe and stable operation of the power system. Usually, when performing vulnerability detection on Internet of Things devices, professional network security personnel are required to manually detect vulnerabilities one by one, and often require specific hardware devices. The scene is not very specific, the operation is complicated, and it is inconvenient to carry. For the electric power Internet of Things scenario, this paper designs and develops a vulnerability detection system for electric power Internet of Things equipment that is highly targeted, capable of batch detection, fast identification speed, complete identification of vulnerabilities, internal closed loop, strong security, and lightweight.

articleTitle: Study on the Method of Underwater Weak Signal Detection in Lévy Noise Based on Stochastic Resonance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For underwater weak signal detection, a lot of research focuses on extracting useful signal information under strong noise that using stochastic resonance, but it is basically carried out in the Gaussian white noise environment, and there is little research on stochastic resonance under Lévy noise excitation. In this paper, the generation method of Lévy noise is introduced, the numerical solution method of bistable system under Lévy noise is given, and the output of bistable system is analyzed by FFT. By analyzing the output of the bistable system, it is found that the bistable system will also have stochastic resonance under the excitation of Lévy noise, and the signal information submerged in the Lévy noise can also be identified. To prove the effectiveness of the above method, we did a set of computer simulation experiments. This method can realize the weak signal detection underwater the environment of Lévy nosie.

articleTitle: An Automatic Leveling System for Automotive Headlight Based on the Suspension Height Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Automatic Leveling System (ALS) is applied to the vehicle headlight to provide an adaptive control when driving at night. The ALS detects the pitching attitude of the vehicle, and drives the stepping motor integrated in the headlight to output a compensation angle. This compensation angle can adjust the headlight illumination angle and maintain a stable lighting range. In this paper, An automotive headlight leveling system based on the vehicle suspension height measurement is proposed. The hall sensor is introduced to realize the measurement of the front and rear suspension heights. The difference of the front and rear heights is then converted to the illumination angle of the headlight. To keep stable illumination range, an compensation angle is calculated and mapped to the rotation steps of the stepping motor in the headlight. The leveling system proposed in this paper can be widely used in the automotive headlight systems.

articleTitle: Statistical on Agricultural Machinery Operation Area Based on Beidou Positioning Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the traditional manual field survey and statistics of agricultural machinery operation effective area, overlapping area and missing area, which is time-consuming, laborious and large error, this paper uses Beidou positioning terminal to collect agricultural machinery driving track information in real time and upload it to the cloud for storage. After the cloud server preprocesses the Beidou data, the data is analyzed by spatial clustering algorithm, which can be self-adaptive Finally, the contour method and grid algorithm are used to analyze and count the effective operation area, missing area and overlapping area. Through the operation experiments of 15 plots, it shows that this algorithm can well count the effective, omitted and overlapping operation areas, and the maximum absolute value of the statistical error of the effective operation area can be less than 4%, most of which are less than 2%, and the statistical accuracy can meet the needs of engineering.

articleTitle: Indoor Location and Data Security of Traffic Flow based on Fingerprint Database Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of urbanization, the number of vehicles is gradually increasing, and the vehicle is gradually developing toward the direction of intelligence. Internet of vehicles technology is gradually entering millions of homes. In this paper, traffic flow data location and security algorithm are designed, and node data verification is carried out. This paper mainly studies the influence of fingerprint database filtering and matching methods on WiFi indoor locations based on RSSI. The results of this paper show that the designed system can transmit traffic flow data safely and accurately.

articleTitle: Remote Power Failure Tracing Based on Classification Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of smart grid and the rapid development of sensor technology, the traditional cost control system fault detection technology has been unable to meet the needs of analysis and processing. Therefore, this paper proposes a fault detection method for cost control system based on decision tree. The method uses decision tree to filter abnormal data, and classifies data at different levels to obtain data sets of different fault causes, establishes attribute feature table, and uses information gain rate for decision division to detect faults. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Stack-CNN: An End-to-end Target Relative Pose Recognition Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the aerospace industry in the world in recent years, the precise measurement of the relative position and attitude of spacecraft has become one of the hot spots in the development of space technology. Among them, the observation technology of computer vision based on optical imaging is the basis for realizing the automation of on-orbit spacecraft position and attitude measurement. It is required that the vision system can measure the relative position and attitude between the observer and the target online. In recent years, a large number of target pose measurement methods based on deep learning have emerged, which are also partially applied in the aerospace field. However, these methods generally have the problems of only recognizing a single image, large amount of calculation, and ignoring the information between images. In order to solve the problems above, we propose an end-to-end target relative pose recognition method based on CNN. This method uses the information between multiple consecutive images to realize the end-to-end recognition of relative pose and absolute pose, and does not need subsequent pose calculation. The advantages of this method, such as low computation, high precision and fast speed, ensure that this method has good application value in the intelligent application of mobile terminals.

articleTitle: A gallbladder segmentation method of a CFC-MSPCNN in ultrasound image
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The gallbladder is located in the gallbladder fossa of the liver and has a long pear shape, which can play a role in storing and concentrating bile in the human body. In recent years, due to the high incidence of gallbladder diseases in China, which affects people’s quality of life, so in order to prevent and detect such diseases in a timely manner, this paper proposes a CFC-MSPCNN-based image segmentation method based on SPCN to simplify the setting of relevant parameters. The experimental results show that this method can significantly reduce the detection cost while improving the detection accuracy, and is an effective method for ultrasound image segmentation of gallbladder stones.

articleTitle: The Prediction Algorithm of Energy Consumption for Cattle GrowMh Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to further promote the efficient and green development of livestock industry, it is an important development trend to build a smart farming system based on data mining. In this paper, fuzzy clustering and random forest prediction algorithm were introduced into the energy consumption prediction of cattle growth in livestock farms. The fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm can identify the factors with high correlation according to the membership size between various variables and the growth energy consumption load. The input space is reconstructed according to the membership size of each component to reduce the input of the prediction algorithm. Then random forest artificial intelligence algorithm was used to predict the growth energy consumption of different livestock cattle. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is discussed with a specific example of a livestock farm.

articleTitle: Research on medical image denoising based on wavelet pyramid fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The noise in medical images will affect the subsequent image processing. In order to reduce the noise in the prostate capsule, we proposed a new noise reduction technology using principal component analysis, wavelet pyramid fusion and adaptive median filtering. Compared with other commonly used denoising algorithms, this method is simple and efficient, and can better maintain image details while reducing noise.

articleTitle: Building A Deep Learning Model for Multi-Label Classification of Natural Disasters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Natural disasters, such as earthquakes, hurricanes/typhoons and wildfires, usually cause severe damage. Disaster response and management is a great challenge to the authority. Current studies usually focus on a single disaster identification using social media data. In reality, there are relationships among different types of disasters. And several disasters may happen simultaneously. In this study, we explore the role of the deep learning model in multi-label disaster classification. We build a deep CNN model for multi-label classification with the instruction of a high-order strategy. We train and validate our model using a professional low-altitude disaster dataset, LADI. We find our proposed deep learning model with the transfer learning method outperforms many other machine learning models in the previous study.

articleTitle: Reaserch of Telecom Enterprise Customer Service Knowledge Base Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to establish and improve the knowledge management system, realize the sharing of internal and external knowledge of the organization, build the core competitiveness of enterprises in the era of digital economy, and realize the whole process information management of knowledge and information of communication enterprises, it has become an inevitable trend to improve the development of optimal management. Based on the investigation and analysis of the actual needs of customer service knowledge base management and service work of telecom enterprises, a customer service knowledge base platform of telecom enterprises is designed and implemented. Through the overall architecture design, functional design and database design of the platform, based on the lightweight framework of Spring Boot, the functions of each subsystem of the platform are designed in detail with a microservice architecture. At the same time, in the whole cycle of system research and development, corresponding testing work was carried out to improve the quality and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: A Survey of Security Analysis on Industrial Control Devices via Rehosting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the network security of embedded devices has received more and more attention. However, the existing dynamic analysis tools can’t performance in embedded devices as common softwares. The main reason is that the internal state information of the embedded device can not be directly obtained, and the debugging interface usually shields the device after the manufacturer produces it. Thus, this paper introduces rehosting techniques for embedded systems and the differences between each way. Then we talk about the Deficiencies and future works in emulate execution.

articleTitle: Exploring the Integration of National Cultural Resources through Content Retrieval and Visual Semantic Segmentation Display
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the era of ubiquitous information and abundant data, the ability to extract relevantinformation from scattered, obscure, and heterogeneous data sources is of paramount importance. Despitethe considerable richness of ethnic cultural resources, they are often characterized by significant heterogeneity and fragmentation. Semantic segmentation technology can effectively leverage the power of computers to extract image features and compile feature databases, enabling the fusion of heterogeneous knowledge. To this end, this paper proposes an image classification method that combines object semantics and deep learning algorithms to identify object areas within an image and retrieve matching images from a database based on implicit semantic information. Through the integration of national cultural resources, this approach enables content retrieval and visual semantic segmentation. The use of multi-layer perceptrons for supervised learning facilitates the generation of object semantic templates to address the challenge of object semantic similarity. The resulting templates can then be applied to classify images, leading to a high classification accuracy rate for binary semantic images. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method enables automatic feature comparison with target images in the feature library during the retrieval of ethnic cultural resources, allowing for the mining of previously undiscovered and valuable knowledge. Finally, the best matching results and relevant information are output to users, enabling the effective use of these resources

articleTitle: MSFNet: A Multi-Level Semantic Feature Fusion Network for Instance Segmentation of X-ray Security Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to eliminate security risks and reduce the probability of terrorist incidents, X-ray security scanners have been installed in places such as airports, customs and railway stations to check whether luggage packages contain prohibited items. At present, the security inspection is manually checked by professional security personnel. In the face of a large number of objects to be detected, the efficiency of manual detection is low, and the detection results are susceptible to human experience and psychological interference. The design of automatic identification and detection of prohibited items in X-ray security inspection scenes can effectively improve the efficiency of security inspection and reduce the difficulty of potential risks and human operation. With the development of deep learning in recent years, computer vision technology can realize fast and reliable automatic detection of prohibited items. However, due to the penetrating imaging nature of X-ray, the X-ray security images contain a lot of occlusion and overlap, which increases the difficulty of identifying prohibited items. Based on the SCNet <sup>[1]</sup> algorithm, this paper proposes an instance segmentation algorithm multi-level semantic feature fusion network(MSFNet).
