MSFNet enhances the upsampling ability of the model to recover detailed information, and effectively fuses low-order shallow detail information and high-order abstract semantic information. Firstly, a dynamic upsampling feature fusion module(DUFM) was proposed to capture a longer range of context information and reduce the interference of occlusion noise. Secondly, a multi-stage global semantic extraction module(MGSEM) is proposed to extract multi-scale global semantic information from semantic features of different granularities. Experiments on the Pidray dataset <sup>[2]</sup> show that MSFNet has further improvement in accuracy compared with common instance segmentation algorithms, and the accuracy index in detection and segmentation tasks reaches 72.3%and 62.4% mAP respectively.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a smart site supervision system based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the advancement of urbanization in China, various problems on construction sites are increasingly prominent. How to strengthen management and eliminate various illegal operations is still an important research topic. This article studies three scenarios: on-site environment, tower crane, and maintenance room from the perspectives of green, safety, and quality. Firstly, monitoring equipment, control equipment, and intelligent IoT gateway are designed based on STM32F407VE. Secondly, a transmission network combining RS485 wired, LoRa, WIFI, and 4G wireless communication is designed, and the Modbus and MQTT protocols are converted. Then, a comprehensive supervision system is designed using a B/S architecture, which realized uploading the site video data, environmental data, tower crane operation, maintenance room temperature and humidity data to the platform, while saving the collected data to MySQL database to complete the data calling and analysis. Finally, the comprehensive supervision platform will conduct alarm linkage and other processing. Through testing, it is verified that the system designed in this paper can supervise the construction site in time and improve the efficiency of site management.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Navigation of a Disinfection Robot for Hospital Based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Hospital is a crowded place, especially full of patients, where the influenza virus, such as COVID-19, can be easier to spread. In order to improve the efficiency of virus disinfection in the hospital, a virus disinfection robot based on the wheeled mobile car and ROS system is proposed in this paper. The proposed disinfection robot scans the corridor of the hospital by laser radar and then builds up the map of the whole environment. And path planning is carried out based on the established map so that effective passage can be realized. Then the virus disinfection is put into effect at the planed point of the building with the ultraviolet lamp. Finally, there is a simulation that shows out the effective of the path planning method, based on which the proposed disinfection robot can be used for virus disinfection in hospitals.

articleTitle: Automatic segmentation of true lumen and false lumen of aortic dissection based on a two-stage learning framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Accurate segmentation for true lumen (TL) and false lumen (FL) is essential for the treatment of aortic dissection (AD) disease. However, the complex morphology of AD raised challenges for AD segmentation, especially for precise TL and FL separation. In this study, a novel two-stage algorithm based on the mesh model was developed to achieve the segmentation of TL and FL. In detail, a MeshSegNet was firstly applied to complete the coarse segmentation of AD and then fast geodesic curvature flow (FGCF) was used to optimize the segmentation result. A total of 150 type B AD cases were included to train and evaluate the effect of the proposed segmentation algorithm. The results showed that FGCF could significantly enhance the segmentation precision with the maximum increasing dice score of 0.18 compared to that with MeshSegNet method only. The average accuracy of all included testing cases was more than 93%. This two-stage segmentation algorithm could achieve precise and efficient segmentation of TL and FL, thus might assist in the treatment of AD in the future.

articleTitle: Vulnerability analysis of power communication network based on complex network theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient recognition ability and inaccurate recognition results of traditional communication network weak area identification methods, this paper proposes a communication network weak link identification algorithm based on community influence. Firstly, the community structure of the network is discovered by the community discovery algorithm GN algorithm, which can divide the network into multiple communities; secondly, the communication network weakness assessment index is constructed from two aspects of community local influence and community global influence; finally, the method proposed in this paper is verified and analyzed by the actual power communication network. The simulation results show that the weak link identification algorithm of power communication network proposed in this paper has higher discriminability and accuracy compared with traditional methods.

articleTitle: Prediction Of Aluminum Electrolytic Cell Condition based on WOA-TCN Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The cell condition plays a very important role in the stability and efficiency of production in the aluminum electrolysis production process. In order to enhance the stability of aluminum electrolytic cell condition, a prediction model of aluminum electrolytic cell condition based on whale optimization algorithm and temporal convolutional network is proposed. Firstly, the time series features are input into the TCN prediction model for pre-training, and then the trained TCN model is adjusted using the whale optimization algorithm to adjust the hyperparameters, and the WOA-TCN combination model is constructed to predict the condition of the aluminum electrolytic cell. The results show that using WOA-TCN combination model can predict the cell conditions accurately, thus providing effective practical guidance for the actual electrolytic aluminum production.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Ultrasonic Propagation Characteristics of Two-point Partial discharge in Oil-immersed Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to analyze the propagation characteristics of the ultrasonic signals generated by the two-point partial discharge inside the oil-immersed transformer, the Finite Element Method is used for modeling and simulation. The temporal, spatial and frequency characteristics of the ultrasonic signals at the partial discharge point inside the transformer are obtained. Compared with the single-point local discharge case, the overall sound pressure amplitude at the place where the sound pressure overlap occurs is approximately doubled in the two-point local discharge case. The frequency distribution ranges at the observation points are also expanded from 10-30kHz at single partial discharge to 10-40 kHz at two-point partial discharge. These provide data support for the detection and positioning of internal partial discharge of oil-immersed transformer.

articleTitle: Code-carrier divergence threshold selection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To address the importance of code-deviation threshold selection in signal quality detection, a code-deviation-based threshold selection algorithm is proposed, firstly, a code-deviation threshold calculation model is given, a threshold selection method based on maximum likelihood estimation is derived, a small amount of abnormal data is eliminated by the box plot method, and then the mean and Then, the mean and standard deviation of the overall data are estimated by the maximum likelihood estimation method, and the thresholds that conform to the overall data distribution are calculated. The results show that the detection of code-carrier divergence can effectively identify the abnormal signals, prove the rationality of the threshold selection, solve the problem that the traditional threshold model is too conservative and less accurate, and improve the reliability of the threshold.

articleTitle: Research on Talent Cultivation Index Model of High-Tech Enterprises Based on Improved AHP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Talents are the core competitiveness of enterprise development, while talent cultivation plays an important role in the stable development of enterprises. As a result, building a scientific evaluation model of talent cultivation is an effective way to establish talent development path and optimize human resource structure. Based on three first-level indexes, four second-level indexes and three third-level indexes, this paper establishes an evaluation model for talent cultivation program, which uses AHP method to calculate index weights. However, in AHP, there are cases where the judgment matrixes fail the consistency tests. To solve this problem, an improved AHP is proposed to amend flawed matrix which can’t pass consistency test for successful operation. After calculation, all matrixes finally pass consistency test and the weights of each level are obtained. Through ranking weights and analyzing results, we can get some guidances and suggestions to assist company in cultivating talent and help talents improve themselves better.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Deep Learning in Liver Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Delineating a target organ is the procedure known as biomedical segmentation. Liver cancer is the second most common cancer to cause death. The automatic liver segmentation from CT scans is a necessary job for the diagnosis of liver cancer disease. However, because of its irregular form and proximity to other organs, the liver is one of the more challenging organs to segment. For liver segmentation in the current research, datasets with only liver labels are typically used, the model is not resistant to cases involving multiple phases and vendors. AbdomenCT1K is a large and various abdominal CT datasets from 12 medical institutions, including cases with multiple diseases, vendors, and phases. To segment the liver, we use the Dense-UNet trained with AbdomenCT-1K, and it achieved the dice of 0.9271 and NSD of 0.9685. We compare different backbone networks in this research, and the results show that our model is more reliable and performs better than many other deep learning models in the prior study.

articleTitle: A RGB-UV Facial Skin Image Translation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In dermatology and cosmetology, ultraviolet (UV) images can reflect deep facial problems better than RGB images, but its reliance on UV imaging devices limits its clinical application and widespread popularity. This paper proposes a UV facial image generation method without using any UV imaging UV equipment. Specifically, many RGB-UV facial skin image pairs are collected and a dataset is then built. The dataset includes high-resolution RGB-UV image pairs of different positions on the face of people in different age groups. By using the dataset, a generative adversarial network-based method for facial skin image translation is proposed, which achieves better results in RGB-UV image conversion than some compared image-to-image translation methods.

articleTitle: Ultra-Sensitive Terahertz Metamaterial Sensor Based on Three-Dimensional Triangular Split Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: an ultra-sensitive three-dimensional triangular resonator (DTSRR) sensor is designed and its transmission characters in the terahertz frequency range (0.1 $\sim$ 1.8 THz) is studied. The resonance and sensing performance of the designed DTSRR unit has been systematically analyzed. At the same time, under the influence of electromagnetic waves, the design of this DTSRR unit not only eliminates anisotropy, but also significantly reduces the dielectric losses caused by the dielectric substrate. This structure reaches a maximum refractive index sensitivity level of 1037 GHz/RIU. These findings might facilitate the design of ultrasensitive real time chemical and biomolecular sensors in the fingerprint region of the terahertz regime.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Economic Management in the Information Age
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and Internet technology, artificial intelligence (AI) innovation technology has made breakthrough progress, which has important impact and significance for economic society. By analyzing four economic effects of AI, including intelligent penetration effect, boundary extension effect, knowledge creation effect and self-deepening effect, this paper probes into the main factors of artificial intelligence affecting economic growth, specifically from three angles of labor factor, capital factor and production technology. In addition, this paper also empirically tests the relationship between artificial intelligence and economic growth according to three important indicators of artificial intelligence, such as industrial scale, patent number and financing scale, and further demonstrates the significant impact of artificial intelligence on economic growth.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Interference of the Drone Gun to Very High Frequency Station of Airport Tower
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, first the intensity of electromagnetic radiation caused by a drone gun at the frequency band of very high frequency station was obtained in laboratory. Then the maximum value of intensity of electromagnetic radiation was acquired through the analytical software. Meanwhile the electromagnetic interference impact of a drone gun to very high frequency station was analyzed. Afterwards the change of the protective distance of very high frequency station with an increase of the protection rate was demonstrated. Finally, the protective distance of very high frequency station was given, which can provide support for the site selection of a drone gun at or around airport.

articleTitle: Research on the Attitude Detection of the Middle Slot of Scraper Conveyor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the difficulty and low accuracy of attitude detection of scraper conveyor in fully mechanized mining face, a method of attitude detection of middle slot of scraper conveyor based on inertia unit is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the principle of middle slot attitude detection based on inertial measurement unit is studied, and the middle slot attitude detection model is established. Then, the attitude update and solution method of the middle trough based on quaternion is determined. Finally, a fusion detection method of middle slot attitude information based on UKF algorithm is designed. The experimental results show that this method can accurately measure the three-axis attitude angle of the middle slot of the scraper conveyor, and the maximum error of yaw angle, pitch angle and roll angle is $0.417^{\circ}, 0.023^{\circ}$ and 0.012° respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors of China’s International Trade Based on the Grey Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Under the background of global economic integration, China’s international trade competitiveness is low, so it is of practical significance to study and analyze its influencing factors. This paper selects GDP, net foreign direct investment, social financing scale stock, net foreign direct investment, and total online sales as influencing factors, establishes a grey relational model, and reasonably analyzes the influence of five influencing factors on China’s international trade through the grey relational coefficient. Based on GM (1, N), this paper forecasts the total import and export volume of China’s international trade, and at the same time selects lag factors to analyze the lag effects of the economic crisis, and considers the impact of price level changes on the lag factors.
